rule: A field is published only where it rests on one tier-1 source (government, immigration authority, official gazette or statute text) or two independent agreeing tier-2 sources (law firm or established specialist outlet). Tier 3 is agency or marketing material and is never sufficient. Fields that could not clear that bar are marked not established in place rather than filled with a best guess; where the threshold itself was unestablished the programme was moved to `excluded`. Wikipedia was not used.
rule_zh: 單一欄位僅於具備一筆第一級來源（政府、移民主管機關、官方公報或法條原文），或兩筆彼此獨立且一致之第二級來源（律師事務所或具規模之專業媒體）時始予刊登。第三級為仲介或行銷資料，任何情形下均不足採。未達此標準之欄位一律於原處標示未查證，不以推測填補；門檻本身無法確立者，該制度移入 excluded 清單。本次未使用維基百科。

notes.sort_usd_en: sort_usd is an ordering key for the table and charts, not a published threshold. It equals min_value.usd wherever the source dataset published one. Cape Verde is the single exception: its source pass deliberately publishes no USD equivalent because the euro floats against the dollar, so sort_usd there is an editorial conversion at EUR 1 = USD 1.17 used solely to place the row.
notes.sort_usd_zh: sort_usd 為表格與圖表之排序鍵，並非刊登之門檻金額。凡原始資料集已刊登 min_value.usd 者，兩者相同。維德角為唯一例外：其原始輪次因歐元對美元浮動而刻意不刊登美元等值，故該筆 sort_usd 係以 EUR 1 = USD 1.17 換算，僅供排序定位之用。
notes.outcome_class_en: outcome_class is an editorial classification of the published leads_to text into four groups: citizenship (the route itself confers citizenship), permanent (a permanent or indefinite status is available, immediately or after a stated qualifying period), renewable (the source states there is no onward pathway, or expressly bars one), not_established (the source could not establish it). The underlying leads_to text is retained in full so the classification can be audited.
notes.outcome_class_zh: outcome_class 係就已刊登之 leads_to 文字所作之編輯分類，分為四組：citizenship（該途徑本身賦予公民身分）、permanent（可取得永久或無期限身分，或於明定年限後取得）、renewable（來源明載無後續途徑，或明文排除）、not_established（來源無法確立）。leads_to 原文全數保留，分類可據以查核。
notes.region_en: region groups jurisdictions geographically for the page and is editorial. Mauritius and Seychelles sit in meaf although their source sweep was the Asia-Pacific one.
notes.region_zh: region 係為頁面呈現所作之地理分組，屬編輯欄位。模里西斯與塞席爾雖出自亞太輪次，於此歸入 meaf。
notes.established_en: established records, per field, whether the finding cleared the publication rule. For the threshold there are three states: published (a figure), absent_verified (the competent authority sets no minimum, and that absence itself is verified at tier 1 or 2), and not_established. For term, minimum stay and onward status there are two: published or not_established. The values were read off the source field text and are index-aligned with it.
notes.established_zh: established 逐欄記錄該項認定是否通過刊登標準。門檻分三種狀態：published（有金額）、absent_verified（主管機關未設最低金額，且該不存在本身已於第一或第二級來源獲得確認）、not_established。期限、最低停留與後續身分則分兩種：published 或 not_established。各值係就原始欄位文字判讀，並與其逐筆對應。

fx_notes.note: All statutory amounts are stated in the currency of the governing instrument; that local-currency figure is the authoritative one. The 'usd' field is an INDICATIVE EDITORIAL CONVERSION, not a sourced or statutory value, computed at EUR 1 = USD 1.17, GBP 1 = USD 1.35, AZN 1 = USD 0.588 (manat pegged ~1.70 AZN/USD since 2017) and rounded to the nearest USD 1,000. Do not quote the USD figure as a legal threshold. Bulgaria adopted the euro on 1 January 2026 at the fixed rate BGN 1.95583 = EUR 1 (ECB), but the consolidated Bulgarian Foreigners Act as amended to 16 June 2026 still expresses every threshold in BGN; any euro figure for Bulgaria is a conversion, not a statutory amount.

USD equivalents are INDICATIVE ONLY. They are arithmetic conversions at the following reference rates and are NOT verified market rates for any given date: THB 34, MYR 4.2, IDR 16300, KRW 1380, HKD 7.8, PHP 57, VUV 120, LKR 300, MUR 46 per USD. Every threshold in this dataset except where the source itself is denominated in USD is set in local currency; the local-currency figure is the operative legal one and is what was verified against source. Refresh the rates before publication and never present the USD column as a legal threshold.

AED is pegged to USD at 3.6725; AED 2,000,000 = US$544,588, rounded to US$545,000. JOD is pegged at 1 JOD = US$1.41044; JOD 150,000 = US$211,566 (shown as US$212,000), JOD 200,000 = US$282,088 (US$282,000), JOD 300,000 = US$423,132 (US$423,000). Caribbean CBI thresholds are legislated in US dollars, so no conversion is applied. XCD (EC$) is pegged at 2.70 to the USD but is not used for any figure below. All USD figures shown are either the legislated currency itself or a peg conversion — none involve a floating rate, so none go stale.

Qatar: the Real Estate Regulatory Authority states its own USD equivalents (QAR 730,000 = US$200,000; QAR 3,650,000 = US$1,000,000), so the authority's figures are used rather than a computed peg conversion (the QAR is pegged at 3.64 to the USD, which would give US$200,549 and US$1,002,747). Bahrain: BHD is pegged at 0.376 to the USD, so BHD 130,000 = US$345,745, shown as US$346,000; note that widely circulated agency material rounds this to US$345,000. Cape Verde: the escudo is pegged to the euro and the statute itself supplies both figures (EUR 80,000 = 8,821,200 CVE; EUR 120,000 = 13,231,800 CVE, implying 110.265 CVE/EUR), so the euro figures are the legislated ones; NO USD equivalent is published for Cape Verde because EUR/USD floats and any USD figure would go stale. Panama and Costa Rica legislate in US dollars, so no conversion applies. Oman's property route has no monetary threshold at all, so no conversion is needed. All published figures below are either the legislated currency itself or a hard-peg conversion — none involve a floating rate.

method_notes.note: Publication rule enforced per field: a value is published only where it rests on one tier-1 source (government / immigration authority / official gazette / statute text) or two independent agreeing tier-2 sources (law firm or established specialist outlet). Fields resting on a single tier-2 source, on tier-3 material, or on disagreeing sources are either omitted, or their text states the disagreement with both values labelled, and the programme's confidence is dropped to medium. Wikipedia was not used. Where a draft figure could not be traced it has been dropped rather than estimated.

Source tiers: 1 = government, immigration authority, gazette or statute; 2 = law firm or established specialist outlet; 3 = agency or marketing blog. A field is published only on one tier-1 source or two independent agreeing tier-2 sources. Fields that could not meet that bar are marked NOT VERIFIED in place rather than filled with a best guess, and where the threshold itself was unestablished the programme was moved to 'excluded'. The session's WebSearch budget was exhausted at the outset, so verification was done by direct retrieval of primary documents (statutes, gazettes, ministerial orders, scanned PDFs read as images) via browser and HTTP, which is stronger evidence than search snippets but did limit the ability to hunt for amending announcements; that limitation is flagged in place wherever it bites.

programmes.programme: Golden Visa (permanent investor residence permit, art. 100 of Law 5038/2023)
programmes.programme_zh: 黃金簽證（第 5038/2023 號法律第 100 條之投資人永久居留許可）

min_value.basis: standard tier — all regions outside the designated high-demand zones; must be a single property; full price paid before application

extra_tiers.label_en: high-demand zones — Attica, the Thessaloniki area of Central Macedonia, Mykonos, Santorini and islands with population over 3,100
conversion of a non-residential/industrial building to residential use (change of use must be COMPLETED before applying), or restoration of a listed/preservable building

term.text_en: 5 years, renewable indefinitely while the investment remains compliant
term.text_zh: 5 年，投資持續合規即可無限次續期

stay.text_en: None. The investor need only appear once per five-year cycle for biometrics at renewal.
stay.text_zh: 無居住天數要求；每 5 年續期時親自到場錄生物特徵一次即可。

leads_to.text_en: Naturalisation after 7 years' residence, plus language and integration criteria. NOTE: this is the general naturalisation rule; with a zero-stay permit the residence clock is not satisfied by holding the permit alone.
leads_to.text_zh: 居住滿 7 年後可申請歸化，另須通過語言與融入條件。注意：此為一般歸化規則；本許可不設居住要求，僅持有許可本身並不累積居住年限。

offplan.text_en: Not established. The full purchase price must be paid before the application is submitted, and a 120 sqm minimum main living area applies to built property and property with an issued building permit (undeveloped land is exempt from the size rule) — but no source reached states whether an undelivered off-plan unit qualifies.
offplan.text_zh: 未能查證。申請前須付清全額價金，且已建成或已取得建照之物件須主要居住面積至少 120 平方公尺（素地不受面積規定限制）；惟無任何可引用來源說明尚未交屋之預售單位是否合格。

mortgage.text_en: UNVERIFIED — do not rely on either answer. Sources confirm only that the price must be paid in full before application; none addresses permitted payment methods or whether borrowing is allowed. The frequently repeated 'no mortgage / bank transfer only' claim could not be traced to any citable source.
mortgage.text_zh: 未經查證，兩種說法皆不可採信。可引用來源僅載明申請前須付清全額，未觸及付款方式或是否得以貸款支應。坊間常見的「不得貸款、僅限電匯」說法查無可引用出處。

dependants.text_en: Not verified in this sweep.
dependants.text_zh: 本次查核未查證。

entry_tax.text_en: Transfer tax 3% of taxable value, 3.09% including the municipal surcharge; reduced 1.5%/0.75% rates in specific cases. New buildings: standard VAT 24%, but suspended where the construction permit was issued or revised from 1 Jan 2006 on seller application — CONFLICT on the current status: PwC states the suspension ran until 31 December 2025 with 24% resuming thereafter, while several tier-3 outlets claim it continues through 2026. Do not publish a 2026 VAT position.
entry_tax.text_zh: 過戶稅為課稅價值的 3%，加計市政附加後為 3.09%；特定情形適用 1.5%／0.75% 減徵。新成屋標準加值稅 24%，惟建照於 2006 年 1 月 1 日起核發或修改者，經賣方申請得暫停課徵——現況有衝突：PwC 稱暫停至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止、其後恢復 24%，多家第三級來源則稱 2026 年續行。2026 年之加值稅立場不予刊登。

last_change.text_en: Law 5100/2024 restructured the tiers with effect from 1 September 2024. VERIFIED NEGATIVE for anything later: a full-text search of the Greek official gazette (et.gr) for 2025 and 2026 found no Issue A (statute) amending art. 100 of Law 5038/2023 — only five Issue B ministerial decisions. The most recent, joint ministerial decision FEK B' 6014/2025 of 11 November 2025, sets supporting documents only and contains no monetary figure, no loan/mortgage provision and no size rule.
last_change.text_zh: 第 5100/2024 號法律重整級距，自 2024 年 9 月 1 日生效。其後之修正經查證為無：以全文檢索希臘官方公報（et.gr）2025 與 2026 年，未見任何甲編（法律）修正第 5038/2023 號法律第 100 條，僅有五件乙編部長決定。最新者為 2025 年 11 月 11 日 FEK B' 6014/2025 聯合部長決定，僅規定應備文件，未含任何金額、貸款條款或面積規定。

short.term_en: 5 yrs, renewable
short.term_zh: 5 年，可續期
short.outcome_en: Naturalisation at 7 yrs, but a zero-stay permit does not run the residence clock
short.outcome_zh: 7 年可歸化，惟零居留要求之許可不累積居住年限
short.own_en: One property only; full price paid before applying; short letting prohibited
short.own_zh: 限單一物件；申請前付清全額；禁止短期出租

programmes.notes_en: DRAFT SWEEP WAS WRONG on one point: a Greek law firm's reference to 'Law 5187/2025 of 21 March 2025' as amending the Golden Visa regime is incorrect. FEK A 48/2025 of 21 March 2025 is Law 5187/2025 on the reorganisation of the Hellenic Police and modernisation of electronic monitoring — it has nothing to do with investor residence. Confidence is medium because the three thresholds themselves rest on a single tier-2 source (Watson Farley & Williams), not on retrieved statutory text. SEPARATE WARNING: the Ministry of Migration and Asylum's own public page at migration.gov.gr/golden-visa is STALE — it is still keyed to art. 20B of Law 4251/2014 (superseded) and still quotes EUR 250,000 as the threshold, and its clarifying-documents library contains nothing newer than 2023. It must not be cited as a statement of current thresholds. Other conditions established at tier 2: the investment must go into ONE property only (no fragmenting); short-term/Airbnb-type letting of the qualifying property is prohibited and breach triggers revocation plus an administrative fine; a converted property may not be used as a business headquarters or branch; permits issued under prior frameworks are grandfathered and exempt from the new restrictions.
programmes.notes_zh: 草稿有一處錯誤：某希臘律師事務所援引「2025 年 3 月 21 日第 5187/2025 號法律」修正黃金簽證制度，此為誤引。2025 年 3 月 21 日 FEK A 48/2025 之第 5187/2025 號法律係關於希臘警察組織重整與電子監控現代化，與投資移民無涉。信心度列為中等，係因三級距金額本身僅有單一第二級來源（Watson Farley & Williams），未取得法條原文。另須警示：移民與庇護部官網 migration.gov.gr/golden-visa 內容已過時——仍援引已被取代之第 4251/2014 號法律第 20B 條，仍列 25 萬歐元門檻，其釋義文件庫最新僅至 2023 年，不得引為現行門檻之依據。其他第二級來源確認之條件：投資須集中於單一物件，不得分拆；合格物件禁止短期出租（Airbnb 類），違反者撤銷許可並處行政罰鍰；改建物件不得作為營業總部或分支機構；依舊制核發之許可受既得保障，不適用新限制。

programmes.programme: Immigration Permit by investment, expedited procedure under Regulation 6(2) of the Aliens and Immigration Regulations
programmes.programme_zh: 投資取得移民許可（外國人與移民規則第 6(2) 條快速通道）

min_value.basis: excluding VAT — VAT is payable on top. For a house or apartment (category 2.1(A)) it must be a FIRST SALE from a development company; resale does not qualify. Official payment receipts of at least EUR 300,000 excluding VAT must be produced at application, regardless of the property's delivery date.

extra_tiers.label_en: other real estate — offices, shops, hotels or similar developments (category 2.1(B)); RESALE IS PERMITTED in this category

term.text_en: The residence right itself is of unlimited validity for the holder and adult dependants. The residence permit CARD expires ten years from issue and must be replaced on expiry; minors' cards run to age 18.
term.text_zh: 居留權本身對主申請人及成年受扶養人為無限期有效。居留許可卡自核發起 10 年到期，屆期須換發；未成年人之卡效期至 18 歲。

stay.text_en: No affirmative visit quota, but two lapse triggers: the permit ceases to be valid if the holder and dependants fail to acquire residence in Cyprus within ONE YEAR of approval while residing abroad; and it ceases to be valid if they acquire permanent residence abroad or are ABSENT FROM CYPRUS FOR TWO YEARS.
stay.text_zh: 無積極的到訪次數要求，但有兩項失效條件：核准後若申請人及受扶養人仍居國外且未於 1 年內在賽普勒斯取得居所，許可失效；若在境外取得永久居留、或連續 2 年未入境賽普勒斯，許可亦失效。

leads_to.text_en: NOT ADDRESSED by the official criteria. A full-text search of the tier-1 policy document returns zero occurrences of 'citizenship' or 'naturalisation'. No naturalisation timeline is asserted here because none was sourced.
leads_to.text_zh: 官方核准標準文件完全未提及。以全文檢索該第一級政策文件，「公民身分」與「歸化」均為零筆。因無可引用出處，本資料集不主張任何入籍年限。

offplan.text_en: Qualifies, provided payment is complete. The criteria require official payment receipts of at least EUR 300,000 excluding VAT at application 'regardless of the property's delivery date' — so an undelivered unit is acceptable if fully paid and receipted.
offplan.text_zh: 可，但須付款完成。核准標準要求申請時提出至少 30 萬歐元（不含加值稅）之正式付款收據，且明定「不論物件交付日期為何」，故尚未交屋之單位只要全額付清並取得收據即可。

mortgage.text_en: Cyprus-side borrowing is BARRED. The criteria require that the funds be proved to have been transferred to Cyprus from abroad, from the applicant's or spouse's own bank account, paid into the seller's account at a Cyprus financial institution, and that the money 'has derived from abroad and is not the result of domestic borrowing'. The text bars DOMESTIC borrowing specifically; it does not expressly address a loan raised outside Cyprus, provided the money arrives from the applicant's own foreign account.
mortgage.text_zh: 禁止賽普勒斯境內借貸。核准標準要求證明資金自國外匯入賽普勒斯，須來自申請人或配偶本人帳戶，並匯入賣方於賽國金融機構之帳戶，且資金須「來自境外，非源於境內借貸」。條文明文禁止的是境內借貸，對於在賽國境外取得之貸款則未明文規範，惟資金仍須自申請人本人之境外帳戶匯入。

dependants.text_en: Spouse and dependent minor children. Unmarried children aged up to 25 in tertiary education abroad and financially dependent may be included; a non-dependent adult child requires a SEPARATE EUR 300,000 investment of their own. Parents and parents-in-law are EXCLUDED — they cannot be included under the investor's permit.
dependants.text_zh: 配偶及受扶養未成年子女。未婚、在國外接受高等教育且經濟依賴之 25 歲以下子女得一併納入；非受扶養之成年子女須另行投資 30 萬歐元。父母與配偶父母不得納入投資人許可之受扶養人範圍。

entry_tax.text_en: Land Registry transfer fees 3% up to EUR 85,000, 5% on EUR 85,001–170,000, 8% above EUR 170,000 — but NO transfer fee is payable where VAT applies to the purchase, and fees are halved where VAT does not apply. Standard VAT 19%. Materially, a new-build 6(2) purchase pays VAT and no transfer fee. Whether the reduced 5% housing VAT rate can apply to a zero-stay investor is UNVERIFIED (it normally requires the property to be the buyer's primary residence).
entry_tax.text_zh: 土地登記過戶費：8.5 萬歐元以下 3%，8.5 萬至 17 萬歐元 5%，17 萬歐元以上 8%；惟該筆交易若課加值稅則免收過戶費，未課加值稅者過戶費減半。標準加值稅 19%。實務上，第 6(2) 條之新成屋購置課加值稅、免過戶費。至於 5% 住宅優惠稅率是否適用於無居住要求之投資人，未經查證（該優惠通常要求該物件為買方主要住所）。

last_change.text_en: Criteria, 4th Revision, May 2023 — in force 2 May 2023; official page re-posted 29 December 2025. The May 2023 revision also relaxed ongoing obligations: annual proof of income is ABOLISHED and the clean criminal record is now required every three years instead of annually, while annual proof of maintaining the investment and of health insurance remains. Disposing of the investment without immediate like-for-like replacement causes cancellation.
last_change.text_zh: 核准標準第 4 次修訂，2023 年 5 月版，自 2023 年 5 月 2 日施行；官方頁面於 2025 年 12 月 29 日重新張貼。2023 年 5 月修訂並放寬持續義務：取消每年收入證明，無犯罪紀錄證明由每年改為每 3 年一次；維持投資及健康保險之年度證明則保留。處分投資標的而未即時以同等標的替代者，許可撤銷。

short.term_en: Unlimited; the card is replaced at 10 yrs
short.term_zh: 效力無期限；許可證滿 10 年換發
short.stay_en: No quota, but lapses on 1 yr absent after approval or 2 yrs continuous absence
short.stay_zh: 無天數配額；核准後 1 年內未在境內居住，或連續離境滿 2 年，即失效
short.outcome_en: Permanent residence; naturalisation not addressed in the criteria
short.outcome_zh: 永久居留；核定標準未觸及歸化
short.own_en: First sale from a development company; EUR 300,000 excluding VAT
short.own_zh: 須為建設公司首次出售；30 萬歐元且不含加值稅

programmes.notes_en: Income requirement: a personal secured annual income of at least EUR 50,000, increased by EUR 15,000 for a spouse and EUR 10,000 for each dependent minor child. For category 2.1(A) that income must DERIVE FROM ABROAD and is provable only via a tax return from the country of tax residence. Cyprus's separate citizenship-by-investment scheme was abolished with effect from 1 November 2020 (announced 13 October 2020) and is not available. RESOLVED: the widely circulated 'must visit Cyprus once every two years' claim is substantially right but wrongly framed — the word 'visit' appears nowhere in the criteria; the actual rule is that the permit lapses on two years' absence from Cyprus.
programmes.notes_zh: 收入條件：本人須有穩定年收入至少 5 萬歐元，配偶加計 1.5 萬歐元，每名受扶養未成年子女加計 1 萬歐元。2.1(A) 類之收入須來自境外，且僅得以稅務居住國之報稅資料證明。賽普勒斯另一套投資入籍計畫已於 2020 年 11 月 1 日起廢止（2020 年 10 月 13 日宣布），現已不存在。已釐清：坊間流傳「每 2 年須入境一次」大方向正確但表述錯誤——核准標準全文並無「到訪」字樣，實際規則是連續 2 年未入境即失效。

programmes.programme: Malta Permanent Residence Programme (MPRP)
programmes.programme_zh: 馬爾他永久居留計畫（MPRP）

min_value.basis: purchase of qualifying owned property, NATIONWIDE — the former EUR 350,000 Malta / EUR 300,000 Gozo-and-South split has been abolished

extra_tiers.label_en: rental alternative — qualifying rented property, nationwide, per year
government contribution — IDENTICAL for the purchase and the rental route, payable within 8 months of the Letter of Approval in Principle
administrative fee — EUR 15,000 within 1 month of submission plus EUR 45,000 within 2 months of the Letter of Approval in Principle
charitable donation to a registered philanthropic, cultural, scientific, artistic, sport or animal-welfare NGO

minimum assets — EUR 500,000 of which at least EUR 150,000 financial assets, OR the alternative limb of EUR 650,000 of which at least EUR 75,000 financial assets; must be held 5 years from the appointed day
administrative fee per dependant — payable ONLY for adult children and for parents/grandparents; spouse, minor children and disabled adult children pay nothing

term.text_en: Indefinite. The Residence-by-Investment Certificate confers the right to reside, settle or stay in Malta indefinitely and carries no expiry date. The residence CARD is valid 5 years and is renewable (EUR 137.50 per person initially, EUR 27.50 per year on renewal).
term.text_zh: 無限期。投資居留證書賦予在馬爾他無限期居住、定居或停留之權利，證書本身無到期日。居留卡效期 5 年、可續（初次每人 137.50 歐元，續卡每年 27.50 歐元）。

stay.text_en: None. S.L. 217.26 contains no minimum physical-presence provision. (Stated as absence of provision in the tier-1 instrument, not as an affirmative official statement.)
stay.text_zh: 無。S.L. 217.26 全文並無最低實際居留天數之規定。（此係第一級法規中「查無此條」之陳述，而非官方積極表示。）

leads_to.text_en: No automatic path. The certificate confers permanent residence only and, per reg. 10(1)(b), 'shall not, by itself, entitle the holder to any other rights'. Ordinary naturalisation is a separate and DISCRETIONARY process requiring 5 years' continuous residence including the 12 months immediately before application plus 4 of the preceding 6 years, together with language and good-conduct requirements.
leads_to.text_zh: 無自動途徑。該證書僅授予永久居留，依第 10(1)(b) 條規定「本身不賦予持有人任何其他權利」。一般歸化為另一套且屬裁量性之程序，須連續居住 5 年（含申請前緊接之 12 個月，加上其前 6 年中的 4 年），並符合語言及品行要求。

offplan.text_en: Not verified in this sweep.
offplan.text_zh: 本次查核未查證。

mortgage.text_en: Not prohibited. S.L. 217.26 contains no hypothec or mortgage restriction anywhere. The official FAQ answers 'Can the applicant take a loan to buy the qualifying property?' with 'This matter is at the discretion of the Bank.'
mortgage.text_zh: 未禁止。S.L. 217.26 全文並無抵押權或貸款之限制。官方常見問答就「申請人可否貸款購買合格物件」之答覆為「此事由銀行自行裁量」。

dependants.text_en: Spouse (gender-neutral, including civil union and domestic partnership); child under 18; child aged 18–28 who is unmarried and principally dependent; a PARENT OR GRANDPARENT of the applicant or spouse who is not in full-time employment and is principally dependent; and a disabled adult child. Both ascending and adult descending relatives therefore qualify.
dependants.text_zh: 配偶（性別中立，含民事結合與同居伴侶）；18 歲以下子女；18 至 28 歲未婚且主要受扶養之子女；申請人或配偶之父母或祖父母，須未全職就業且主要受扶養；以及身心障礙之成年子女。故直系尊親屬與成年直系卑親屬皆可納入。

entry_tax.text_en: Stamp duty 5%, paid by the buyer on the higher of market price or contract value, with 1% provisional duty payable at promise-of-sale stage (within 21 days). A 15% valuation tolerance applies; penalty duty of 20% plus 0.75% per 30 days runs on assessed shortfalls. The commonly quoted 2% Gozo rate is UNVERIFIED — the official tax authority page makes no mention of it and one tier-3 source claims it reverted to 5%; do not publish a Gozo figure. No official notary fee schedule was located.
entry_tax.text_zh: 印花稅 5%，由買方就市價與契約價之較高者繳納；預售契約階段（21 日內）先繳 1% 暫繳稅。估價容許誤差 15%；核定短漏部分加徵 20% 罰稅並按每 30 日 0.75% 計息。坊間常見之「戈佐島 2%」未經查證——官方稅務機關頁面完全未提及，且有第三級來源稱已回復 5%，故不刊登戈佐島稅率。亦未查得官方公證人費率表。

last_change.text_en: L.N. 146 of 2025, published 22 July 2025, Government Gazette No. 21,472, amending S.L. 217.26 (originally L.N. 121 of 2021, previously amended by L.N. 57 and L.N. 310 of 2024). The consolidated point-in-time text is 22 July 2025. PARTIAL: the text of the amending notice's own commencement/transitional regulation could not be retrieved, so no commencement date distinct from the 22 July 2025 publication date is asserted.
last_change.text_zh: 2025 年第 146 號法律公告，2025 年 7 月 22 日刊登於政府公報第 21,472 號，修正 S.L. 217.26（原為 2021 年第 121 號公告，前經 2024 年第 57 號及第 310 號公告修正）。彙編版本時點為 2025 年 7 月 22 日。部分未證：該修正公告本身之生效／過渡條款原文未能取得，故不主張有別於 2025 年 7 月 22 日刊登日之生效日。

short.term_en: Indefinite; the card is renewed at 5 yrs
short.term_zh: 無期限；居留卡 5 年續期
short.outcome_en: Permanent residence; ordinary naturalisation is separate and discretionary
short.outcome_zh: 永久居留；一般歸化屬另案且為裁量事項
short.own_en: Qualifying owned property nationwide; a rental alternative also exists
short.own_zh: 全國適用之合格自有物件；另設租賃替代方案

programmes.notes_en: DRAFT SWEEP WAS WRONG on three points. (1) The legal citation is S.L. 217.26, not S.L. 217.60. (2) The government contribution is EUR 37,000 flat for BOTH the purchase and the rental route — the EUR 30,000 purchase / EUR 60,000 rent split no longer exists, having been superseded by L.N. 310 of 2024 and L.N. 146 of 2025. (3) The administrative fee is EUR 60,000, not EUR 50,000. The draft also omitted the alternative asset limb (EUR 650,000 including EUR 75,000 financial assets). Property holding period: 5 years from the appointed day, and AFTER those 5 years the holder must still hold a residential property in Malta or Gozo — owned or leased — indefinitely.
programmes.notes_zh: 草稿有三處錯誤。（一）法規編號為 S.L. 217.26，非 S.L. 217.60。（二）政府捐獻為購屋與租屋兩條路徑一律 3.7 萬歐元——「購屋 3 萬／租屋 6 萬」之區分已不存在，經 2024 年第 310 號及 2025 年第 146 號公告取代。（三）行政規費為 6 萬歐元，非 5 萬歐元。草稿亦漏列替代性資產門檻（65 萬歐元，其中 7.5 萬歐元為金融資產）。持有期間：自指定日起 5 年；且該 5 年屆滿後，持有人仍須無限期持有馬爾他或戈佐島之住宅物件（自有或承租皆可）。

programmes.programme: Temporary residence permit for real-estate investment, Immigration Law s. 23(1)(29)
programmes.programme_zh: 不動產投資臨時居留許可（《移民法》第 23 條第 1 項第 29 款）
programmes.label_zh: 不動產投資暫時居留許可

min_value.basis: ONE functionally-linked property in Riga, Jurmala, Ikskile or Saulkrasti city, or Adazi, Kekava, Marupe, Olaine or Salaspils county, or Garkalne, Ropazi, Saulkrasti, Stopini or Tinuzi parish; OR up to TWO properties totalling EUR 250,000 outside those areas. Undeveloped land is excluded in both cases. Additional test: cadastral value at acquisition must be at least EUR 80,000 (or EUR 40,000 each for two properties outside the listed areas); if below, a certified valuer's market value must be at least EUR 250,000 (or EUR 125,000 each).

extra_tiers.label_en: one-off state budget payment on FIRST application — 5% of the property value, non-refundable, credited to the Economic Development Programme
repeat/renewal payment to the state budget, where conditions still hold

term.text_en: Up to 5 years, with COMPULSORY ANNUAL REGISTRATION (s. 22(2): any temporary permit valid longer than one year must be registered every year; state fee EUR 75 at 30 days, EUR 140 at 10 working days, EUR 290 at 5 working days). Renewal available on payment of EUR 5,000; if applied for more than 90 days after expiry, or if the investment object changes, it is treated as a first application and the 5% charge applies again.
term.text_zh: 最長 5 年，並須每年辦理登記（第 22 條第 2 項：效期逾 1 年之臨時居留許可須逐年登記；國家規費 30 日件 75 歐元、10 個工作日件 140 歐元、5 個工作日件 290 歐元）。續期須繳 5,000 歐元；若逾期滿 90 日後才申請，或投資標的變更，視同首次申請，須重新繳納 5% 費用。

stay.text_en: The statute imposes no minimum physical-presence requirement for this ground itself, beyond the annual registration. (Absence of provision, not an affirmative statement.)
stay.text_zh: 除年度登記外，法條就本款並未課予最低實際居留天數要求。（係「查無此條」，非官方積極表示。）

leads_to.text_en: Permanent residence after 5 years' CONTINUOUS RESIDENCE on a temporary permit (s. 24(1)(7)) plus a state language examination (s. 24(5)). Continuity under s. 24(8) means absence not exceeding 6 consecutive months or 12 months in aggregate. Investment permits are not among the excluded categories (s. 24(3) excludes only student and trafficking-victim permits). PRACTICAL CONSEQUENCE: a passive investor who does not actually live in Latvia will not reach permanent residence. Citizenship is governed by the separate Citizenship Law and was not examined.
leads_to.text_zh: 以臨時居留許可連續居住滿 5 年後可申請永久居留（第 24 條第 1 項第 7 款），並須通過國家語言測驗（第 24 條第 5 項）。第 24 條第 8 項所稱連續，指離境未逾連續 6 個月或累計 12 個月。投資類許可不在排除之列（第 24 條第 3 項僅排除學生及人口販運被害人許可）。實務結果：未真正在拉脫維亞居住之被動投資人無法取得永久居留。入籍另依《公民法》規範，本次未查核。

offplan.text_en: Effectively excluded, by reading of the statutory text rather than a cited administrative ruling. The section requires that the applicant 'has acquired and owns' the property, and the cadastral-value test is keyed to the moment of acquisition. An unregistered off-plan unit has neither registered title nor a cadastral value, so it cannot satisfy the section until title is corroborated in the Land Register.
offplan.text_zh: 實質上不可，惟此係就法條文義之解讀，而非引自行政函釋。該款要求申請人「已取得並擁有」該不動產，且地籍價值之檢驗係以取得時點為準。尚未登記之預售單位既無登記所有權亦無地籍價值，須待土地登記簿完成登記後始能符合。

mortgage.text_en: Not prohibited by statute; administrative practice unverified. The section requires only that the full value be paid by NON-CASH settlement, and contains no express prohibition on mortgage financing. No PMLP page or Cabinet regulation confirming practice was reached.
mortgage.text_zh: 法律未禁止，行政實務未查證。該款僅要求全額以非現金方式結算，並無明文禁止貸款融資。未能取得公民及移民事務局（PMLP）頁面或內閣規則以確認實務作法。

dependants.text_en: Spouse; the foreigner's or spouse's minor children, including those under guardianship; and persons under trusteeship — for the same term (s. 23(4)).
dependants.text_zh: 配偶；申請人或配偶之未成年子女（含受監護者）；以及受輔助宣告之人——效期相同（第 23 條第 4 項）。

entry_tax.text_en: Land Register state duty 1.5% of property value for a natural-person buyer and 2% for a legal person, capped at EUR 50,000 in both cases (Cabinet Regulation No. 1250 of 27 Oct 2009, as amended by Cabinet Regulation No. 833 of 14 Dec 2021). Small separate chancellery fees exist; amounts not verified.
entry_tax.text_zh: 土地登記國家規費：自然人買方為不動產價值之 1.5%，法人為 2%，兩者上限均為 5 萬歐元（2009 年 10 月 27 日內閣規則第 1250 號，經 2021 年 12 月 14 日內閣規則第 833 號修正）。另有少額登記處規費，金額未查證。

last_change.text_en: Consolidated Immigration Law in force from 20 May 2026, status 'Speka esoss' (in force), with no repeal date and no pending future version on likumi.lv. SEE NOTES — an abolition has been ADOPTED BUT NOT PROCLAIMED and is not law.
last_change.text_zh: 《移民法》彙編版自 2026 年 5 月 20 日施行，likumi.lv 狀態為「現行有效」，無失效日期，亦無待生效之未來版本。詳見備註——廢止案已表決通過但尚未公布，不具法律效力。

short.term_en: Up to 5 yrs, with compulsory annual registration
short.term_zh: 最長 5 年，須每年辦理登記
short.outcome_en: PR after 5 yrs continuous residence plus a state language examination
short.outcome_zh: 連續居住 5 年並通過國家語言考試後取得永久居留
short.own_en: One linked property in the listed areas, or two elsewhere; no farm or forest land
short.own_zh: 指定區域內功能相連之單一物件，或其他地區兩處合計；不含農地與林地

programmes.notes_en: THE LATVIA ANSWER — the route is OPEN as at 1 August 2026, and the abolition is adopted but NOT PROCLAIMED, so it is not law and has no in-force date. Sequence, from the Saeima's own legislative tracker for bill 56/Lp14 (a wholly new Immigration Law replacing the 2002 Act, not amendments to it): adopted in third reading 11 June 2026; returned by President Rinkevics for repeated review under the Satversme art. 71 procedure on 19 June 2026 by letter No. 228, the same day the spring session closed; REFERRED TO COMMITTEE at an extraordinary sitting on 23 July 2026 (Defence, Internal Affairs and Corruption Prevention Committee, rapporteur Raimonds Bergmanis) — it was NOT re-adopted; amendment deadline 28 July 2026; consideration scheduled for 20 August 2026; autumn session opens 31 August 2026. The tracker's 'Izsludinats' (proclaimed) field is BLANK — the law was never proclaimed or published in Latvijas Vestnesis. Cross-checked against likumi.lv, which shows the 2002 Act still in force with no repeal date. No art. 72 referendum suspension applies; this is the art. 71 return-for-reconsideration route. THE OUTCOME IS GENUINELY OPEN, NOT MERELY DELAYED: in letter No. 228 the President invited the Saeima to consider RE-INTRODUCING a real-estate route restricted to citizens of NATO, OECD and EEA states and possibly other Cabinet-listed friendly states, noting he had received a similar request from the largest real-estate industry representatives. His principal objection was to the replacement fund route (draft art. 27(1)(36): EUR 150,000 into a state-established alternative investment fund for 5 years plus EUR 10,000 to the state budget) on source-of-funds verification grounds and incomplete cross-referencing of the Russia/Belarus exclusions. DRAFT SWEEP WAS WRONG on the section number: the real-estate ground is s. 23(1)(29), not s. 23(1)(3). ALSO: Russian and Belarusian citizens are EXCLUDED — s. 23.1(1) limits them to s. 23(3), (6), (7) and s. 23.1 grounds, and 23(1)(29) is not among them. Other statutory conditions: no property-tax arrears; the seller must be a legal person registered in Latvia, the EU, the EEA or Switzerland that is a Latvian taxpayer, or a natural person who is a Latvian citizen, a Latvian non-citizen, an EU citizen or a foreigner holding a valid Latvian residence permit; no agricultural or forest land may be included. The Cabinet must review the practical operation of the scheme at least annually (s. 38(2)). TIER-3 SOURCES ARE ACTIVELY WRONG ON THIS: at least one immigration blog dated 16 July 2026 states the EUR 250,000 route was 'eliminated' by the June vote, conflating Saeima adoption with entry into force. WATCH 20 AUGUST 2026.
programmes.notes_zh: 拉脫維亞結論——截至 2026 年 8 月 1 日該途徑仍開放；廢止法案雖已表決通過但尚未公布，故不具法律效力，亦無生效日。依國會（Saeima）第 56/Lp14 號法案（係取代 2002 年法之全新《移民法》，非修正案）之立法追蹤紀錄：2026 年 6 月 11 日三讀通過；2026 年 6 月 19 日總統林克維奇斯依《憲法》第 71 條程序以第 228 號函退回覆議，同日春季會期結束；2026 年 7 月 23 日臨時會將該法案交付委員會（國防、內政及防貪委員會，報告人 Raimonds Bergmanis），並未再次表決通過；修正案截止日為 2026 年 7 月 28 日；審議定於 2026 年 8 月 20 日；秋季會期於 2026 年 8 月 31 日開議。追蹤表之「已公布」欄位為空白——該法從未公布，亦未刊登於《拉脫維亞公報》。並以 likumi.lv 交叉查核，2002 年法仍為現行有效且無失效日期。本案不涉《憲法》第 72 條之公投停止效力程序，而係第 71 條退回覆議。結果確實仍未定，並非單純延後：總統於第 228 號函中請國會考慮重新引入不動產途徑，惟限於北約、經合組織及歐洲經濟區會員國公民，並可能及於內閣列表之其他友好國家公民，並敘明其亦收到不動產業界主要代表之相同陳請。其主要反對意見針對替代之基金途徑（草案第 27 條第 1 項第 36 款：投入國家設立之另類投資基金 15 萬歐元並持有 5 年，另繳 1 萬歐元予國庫），理由為資金來源查核，以及俄羅斯／白俄羅斯排除條款之交互引用不完整。草稿之條號有誤：不動產款項為第 23 條第 1 項第 29 款，非第 3 款。另：俄羅斯與白俄羅斯公民被排除——第 23.1 條第 1 項將其限於第 23 條第 3、6、7 項及第 23.1 條各款，第 23 條第 1 項第 29 款不在其中。其他法定條件：不得有不動產稅欠繳；賣方須為在拉脫維亞、歐盟、歐洲經濟區或瑞士登記且為拉脫維亞納稅義務人之法人，或為拉脫維亞公民、拉脫維亞非公民、歐盟公民或持有效拉脫維亞居留許可之外國人之自然人；不得包含農地或林地。內閣須至少每年檢討本制度之實際運作（第 38 條第 2 項）。第三級來源在此議題上明確錯誤：至少一家移民部落格於 2026 年 7 月 16 日聲稱 25 萬歐元途徑已於 6 月表決「取消」，係將國會通過與生效混為一談。請留意 2026 年 8 月 20 日。

programmes.programme: Temporary residence for the use and disposition of owned real property, Law on Foreigners art. 56
programmes.programme_zh: 以所有之不動產使用及處分為由之臨時居留（《外國人法》第 56 條）

min_value.basis: measured on the TAX-ASSESSMENT BASE, not the purchase price — specifically the taxable base stated in the municipal tax authority's real-estate transfer tax assessment decision (rjesenje o utvrdivanju poreza na promet nepokretnosti), which must be not less than EUR 150,000

term.text_en: Issued for up to ONE year (Law on Foreigners art. 63). Renewal must be applied for in person at the Ministry no later than 30 days before expiry (art. 64).
term.text_zh: 核發效期最長 1 年（《外國人法》第 63 條）。續期須於屆期前 30 日內親自向內政部提出申請（第 64 條）。

stay.text_en: Not established in this sweep.
stay.text_zh: 本次查核未查證。

leads_to.text_en: UNRESOLVED — do not publish either answer. Whether time held on the art. 56 property permit counts toward the qualifying period for permanent residence (stalno nastanjenje) could not be verified in either direction; the base law is published only as rasterised page images with no text layer or search, and the permanent-residence chapter could not be located within budget. One tier-3 source claims the time does NOT count; that claim is neither confirmed nor refuted. One adjacent tier-1 data point: art. 83 item 12 lists 'when the foreigner acquires the right to permanent residence' as a ground on which a temporary permit ceases, implying the two are sequential but saying nothing about countability.
leads_to.text_zh: 未解決，兩種說法皆不可刊登。持有第 56 條不動產居留許可之期間是否計入永久居留（stalno nastanjenje）之資格年限，正反皆無法查證；母法僅以掃描頁面影像公布，無文字層亦無法檢索，永久居留章節在預算內未能定位。有一第三級來源稱不計入，該說法既未證實亦未推翻。一項相關之第一級資料：第 83 條第 12 款將「外國人取得永久居留權時」列為臨時居留許可終止事由，顯示兩者係先後關係，但未說明年限是否採計。

offplan.text_en: Not established. The evidentiary test is a municipal tax assessment decision on a completed transfer, which implies registered ownership.
offplan.text_zh: 未查證。舉證方式為就已完成移轉所核發之市政稅務核定書，隱含須已登記所有權。

mortgage.text_en: Not established in this sweep.
mortgage.text_zh: 本次查核未查證。

dependants.text_en: Not established in this sweep.

entry_tax.text_en: Real-estate transfer tax is PROGRESSIVE 3% to 6% (the frequently quoted flat 3% is outdated). Standard VAT 21% applies to new-build supplied by a taxable person.

programmes.notes_en: CONFLICT RESOLVED: the circulating '9 January' and '17 January' dates are both real and refer to different things — 9 January 2026 is the gazette publication date, 17 January 2026 is entry into force (publication plus eight days per art. 92). The EUR 150,000 rule is art. 24 of the amending law, inserting new paragraphs into art. 56 of the Law on Foreigners. EXEMPTION, and it is broader than tier-3 reporting suggested: the obligation to produce proof of value does not apply to citizens of EU member states OR THEIR FAMILY MEMBERS REGARDLESS OF THOSE FAMILY MEMBERS' OWN NATIONALITY, nor to citizens of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland. GRANDFATHERING, and it is stronger than reported: new art. 217b provides that for a foreigner issued a property-based temporary residence permit BEFORE entry into force, a RENEWAL application filed AFTER entry into force is still decided under the previous Law on Foreigners (Sl. list CG 12/18, 3/19, 86/22, 77/24) — so it is not merely the original grant that is protected. Art. 218a preserves the validity of already-issued permits to their stated expiry. Qualifying property types under the base art. 56: family houses, holiday houses, villas, apartments, hospitality premises, mixed residential-commercial buildings and business premises. Montenegro's citizenship-by-investment programme ended 31 December 2022 (tier-3 only; not independently confirmed here). METHOD NOTE: sluzbenilist.me returns 403 to automated fetchers but loads in a real browser, and serves statutory text ONLY as rasterised page images with no text layer, no PDF and no full-text search — the findings above were read visually off those images.
programmes.notes_zh: 衝突已釐清：坊間流傳的 1 月 9 日與 1 月 17 日皆屬實，但指涉不同事項——2026 年 1 月 9 日為公報刊登日，2026 年 1 月 17 日為生效日（依第 92 條，刊登後第 8 日生效）。15 萬歐元規定係修正法第 24 條，於《外國人法》第 56 條增訂數項。豁免範圍較第三級報導所稱更寬：提出價值證明之義務不適用於歐盟會員國公民，亦不適用於其家庭成員（不論該家庭成員本身國籍為何），並不適用於冰島、列支敦斯登、挪威及瑞士公民。既得保障亦較外界所知更強：新增第 217b 條規定，生效前已取得不動產類臨時居留許可之外國人，其於生效後提出之續期申請，仍依修正前之《外國人法》（政府公報 12/18、3/19、86/22、77/24）辦理——受保障者不限於原始核發。第 218a 條並保留已核發許可至其所載屆期日之效力。母法第 56 條之合格不動產類型：家庭住宅、度假屋、別墅、公寓、餐旅場所、住商混合建物及營業場所。蒙特內哥羅之投資入籍計畫於 2022 年 12 月 31 日結束（僅第三級來源，本次未獨立查證）。方法備註：sluzbenilist.me 對自動抓取回應 403，惟以真實瀏覽器可正常載入；其法條僅以掃描頁面影像提供，無文字層、無 PDF、亦無全文檢索，上述內容係以肉眼判讀影像取得。

min_value.basis: NO PUBLISHED MINIMUM. The statute sets no monetary threshold; art. 31(6), added on 21 November 2024 by Law No. 7533, provides that 'the nature and value of the immovable property forming the basis for granting a short-term residence permit shall be determined by the MINISTRY'. The widely quoted USD 200,000 is therefore an administrative figure set by internal circular, not a statutory one — and it could not be found on any official page. The Presidency of Migration Management's own residence-permit-types page enumerates the property ground and states no monetary threshold at all; a site-restricted search for '200.000' and 'ABD doları' returned zero results. DO NOT PUBLISH USD 200,000.

term.text_en: Up to TWO years per grant — art. 31(2): 'her defasında en fazla ikişer yıllık sürelerle' (each time for periods of at most two years).

programmes.notes_en: DRAFT SWEEP CITED THE WRONG ARTICLE: it gives art. 31(1)(f), which is the MEDICAL TREATMENT ground. The property ground is art. 31(1)(b) — 'Turkiye'de tasinmaz mali bulunanlar'. Confidence is medium solely because the threshold could not be established; the route's existence, term, dependants rule and dwelling-use condition are all tier-1. The property must be a dwelling and must be used as one — not land, not commercial premises. NOT VERIFIED, and therefore not published: the 'closed neighbourhood' rule under which districts where the foreign resident share exceeds a threshold percentage are closed to new residence permits. The commonly cited 20% figure appears on no official page reached; the rule's current percentage and whether it is still operating are both unverified. Omission is preferred to the 20% figure.

programmes.programme: Temporary residence on the basis of ownership of immovable property, Law on Foreigners art. 54
programmes.programme_zh: 以不動產所有權為由之臨時居留（《外國人法》第 54 條）

min_value.basis: NO MINIMUM VALUE. Art. 54 imposes an ownership and use test, not a value test: the property must be a residential building or apartment in which the foreigner resides. Confirmed absent from the statutory text.

term.text_en: Up to THREE years, renewable for the same period — art. 44(1): 'Privremeni boravak moze se odobriti u trajanju do tri godine i moze se produzavati na isti period'.
term.text_zh: 最長 3 年，並得就同一期間續期——第 44 條第 1 項：「臨時居留得核准至 3 年，並得就同一期間延長」。

stay.text_en: Art. 54 requires that the property be one 'in which the foreigner resides', so actual occupation is part of the ground itself. No separate day-count was established.
stay.text_zh: 第 54 條要求該不動產須為「外國人所居住者」，故實際居住本身即為事由之一部。未另查得具體天數規定。

leads_to.text_en: Permanent residence after 3 years' continuous temporary residence — art. 67(2), reduced from 5 years by the 2023 amendment; tolerance is 10 months' absence in total or 6 months in a single absence. CAUTION: the Citizenship Law separately requires 3 years of registered residence (prebivaliste) under art. 14(1)(3), and whether that clock runs concurrently with or after the permanent-residence qualifying period is unclear — DO NOT publish a clean '6 years to citizenship' total.
leads_to.text_zh: 連續臨時居留滿 3 年後可申請永久居留——第 67 條第 2 項，2023 年修法由 5 年縮短為 3 年；離境容許為累計 10 個月或單次 6 個月。注意：《公民法》第 14 條第 1 項第 3 款另要求 3 年之設籍居住（prebivaliste），該年限與永久居留資格年限係併行或接續尚不明確，不得刊登「6 年入籍」之簡化總計。

offplan.text_en: Not established. The requirement that the foreigner reside in the property implies a completed, habitable dwelling.
offplan.text_zh: 未查證。要求外國人須居住於該不動產，隱含須為已完工可居住之住宅。

mortgage.text_en: Not established in this sweep.
mortgage.text_zh: 本次查核未查證。

dependants.text_en: Not established in this sweep.
dependants.text_zh: 本次查核未查證。

programmes.notes_en: REFRAMED, NOT A RESIDENCY-BY-INVESTMENT PRODUCT. Three traps to avoid, all of which circulate widely. (1) The frequently repeated 'three properties' allowance is a RECIPROCITY-ONLY exception available to nationals of states that recognise the TRNC — functionally Turkish nationals only. It is not a general foreigner allowance. (2) The EUR 50,000 figure circulating online is a PRE-PURCHASE ENTRY-VISA FUNDS TEST under art. 9(1)(a)(c) of the residence regulation, not a property threshold. (3) The transfer and VAT rates in agency material could not be traced to official sources. IMPORTANT CONTEXT FOR ANY READER: the TRNC is recognised only by Turkey; its documents have no international standing, and title to property in northern Cyprus may be subject to competing claims by displaced pre-1974 owners, with judgments enforceable in EU member states. Confidence is medium because the route's core parameters are tier-1 but its practical characterisation, taxes and onward path are not established.
programmes.notes_zh: 已重新定性，並非投資移民產品。三個廣為流傳的陷阱：（一）常見的「可購三戶」係僅適用於承認北賽政權國家之國民的對等待遇例外，實務上僅土耳其國民適用，並非一般外國人之額度。（二）網路流傳之 5 萬歐元係居留規則第 9 條第 1 項第 a 款第 c 目之購置前入境簽證財力證明，並非不動產門檻。（三）仲介資料所載之移轉稅與加值稅率無法追溯至官方出處。讀者須知之重要背景：北賽政權僅獲土耳其承認，其文件不具國際效力；北賽不動產產權可能面臨 1974 年前流離原所有權人之權利主張，且相關判決在歐盟會員國具可執行性。信心度列為中等，係因該途徑之核心規範屬第一級來源，惟其實務定性、稅負與後續途徑均未確立。

programmes.notes_en: DRAFT SWEEP'S FRAMING WAS WRONG, and materially so. AZN 100,000 and AZN 200,000 are NOT two tiers of temporary residence. AZN 100,000 is the TEMPORARY residence threshold; AZN 200,000 is the PERMANENT residence threshold and additionally requires two years of prior temporary residence. Presenting them as parallel temporary tiers would mislead. Unresolved: whether the AZN 100,000 property ground and a same-value bank-deposit ground are the same Migration Code clause or distinct ones. The manat has been pegged at approximately 1.70 AZN to the US dollar since 2017 (tier 2/3 — cbar.az was unreachable), so the USD figures here carry that additional caveat.

programmes.notes_en: DISPUTE RESOLVED: the route DOES exist and the EUR 40,000 figure is correct and statutory — but the draft sweep was materially incomplete in two ways that change the entire proposition, and publishing the EUR 40,000 without both qualifiers would be misleading. (1) IT IS CLOSED TO MOST NATIONALITIES: eligibility is gated to citizens of an EU member state or of the OECD. A buyer from outside that set cannot use this route at any price. Note a drafting shift worth flagging: the pre-2018 law said 'resident of an EU member state AND the OECD'; the current law says 'citizen of an EU member state OR the OECD'. (2) IT IS A STATUTORY DEAD END for permanent residence, by express exclusion. General conditions under art. 72 also apply: subsistence means, accommodation, health insurance, no public-order threat, no unconditional sentence exceeding six months, no pending criminal proceedings. TWO CAVEATS. The phrase 'under conditions established by law' in art. 119(1) subordinates the purchase to North Macedonia's property-ownership law, which applies reciprocity conditions to foreign buyers and generally bars agricultural land; that was not separately verified. And the Ministry of Interior's own published service-checklist page lists categories for marriage, employment, permanent residence, family reunification and study but displays NO property-ownership category, so practical uptake is uncertain. SEPARATELY EXCLUDED: North Macedonia's citizenship-by-investment route under art. 11 of the Citizenship Law is a national-interest/economic route with NO monetary figure in the statute — art. 11(2) delegates the criteria to a government decree that was not obtained. The circulating EUR 200,000 investment, 10 jobs and 1,000-person cap figures are not published here; see the excluded list.
programmes.notes_zh: 爭議已釐清：該途徑確實存在，4 萬歐元亦屬正確且有法源——惟草稿有兩項實質遺漏足以翻轉整體判斷，若刊登 4 萬歐元而不併同兩項限制，將構成誤導。（一）對多數國籍封閉：資格限於歐盟會員國或經合組織國家之公民，此範圍以外之買方無論出價多少均無法適用。另有一處值得注意的條文變動：2018 年前之法律為「歐盟會員國『與』經合組織之居民」，現行法為「歐盟會員國『或』經合組織之公民」。（二）就永久居留而言為法定死路，經明文排除。第 72 條之一般要件亦適用：生活費用、住所、健康保險、無危害公共秩序之虞、無逾 6 個月之不附條件宣告刑、無繫屬中之刑事程序。兩項保留：第 119 條第 1 項所稱「依法律所定條件」使該購置從屬於北馬其頓之不動產所有權法，該法對外國買方設有對等待遇條件並原則禁止農地，本次未另行查證；另內政部自行公布之業務文件清單頁面列有結婚、就業、永久居留、家庭團聚與就學等類別，卻未見不動產所有權類別，故實際使用情形不明。另行排除：北馬其頓依《公民法》第 11 條之投資入籍途徑係國家利益／經濟事由，法條並無任何金額，第 11 條第 2 項將條件授權政府命令訂定，而該命令未能取得。坊間流傳之 20 萬歐元投資、創造 10 個就業機會、上限 1,000 人等數字不予刊登，詳見排除清單。

programmes.programme: Residence permit for owners of immovable property, Law no. 79/2021 'On Foreigners' art. 84
programmes.programme_zh: 不動產所有人居留許可（第 79/2021 號《外國人法》第 84 條）
programmes.label_zh: 業主居留許可（第 84 條）

min_value.basis: NO MINIMUM VALUE IN THE LAW. Art. 84 imposes an OWNERSHIP test, not a value test: the applicant must prove ownership of the immovable property, with ownership lasting throughout the duration of the permit. Co-ownership of one half suffices (art. 84(3)). All three figures circulating in agency material — EUR 50,000, ALL 5,000,000, and unspecified others — have no basis in the primary legislation. CAVEAT: art. 84(4) delegates the procedures and criteria to a Council of Ministers Decision (VKM), and that VKM could not be located; a decision-level threshold therefore cannot be positively excluded.

term.text_en: Up to 1 year on first issue, renewable every year while the foreigner continues to meet the criteria set by law (art. 84(2)).
term.text_zh: 初次核發最長 1 年，於持續符合法定條件之期間內得逐年續期（第 84 條第 2 項）。

stay.text_en: Not specified for the permit itself. Note the permanent-residence rule below implies limits on absence only at that later stage.
stay.text_zh: 本許可本身未規定。下述永久居留規則之離境限制僅適用於該後續階段。

leads_to.text_en: PERMANENT RESIDENCE after 5 years' continuous legal residence (art. 87), with absence of up to 6 months at a time and a maximum of 10 months in total across the five years. Also requires sufficient lawful income, health insurance, adequate housing and proof that all taxes are paid. The art. 88 exclusion list does NOT include the property permit, so this route DOES accrue toward permanent residence. The permanent residence card is automatically replaced every 7 years and expiry does not cancel long-term-resident status. Citizenship is governed by the separate Law on Citizenship and was NOT tier-1 verified — no naturalisation timeline is published here.

programmes.notes_en: DISPUTE RESOLVED, AND THE ANSWER IS THAT THE THRESHOLD IS A FICTION. All three circulating figures are wrong because the law specifies no minimum value at all. The EUR 50,000 figure propagating through agency material has no basis in Law no. 79/2021. The route itself is genuine, and — unlike North Macedonia's — it DOES count toward permanent residence at five years. Confidence is medium, not high, for one honest reason: art. 84(4) delegates the procedures and criteria to a Council of Ministers Decision that could not be located, so while no threshold exists in the PRIMARY legislation, a decision-level threshold cannot be positively excluded. The correct published line is 'no statutory minimum; implementing decision not located'. GOLDEN PASSPORT: Albania's much-publicised citizenship-by-investment proposal, drafted around 2020–21, NEVER BECAME LAW — it met sustained EU objection and was suspended, and no active scheme exists today. That claim is a negative and rests on tier-2/3 sources, which is the safe direction to state it.

entry_tax.text_en: CONFLICT — publish the range, not a band table. The tax on foreign real-estate investment (impost sobre la inversio estrangera immobiliaria) exists under Llei 3/2024 plus Decret 76/2024, and the Government's own headline states it is 'un impost d'entre el 3 i el 10%' (a tax of between 3 and 10%). But the sources disagree on the scale: the tier-1 statute (Llei 3/2024 art. 8) reads as 6% for a single-family home or one residential unit with up to three parking spaces and 10% for everything else, whereas tier-2/3 commentary gives a progressive band table of 3% for a first property, 5% for two to five, 8% for six to nine, and 10% for ten or more or for development projects. Both agree on a 90% reduction for property committed to long-term rental, with a 10-year minimum hold and clawback with interest on early sale. FURTHER LIVE RISK: the Government has published a proposal to DOUBLE this tax, so any rate published now may be stale within months.

DRAFT SWEEP WAS WRONG ON TWO POINTS: (1) GBP 145,000 is the SUPERSEDED minimum annual tax — the current figure for new approvals is GBP 250,000; (2) the 'GBP 1.25 million sustainable annual income' framing is a mischaracterisation — GBP 1.25 million is the income band boundary at which the rate drops from 20% to 1%, not an eligibility test. The actual eligibility test is the GBP 10 million asset wealth test. CAVEAT THAT DRIVES THE MEDIUM RATING: the Locate Jersey supplementary sheet carrying the GBP 3.5 million / GBP 1.75 million property thresholds is stamped 'Information accurate as at 1 July 2023' and states that all rates are subject to annual review. programmes.programme: Extension of stay for the purpose of investment — THB 3m real-estate route (Immigration Bureau Orders 237/2568 and 238/2568)
programmes.programme_zh: 以投資為目的之居留延期——300 萬泰銖不動產途徑（入出境事務局第 237/2568、238/2568 號命令）
programmes.label_en: Investment extension of stay: the THB 3m limb
programmes.label_zh: 投資型延長居留：300 萬泰銖分項

min_value.basis: Purchase of a condominium unit at a registered purchase price of not less than THB 3,000,000, AND a certification-and-request letter from the Ministry of Tourism and Sports (or its delegate) certifying the applicant as a long-stay tourism supporter. The MOTS letter is a mandatory, non-severable element of this tier at BOTH the visa stage (Order 237/2568 item 3.2(2)) and the extension stage (Order 238/2568 item 2.5.C(3)). Without it this tier is unavailable.

extra_tiers.label_en: General investment tier requiring NO Ministry of Tourism and Sports certificate. Satisfied by purchase OR lease of not less than 3 years of a condominium unit at not less than THB 10,000,000, or by fixed deposit / government or state-enterprise bonds at the same figure, or a combination. Requires evidence of transfer of not less than THB 10,000,000 into Thailand. Order 237/2568 item 3.1; Order 238/2568 item 2.5.B.

CLOSED LEGACY TIER — not available to new applicants. Order 238/2568 item 2.5.A(2) restricts this THB 3,000,000 tier to aliens who 'entered the Kingdom before 1 October B.E. 2549 (2006) and have been continuously permitted to stay for investment of not less than 3 million baht'. Grandfathered holders only.

term.text_en: Extension of stay granted in periods of not more than one year at a time, renewable while conditions are maintained ('permit granted each time not exceeding 1 year').
term.text_zh: 每次核給不超過一年之居留延期，條件維持期間可續延。

stay.text_en: No minimum physical-presence requirement is stated in either Order. Standard Thai immigration obligations apply (90-day address reporting; re-entry permit needed to preserve the extension when leaving).
stay.text_zh: 兩項命令均未規定最低實際居住天數。仍適用泰國一般入出境義務（90 天居留通報；出境須辦再入境許可以保留延期效力）。

leads_to.text_en: No pathway to permanent residence or citizenship arises from this route as such. Thai permanent residence is a separate annual-quota system under the Immigration Act B.E. 2522 with its own criteria; nothing in Orders 237/2568 or 238/2568 confers or accelerates it.
leads_to.text_zh: 本途徑本身不通往永久居留或公民身分。泰國永久居留係《1979 年入出境法》下另設之年度配額制度，第 237/2568、238/2568 號命令均未賦予或加速該資格。

ownership_form.text_en: Condominium unit freehold only; no land. Foreigners in aggregate may hold not more than 49% of the space of the whole units in any one condominium (Condominium Act B.E. 2522 s.19 bis). Orders 237/2568 and 238/2568 both cross-refer to 'the law on condominiums and the holding of ownership of condominium units by aliens' in the documentary schedule.
ownership_form.text_zh: 僅限區分所有權（公寓大廈）之完全所有權，不含土地。同一棟公寓大廈之外國人持有面積合計不得超過全部專有部分之 49%（《佛曆 2522 年公寓大廈法》第 19 條之 1）。第 237/2568 與 238/2568 號命令之文件清單均援引「公寓大廈法及外國人區分所有權之持有」。

offplan.text_en: Effectively excluded. The documentary schedule requires a registered condominium ownership document in the applicant's own name — 'copy of the registration showing ownership of the condominium unit, or the title deed, or the condominium unit ownership certificate under the land law, the condominium law and the law on foreign ownership of condominium units' — plus a photograph of the unit. An off-plan unit has no registered title until handover and so cannot satisfy this. Note this is a consequence of the documentary requirement; neither Order contains an express words-of-exclusion for off-plan.
offplan.text_zh: 實質上排除。文件清單要求申請人本人名下之已登記區分所有權文件（區分所有權登記謄本、所有權狀或依土地法、公寓大廈法及外國人區分所有權法核發之權利證明），並須檢附房屋照片。預售屋於交屋前無登記所有權，故無法滿足。此為文件要件之結果，兩項命令均未明文排除預售屋。

mortgage.text_en: Not addressed in either Order. The Orders require evidence of transfer of the qualifying sum into Thailand from abroad and evidence of payment for the unit; a domestic mortgage would not evidence inward transfer. Treat as unresolved rather than permitted.
mortgage.text_zh: 兩項命令均未規範。命令要求檢附自海外匯入合格金額之證明及購屋付款證明；本地房貸無法證明資金匯入。應視為未定，不得逕認為許可。

dependants.text_en: Yes, under Order 238/2568 item 2.20, granted in periods of not more than one year at a time. Spouse (relationship must be genuine in both law and fact); children, adopted children or stepchildren who are unmarried, living as part of the household and not over 20 years of age (unless ill or disabled and unable to support themselves); and parents aged 50 or over. Where the principal holds the THB 3m real-estate tier, each family member ALSO needs a Ministry of Tourism and Sports certification letter confirming they are family of the long-stay tourism supporter.
dependants.text_zh: 可攜眷。依第 238/2568 號命令第 2.20 項，每次核給不超過一年。配偶（法律與事實上均須為真實關係）；未婚、同住且未滿 20 歲之子女、養子女或配偶之子女（因病或身心障礙而無法自立者不在此限）；以及年滿 50 歲之父母。主申請人若走 300 萬泰銖不動產途徑，各眷屬另須取得觀光暨體育部證明信，確認其為長期旅遊支持者之家屬。

entry_tax.text_en: NOT VERIFIED in this pass. Thai transfer taxes on a condominium conveyance (transfer fee, specific business tax or stamp duty, withholding tax) were not checked against a Revenue Department or Land Department source and are omitted rather than estimated.
entry_tax.text_zh: 本次未查證。區分所有權移轉之泰國稅費（過戶費、特種營業稅或印花稅、預扣稅）未經稅務廳或土地廳來源查證，故從缺，不作推估。

short.term_zh: 每次核給 1 年，條件維持即可續期

short.stay_zh: 未設；在泰期間適用 90 天住所申報

programmes.notes_en: THE TWO-TIER QUESTION IS RESOLVED, AND THE DRAFT WAS WRONG IN THREE PLACES. (1) The claim that THB 3,000,000 alone buys a renewable extension is wrong: for anyone who entered Thailand on or after 1 October 2006, the THB 3m figure is available ONLY with a Ministry of Tourism and Sports certification-and-request letter. Without that letter the operative threshold is THB 10,000,000. This is not an administrative gloss — the MOTS letter is a numbered condition in the criteria column of both Orders, and it also appears as a required document. (2) There is in fact a THIRD tier, not two: a closed legacy THB 3m tier restricted to aliens who entered before 1 October 2006 and have held the investment extension continuously since. (3) The draft's 'seller must be Thai or 49%-or-less foreign-owned' does not exist for the purchase route. That condition appears only for the LESSOR under the lease alternative ('the owner of the condominium unit or residential house, being a Thai natural person or a juristic person with Thai nationals holding more than 50 per cent of shares, as the lessor') and for the BANK under the fixed-deposit alternative. It was misattributed to the seller in a purchase. ALSO CORRECTED: the draft's visa class 'Non-Immigrant B' is not supported. Both Orders require only that the applicant already hold a Non-Immigrant visa of some class and describe the grant as an extension of stay for investment under Section 34 of the Immigration Act B.E. 2522; no sub-code is stated in the operative text and none is published here. LEASE ALTERNATIVE (verified, for completeness): the THB 3m real-estate tier can alternatively be met by leasing a condominium unit or residential house at not less than THB 85,000/month — at the visa stage a lease of not less than 1 year with at least 3 months paid in advance, at the extension stage at least 12 months paid in advance, or a registered lease of over 3 years with aggregate advance rent of not less than THB 3,000,000. OPEN ITEM: whether the Ministry of Tourism and Sports has published the procedure, delegate list, or fee for issuing the certification letter is NOT verified. Until that is confirmed, the practical availability of the THB 3m tier is unestablished even though its legal basis is now certain.
programmes.notes_zh: 兩級結構已釐清，草稿有三處錯誤。(1)「300 萬泰銖即可取得可續延之居留」為錯誤：凡 2006 年 10 月 1 日以後入境者，300 萬泰銖僅在取得觀光暨體育部證明暨請求函時方可適用；無該函者，實際門檻為 1,000 萬泰銖。此非行政慣例，該函在兩項命令之審查基準欄均為列號要件，並同時列為應備文件。(2) 實為三級而非兩級：另有一封閉之 300 萬泰銖舊制級距，僅限 2006 年 10 月 1 日前入境且持續持有投資居留者。(3) 草稿所稱「賣方須為泰國人或外資不超過 49%」在購買途徑並不存在。該條件僅出現於租賃途徑之「出租人」（須為泰國自然人或泰國人持股逾 50% 之法人）及定存途徑之「銀行」，草稿誤植於購買之賣方。另更正：草稿之「Non-Immigrant B」簽證類別無據。兩項命令僅要求申請人已持有某類非移民簽證，並將核給描述為《佛曆 2522 年入出境法》第 34 條下以投資為目的之居留延期；條文未載子代碼，本資料集亦不刊載。租賃替代方案（已查證，供完整參考）：300 萬泰銖不動產級距亦可以每月不低於 85,000 泰銖租賃區分所有權房屋或住宅滿足——簽證階段為期不低於 1 年之租約並預付至少 3 個月，居留延期階段須預付至少 12 個月，或登記逾 3 年之租約且預付租金合計不低於 300 萬泰銖。未決事項：觀光暨體育部是否已公布該證明函之核發程序、受委任機構名單或規費，本次未查證。在此確認前，300 萬泰銖級距之法律依據雖已確定，實務可行性仍屬未定。

programmes.programme: Long-Term Resident (LTR) visa — Wealthy Global Citizen category
programmes.programme_zh: 長期居留（LTR）簽證——高資產全球公民類別
programmes.label_zh: 長期居留 LTR：高資產全球公民

min_value.basis: Investment in Thailand of at least USD 500,000 in the applicant's own name, which may be in one or a combination of: Thai government bonds with at least 5 years' remaining maturity; direct investment in companies registered in Thailand; or investment in Thai property. Property is a qualifying asset class within this figure and carries no separate property-specific minimum. The investment must already have been made before applying.

term.text_en: 10 years: 'Permission will be granted to stay in Thailand the first time for five years which can be extended for 5 more years if qualifications are met.'
term.text_zh: 10 年：首次核給 5 年，符合資格者可再延長 5 年。

stay.text_en: No minimum physical-presence requirement stated. LTR holders are exempt from the standard 90-day reporting in favour of annual reporting (not re-verified in this pass — omitted from publication).
stay.text_zh: 未規定最低居住天數。LTR 持有人免除一般 90 天通報而改為年度通報（本次未複查，不予刊載）。

leads_to.text_en: No pathway to permanent residence or citizenship. The LTR is a renewable long-stay visa only.
leads_to.text_zh: 不通往永久居留或公民身分。LTR 僅為可續延之長期居留簽證。

ownership_form.text_en: Condominium unit freehold only; no land. Foreigners in aggregate may hold not more than 49% of the space of the whole units in any one condominium (Condominium Act B.E. 2522 s.19 bis).
ownership_form.text_zh: 僅限區分所有權之完全所有權，不含土地。同一棟公寓大廈之外國人持有面積合計不得超過全部專有部分之 49%（《佛曆 2522 年公寓大廈法》第 19 條之 1）。

offplan.text_en: NOT VERIFIED. The BOI page states only 'investment in Thai property' without defining completion status. Omitted rather than inferred.
offplan.text_zh: 未查證。BOI 頁面僅載「投資泰國不動產」，未界定完工狀態。從缺，不作推論。

mortgage.text_en: NOT VERIFIED.
mortgage.text_zh: 未查證。

dependants.text_en: Yes — spouse and dependants are eligible. Visa fee THB 50,000 per person for the 10-year multiple-entry visa when collected in Thailand.
dependants.text_zh: 可攜眷——配偶及受扶養人符合資格。10 年多次入境簽證於泰國境內領取者，每人簽證費 50,000 泰銖。

entry_tax.text_en: NOT VERIFIED for the property purchase itself. IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the widely-quoted 17% flat personal income tax applies to the HIGHLY-SKILLED PROFESSIONALS category only ('17% Personal income tax for Highly-skilled professionals'), NOT to Wealthy Global Citizen. Do not attach it to this route.
entry_tax.text_zh: 購置本身之稅負未查證。重要更正：常被引用之 17% 個人所得稅單一稅率僅適用「高技術專業人才」類別，不適用高資產全球公民類別，不得掛用於本途徑。

last_change.text_en: The current BOI page shows no personal-income requirement for this category, unlike the Highly-Skilled panel which retains a USD 80,000/yr test — consistent with a revision that removed the INCOME test. The USD 1 million assets requirement was NOT removed and remains the category's defining heading. The date and scope of the amending announcement could not be located and are NOT verified; the current requirements are stated, the amendment is not narrated.
last_change.text_zh: 現行 BOI 頁面就本類別未列個人所得要件，與仍保留每年 8 萬美元門檻之高技術專業人才類別不同，與「移除所得要件」之修訂一致。100 萬美元資產要件並未移除，仍為本類別之標題要件。修訂公告之日期與範圍無法查得，未經查證；本欄僅陳述現行要件，不敘述修訂經過。

short.term_en: 10 yrs, issued as 5 plus 5
short.term_zh: 10 年，先核 5 年再延 5 年
short.outcome_en: No pathway to permanent residence or citizenship
short.outcome_zh: 不通往永久居留或公民身分
short.own_en: Condominium freehold only, no land; 49% foreign cap per building
short.own_zh: 僅限公寓完全所有權，不含土地；每棟外國人持有上限 49%

programmes.notes_en: Property is one qualifying asset inside a USD 500,000 investment test — there is no property-only LTR route and no property-specific threshold. TWO ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS that are easy to miss and both are hard gates: (a) 'Owning at least USD 1 million in global assets or Thai assets in the applicant's name' — this remains live and is the category's defining condition, contrary to reports that it was dropped; and (b) health insurance of at least USD 50,000 coverage, OR Thai social security, OR a bank balance of at least USD 100,000 held for at least 12 months. Helpfully, the USD 1m assets test 'can include or combine with the investment in Thailand of at least USD 500,000 mentioned above', so the total commitment is USD 1m, not USD 1.5m. Every condition must be maintained throughout the life of the visa, including the investment amounts.
programmes.notes_zh: 不動產僅為 50 萬美元投資測試下之一種合格資產——LTR 並無純不動產途徑，亦無不動產專屬門檻。另有兩項易被忽略且均為硬性門檻之要件：(a)「申請人名下持有至少 100 萬美元之全球或泰國資產」——此要件仍然有效，且為本類別之核心條件，與「已取消」之傳聞相反；(b) 保額至少 5 萬美元之健康保險，或泰國社會保險，或持有至少 12 個月、餘額至少 10 萬美元之銀行存款。惟 100 萬美元資產測試「得包含或合併上述至少 50 萬美元之泰國投資」，故總承諾為 100 萬美元而非 150 萬美元。簽證存續期間所有條件（含投資金額）均須持續維持。

programmes.programme: Malaysia My Second Home (MM2H) — Silver / Gold / Platinum
programmes.programme_zh: 馬來西亞我的第二家園（MM2H）——銀/ 金/ 白金級

min_value.basis: Silver category. 'Compulsory to purchase and own a residence after obtaining the approval as MM2H participant.' 'Value of the purchased residence should be RM600,000 or above.' Property purchase is a COMPULSORY CONDITION but is NOT sufficient on its own — it sits on top of a fixed deposit of USD 150,000 in a Malaysian institution licensed under the Financial Services Act 2013 or Islamic Financial Services Act 2013, plus a one-off participation fee of RM1,000.

extra_tiers.label_en: Gold category: residence of RM1 million or above, plus fixed deposit of USD 500,000 and a one-off participation fee of RM3,000. Pass of 15 years.
Platinum category: residence of RM2 million or above, plus fixed deposit of USD 1 million and a one-off participation fee of RM200,000. Pass of 20 years.

term.text_en: Silver: MM2H pass for 5 years. Gold: 15 years. Platinum: 20 years. In every category 'the pass can be renewed for every 5 years'. The hologram security sticker is issued for the length of the pass but is bounded by the participant's passport validity.
term.text_zh: 銀級：5 年 MM2H 准證。金級：15 年。白金級：20 年。各級別均為「每 5 年可續」。全息安全貼紙依准證期限核發，但以申請人護照效期為限。

stay.text_en: Minimum 90 days (cumulative) in Malaysia per year — a real obligation, not a formality. For participants aged 25 to 49 the 90 days may be fulfilled by the principal OR his/her dependants.
stay.text_zh: 每年須在馬來西亞停留累計至少 90 天——此為實質義務而非形式。25 至 49 歲之申請人，該 90 天得由主申請人或其眷屬履行。

leads_to.text_en: Nothing. MM2H is a Social Visit Pass. It does not lead to permanent residence or citizenship, and time held does not count toward either.
leads_to.text_zh: 無。MM2H 屬社交訪問准證，不通往永久居留或公民身分，持有期間亦不計入任一資格。

ownership_form.text_en: Freehold or leasehold title, including landed property — Malaysia is unusual in Asia in permitting foreign freehold of land. BUT every acquisition by a non-citizen requires the written consent of the State Authority under the National Land Code, and each state sets its own minimum purchase price, which operates INDEPENDENTLY of the MM2H thresholds. Low-cost, low-medium-cost and medium-cost housing is barred to foreigners and permanent residents.
ownership_form.text_zh: 可持有永久業權或租賃業權，含有地房產——馬來西亞在亞洲罕見地允許外國人持有土地永久業權。惟非公民之每一宗取得均須依《國家土地法典》取得州政府書面同意，且各州自訂最低購價，該門檻獨立於 MM2H 門檻運作。低成本、中低成本及中等成本房屋禁止外國人及永久居民購買。

offplan.text_en: NOT VERIFIED. The Terms and Regulations do not address completion status. The Fixed Deposit Withdrawal checklist accepts a 'Sale and Purchase Agreement (S&P) or utility bill' as proof of property purchase, which does not settle the point either way. Omitted rather than inferred.
offplan.text_zh: 未查證。條款與規則未規範完工狀態。定存提領檢核表接受「買賣合約（S&P）或水電帳單」作為購屋證明，兩者均無法確認此點。從缺，不作推論。

mortgage.text_en: NOT VERIFIED. Not addressed in the Terms and Regulations.
mortgage.text_zh: 未查證。條款與規則未規範。

dependants.text_en: Spouse; biological, step- or adopted children below 21; children aged 21 to 34 may be included but must be unemployed and single while in Malaysia. No participation fee is charged for dependants in any category. A foreign domestic helper may be applied for separately.
dependants.text_zh: 配偶；未滿 21 歲之親生、繼親或收養子女；21 至 34 歲之子女得納入，惟在馬來西亞期間須未就業且未婚。各級別眷屬均免收參與費。外籍家庭幫傭可另行申請。

entry_tax.text_en: NOT VERIFIED in this pass. Malaysian stamp duty on transfer, plus the state consent fee levied by the relevant Land and Mines Office, were not confirmed against a tier-1 source and are omitted rather than estimated.
entry_tax.text_zh: 本次未查證。移轉印花稅及各州土地礦務局徵收之同意費未經一級來源確認，故從缺，不作推估。

last_change.text_en: The three-tier Silver/Gold/Platinum structure is stated in the MOTAC 'Terms and Regulations for New Participants' document, which is marked 'ACCURATE AS OF 22 JULY 2024' on every page. The MOTAC Application Guidelines Booklet published May 2026 is consistent with it and confirms renewal is a 5-year extension.
last_change.text_zh: 銀/金/白金三級結構載於旅遊藝術文化部《新參與者條款與規則》，該文件每頁標註「資料截至 2024 年 7 月 22 日」。旅遊藝術文化部 2026 年 5 月發布之《申請指南手冊》與之一致，並確認續期為 5 年延長。

short.term_en: Silver 5 yrs, Gold 15, Platinum 20; renewable every 5 yrs
short.term_zh: 銀級 5 年、金級 15 年、白金級 20 年；每 5 年續期
short.outcome_en: Nothing. A social visit pass; time held counts toward neither PR nor citizenship
short.outcome_zh: 無。屬社交訪問准證，持有年資不計入永久居留亦不計入入籍
short.own_en: Freehold or leasehold including land, but state consent and each state’s own minimum price apply
short.own_zh: 可持有永久或租賃業權，含土地；惟須州政府同意並符合各州自訂最低購價

programmes.notes_en: THE EFFECTIVE-FLOOR QUESTION, ANSWERED — AND THE DRAFT'S PREMISE IS WRONG FOR PENANG. The draft asserted that state minimums are never overridden and that Penang Island's RM3,000,000 therefore sets the floor for an MM2H buyer. Penang's own Land and Mines Office guideline (updated 1 August 2024) shows the opposite: Penang grants MM2H participants an EXPRESS CONCESSION of RM500,000, on both the island and the mainland, for strata AND landed property — far below both the general foreign thresholds and below MM2H Silver's own RM600,000. The concession is limited: 'Malaysia My Second Home (MM2H) is for residence only and limited to 2 units only.' So in Penang the binding constraint on an MM2H Silver participant is the MM2H programme's own RM600,000, not RM3,000,000. Penang's general (non-MM2H) foreign thresholds are: strata, island — RM1 million (since 1 July 2012); landed/landed strata, island — RM3 million (since 1 April 2017); strata, mainland — RM1 million; landed, mainland — RM1 million (since 1 July 2012). Permanent residents pay a RM250,000 floor. The RM3 million figure is real, but it binds foreigners who are NOT MM2H participants buying landed property on the island — not MM2H buyers. THE CORRECT GENERAL STATEMENT is therefore: the operative floor for any given purchase is the HIGHER of (a) the MM2H tier minimum and (b) whatever minimum the relevant state applies to that buyer and that property type — and some states, Penang demonstrably among them, apply a LOWER minimum to MM2H participants specifically. It cannot be resolved nationally; it must be checked state by state. KUALA LUMPUR IS NOT VERIFIED. The draft's KL figure of RM1,000,000 could not be confirmed: the Federal Territories Land and Mines Office (ptgwp.gov.my) was unreachable from this environment across repeated attempts by three different methods, and the Economic Planning Unit's Guideline on the Acquisition of Properties PDF on ekonomi.gov.my refused every connection. The RM1,000,000 figure appears only in tier-3 sources here and is therefore NOT published. Do not print a KL number without re-verifying it against PTGWP or the EPU guideline. SEQUENCING (verified, and it settles the lock question's premise): the purchase is required AFTER approval, not before — 'Compulsory to purchase and own a residence after obtaining the approval as MM2H participant.' THE 10-YEAR LOCK: the instrument says only 'Selling of the residence is not allowed for 10 years. However, the house can be upgraded (buying of a new residence) to a residence of higher value from the current property.' It does NOT state whether the 10 years runs from the SPA or from visa issuance. Since the purchase must post-date approval, the two dates cannot be far apart, but the document does not resolve the start point and neither reading is published as fact.
programmes.notes_zh: 實際門檻問題已釐清——且草稿在檳城之前提為錯誤。草稿主張州最低價從不被排除，故檳城島 RM3,000,000 即為 MM2H 買方之底線。檳城土地礦務局自身指引（2024 年 8 月 1 日更新）顯示相反：檳城對 MM2H 參與者明文給予 RM500,000 之優惠，島區與威省、分層與有地房產皆適用，遠低於一般外國人門檻，亦低於 MM2H 銀級自身之 RM600,000。該優惠有限制：「馬來西亞我的第二家園（MM2H）僅限自住，且以 2 個單位為限。」故在檳城，MM2H 銀級參與者之拘束條件為 MM2H 方案自身之 RM600,000，而非 RM3,000,000。檳城一般（非 MM2H）外國人門檻為：島區分層 RM100 萬（2012 年 7 月 1 日起）；島區有地/有地分層 RM300 萬（2017 年 4 月 1 日起）；威省分層 RM100 萬；威省有地 RM100 萬（2012 年 7 月 1 日起）。永久居民門檻為 RM250,000。RM300 萬確有其事，但拘束的是非 MM2H 之外國人購買島區有地房產，而非 MM2H 買方。正確之一般性陳述為：任一宗購置之實際底線，係(a) MM2H 級別門檻與(b) 該州就該買方及該房產類型所適用之最低價，兩者取其高——且部分州（檳城為明證）對 MM2H 參與者另訂較低門檻。此事無法在全國層次一概而論，必須逐州查核。吉隆坡未經查證。草稿之 RM1,000,000 無法確認：聯邦直轄區土地礦務局（ptgwp.gov.my）在本環境下以三種方法反覆嘗試均無法連通，經濟策劃單位之《房地產取得指引》PDF（ekonomi.gov.my）亦拒絕所有連線。RM1,000,000 於本次僅見於三級來源，故不予刊載。未向 PTGWP 或經濟策劃單位指引重新查證前，不得刊出吉隆坡數字。順序（已查證，並釐清鎖定期問題之前提）：購置須於核准之後，而非之前——「經核准為 MM2H 參與者後，強制購買並持有住宅。」10 年鎖定期：條文僅載「住宅於 10 年內不得出售。惟該住宅得升級（購買新住宅）為價值更高之房產。」文件未載明 10 年係自買賣合約起算或自簽證核發起算。因購置必然晚於核准，兩個日期不致相距甚遠，惟文件未解決起算點，故兩種解讀均不作為事實刊載。

programmes.programme: Residence Visa — Leasehold Holder category
programmes.programme_zh: 居留簽證——租賃權持有人類別
programmes.label_zh: 居留簽證：租賃權持有人

min_value.basis: 'Requires leasehold ownership of a Vanuatu property valued at 10 million Vatu or more, with certified income of at least 250,000 Vatu per month per person in the application.' The property test alone is NOT sufficient — the monthly income test is a co-equal condition.

term.text_en: NOT VERIFIED — do not publish a fixed term. The Department states only that for the Leasehold Holder category 'the visa's duration may vary based on individual circumstances.' The published fee schedule runs from 57,600 VUV (1 year) to 511,200 VUV (10 years) for applicants aged 18 and over, implying options in the 1-10 year range, but the Department does not commit to a term.
term.text_zh: 未查證——不得刊載固定期限。移民局僅表示租賃權持有人類別「簽證期限視個別情況而異」。公布之費用表自 57,600 瓦圖（1 年）至 511,200 瓦圖（10 年）（18 歲以上申請人），顯示選項落在 1 至 10 年區間，惟移民局未承諾特定期限。

stay.text_en: NOT VERIFIED.
stay.text_zh: 未查證。

leads_to.text_en: NOT VERIFIED. The Department lists a separate 'Permanent Residency Visa' but its relationship to the Leasehold Holder route was not established in this pass.
leads_to.text_zh: 未查證。移民局另列「永久居留簽證」，惟其與租賃權持有人途徑之關係本次未確立。

ownership_form.text_en: LEASEHOLD ONLY. Vanuatu land is customary-owned and the Department's own term for the qualifying interest is 'leasehold ownership' — there is no foreign freehold. The commonly-cited 75-year maximum lease term is NOT published here: the only source found was a single tier-2 report of a 2024 amendment to the Land Leases Act [CAP 163] s.32B raising the maximum on PUBLIC land from 75 to up to 99 years, which is both single-sourced and about public rather than custom land.

programmes.notes_en: The VUV 10,000,000 figure is confirmed at tier 1, but the draft omitted a second hard gate that materially changes who qualifies: certified income of at least VUV 250,000 per month PER PERSON in the application. For a couple that is VUV 500,000/month of certified income, which is a substantial ongoing test rather than a formality. Maintenance obligation: 'The main applicant must maintain the required monthly income and leasehold ownership of the property.' CITATION WARNING: the Department cites the Immigration Act No. 17 of 2010, not '[CAP 66]' as the draft had it — do not publish CAP 66. Confidence is medium because term, stay, and pathway-to-PR are all unverified. STRICTLY SEPARATE from the Vanuatu citizenship-by-donation programmes (DSP/CIIP), which sit with the Vanuatu Citizenship Office, are not property-based, and were not verified here.

programmes.programme: Special Resident Retiree's Visa (SRRV) Classic — deposit-to-property conversion
programmes.programme_zh: 特別居留退休簽證（SRRV）經典型——存款轉換不動產

min_value.basis: Minimum value of the property into which the visa deposit may be converted. Condominium: 'The visa deposit under the SRRV Classic may be converted into a condominium unit provided that the CCT is under the principal retiree's name and the value of the property is at least US$50,000.00 in Philippine Peso equivalent.' Long-term lease of house and lot: 'The Contract of Lease should be at least US$50,000.00 in Philippine Peso equivalent', and 'The lease should be at least 25 years and can be renewed for another 25 years at the option of the retiree-lessee.'

term.text_en: Indefinite while the deposit or the converted investment is maintained and the holder remains qualified. SRRV is a special resident visa with multiple-entry privileges.
term.text_zh: 只要存款或轉換後之投資維持且持有人資格存續，期限不限。SRRV 為具多次入境權之特別居留簽證。

stay.text_en: No minimum physical-presence requirement.
stay.text_zh: 無最低居住天數要求。

leads_to.text_en: No pathway to Philippine citizenship. SRRV is permanent-resident-style status contingent on maintaining the deposit or investment.
leads_to.text_zh: 不通往菲律賓公民身分。SRRV 屬須維持存款或投資之類永久居留身分。

ownership_form.text_en: Condominium unit title (CCT) or a long-term lease of house and lot — NEVER land. Republic Act No. 4726 (Condominium Act) s.5: 'no condominium unit therein shall be conveyed or transferred to persons other than Filipino citizens, or corporations at least sixty percent of the capital stock of which belong to Filipino citizens, except in cases of hereditary succession.' Expressed as a 60% Filipino floor, which is how the statute puts it, rather than as a 40% foreign cap.
ownership_form.text_zh: 僅限區分所有權狀（CCT）或房地長期租賃，絕不含土地。第 4726 號共和國法（區分所有權法）第 5 條規定，區分所有權單位不得移轉予菲律賓公民以外之人，或菲律賓公民持股未達 60% 之法人，繼承者除外。此係法條之表述方式（菲方持股 60% 下限），而非「外資 40% 上限」。

offplan.text_en: Excluded for the condominium conversion. The rule requires the Condominium Certificate of Title (CCT) to be already issued in the principal retiree's name, which an off-plan unit does not have.
offplan.text_zh: 區分所有權轉換排除預售屋。規則要求區分所有權狀（CCT）已登記於主申請退休人名下，預售屋不具備。

short.term_zh: 維持存款或轉換後之投資期間無期限

short.outcome_zh: 近似永久居留之身分；不通往菲律賓公民身分
short.own_en: Condominium title or a 25-year lease of house and lot; never land
short.own_zh: 區分所有權狀或房地 25 年租賃，絕不含土地

programmes.notes_en: THE DIRECTION IS CONFIRMED AND IT IS THE OPPOSITE OF A PROPERTY ROUTE. The visa is granted by the DEPOSIT; the purchase is a permitted post-issuance use of that deposit. The clincher is explicit in the PRA checklist: 'Conversion of visa deposit into an existing condominium unit under principal retiree's name is only allowed 30 days after the issuance of SRRV.' You cannot buy your way to an SRRV; you obtain the SRRV by depositing, then may redeploy the deposit into property worth at least USD 50,000. CORRECTIONS TO THE DRAFT: the reported '2023 reform raising the age to 50+' is FALSE — the PRA's current stated eligibility is 'Principal/s — 40 years old and above'. And 'USD 50,000 for the Classic' is FALSE as a blanket deposit figure; it applies only to non-pensioners aged 40-49. DEPOSIT BANDS: the SRRV Classic deposit falls in the range USD 15,000 to USD 50,000 depending on age band and pension status. The per-band allocation is deliberately NOT published: the PRA table's row/column orientation was ambiguous on extraction and, while a screenshot reading was taken, the risk of transposing two figures is real and the deposit is not the property threshold anyway. Pension proof required: at least USD 800/month for single applicants, USD 1,000/month with dependants. Land ownership by foreigners is constitutionally barred; the 1987 Constitution Art. XII text itself could not be retrieved and is not cited here.
programmes.notes_zh: 方向已確認，且與「不動產途徑」正好相反。簽證係由存款取得；購置僅為核發後動用該存款之許可用途。菲律賓退休管理局檢核表明文載定：「將簽證存款轉換為主申請退休人名下既有區分所有權單位，僅於 SRRV 核發 30 日後始得為之。」無法以購置換取 SRRV；須先以存款取得 SRRV，其後方得將存款轉投入價值至少 5 萬美元之不動產。草稿更正：所謂「2023 年改革將年齡提高至 50 歲以上」為錯誤——退休管理局現行資格為「主申請人 40 歲以上」。「經典型 5 萬美元」作為通案存款數字亦為錯誤，該數字僅適用 40 至 49 歲之非領退休金者。存款級距：SRRV 經典型存款依年齡級距與是否領退休金，落在 15,000 至 50,000 美元區間。各級距對應金額刻意不予刊載：擷取時該表列欄方向存有歧義，雖已以截圖判讀，錯置兩個數字之風險確實存在，且存款本非不動產門檻。須檢附退休金證明：單身申請人每月至少 800 美元，有眷屬者每月至少 1,000 美元。外國人持有土地為憲法所禁；1987 年憲法第 12 條本文無法取得，本處不予引註。

min_value.basis: Total minimum investment. 'An Applicant must make investment of a minimum of HK$30 million Net.' Of this, at least HK$27 million goes into permissible financial assets and/or real estate, and HK$3 million must be placed into the CIES Investment Portfolio managed by the Hong Kong Investment Corporation Limited. Applicant must also hold net assets of at least HK$30 million for the six months preceding assessment.

extra_tiers.label_en: AGGREGATE CAP on real estate counted toward the HK$30m: 'The total investment amount in real estate which is counted towards the fulfillment of minimum investment threshold is subject to an aggregate cap of HK$15 million.'

SUB-CAP on residential real estate within that HK$15m: 'of which the investment in residential real estate is capped at HK$10 million.' Residential investment must be in one single property with a transaction price of HK$30 million or above.
