programmes.notes_en: THE DRAFT WAS OUT OF DATE — 'non-residential only, capped at HK$10 million' is the superseded launch rule. Residential property has been admissible since purchases completing on or after 16 October 2024, and the caps changed again on 17 September 2025. Current position: aggregate real-estate cap HK$15 million, of which residential is capped at HK$10 million, and any residential investment must be a single property transacting at HK$30 million or above. FRAMING: property is NOT a route here. It is one permitted asset class inside a single HK$30 million investment requirement, and it is capped so that it can never satisfy more than half of it. There is no property-only pathway into New CIES. Most non-financial fields above were out of scope for this pass and are marked unverified rather than guessed. The commonly-cited 1 March 2024 launch date was not stated on the pages read and is not confirmed here — the rules refer only to 'the launch date of the Scheme'.
programmes.notes_zh: 草稿已過時——「僅限非住宅、上限 1,000 萬港元」為已被取代之開辦規則。住宅物業自 2024 年 10 月 16 日或之後完成交易者即可納入，上限並於 2025 年 9 月 17 日再度變更。現行規定：房地產總上限 1,500 萬港元，其中住宅上限 1,000 萬港元，且住宅投資須為單一物業且成交價 3,000 萬港元或以上。定位：不動產在此並非途徑，而係單一 3,000 萬港元投資要求下之一種許可資產類別，且其上限使其永遠無法滿足該要求之一半以上。新 CIES 並無純不動產途徑。上列多數非財務欄位不在本次查證範圍，標示未查證而不作臆測。常被引用之 2024 年 3 月 1 日開辦日期未見於所讀頁面，本處不予確認——規則僅提及「計劃開辦日」。

programmes.programme: Residence permit by acquisition of scheme property (PDS / RES / IHS / Smart City) or a G+2 apartment
programmes.programme_zh: 取得計畫類房產（PDS / RES / IHS / 智慧城市）或 G+2 公寓之居留許可
programmes.label_en: Scheme property or a G+2 apartment
programmes.label_zh: 計畫類物件或 G+2 公寓

min_value.basis: Immigration Act s.5(1)(g): resident status where a person 'holds immovable property under the Integrated Resort Scheme, Real Estate Scheme, Invest Hotel Scheme, Property Development Scheme or Smart City Scheme, the purchase price of which is not less than 375,000 US dollars'. Separately, Immigration Act s.5(1)(ga), inserted by Act 15 of 2021 and in force 5 August 2021: resident status where a person 'purchases or otherwise acquires an apartment used, or available for use, as residence, in a building of at least 2 floors above ground floor, provided the purchase price is not less than 375,000 US dollars'.

extra_tiers.label_en: NOT a residence threshold — the minimum price at which a non-citizen is PERMITTED TO BUY a G+2 apartment at all. Non-Citizens (Property Restriction) Act s.3(3)(c)(v): 'an apartment used, or available for use, as residence, in a building of at least 2 floors above ground floor, provided the purchase price is not less than 6 million rupees or its equivalent in any other hard convertible foreign currency'. A G+2 purchase priced between MUR 6 million and USD 375,000 is lawful but confers NO residence.

term.text_en: Open-ended, tied to continued holding. EDB guidelines: 'The residence permit granted to the non-citizen remains in force until such time the non-citizen shall hold the residential property under the G+2 or where the person nominated ... informs the Economic Development Board to terminate the residency.' Immigration Act s.6(1A): a person who acquired resident status under s.5(1)(g), (ga), (h), (ha) or (hb) 'shall cease to be a resident where he is certified by the Economic Development Board to have ceased to satisfy the requirements' of the relevant scheme.
term.text_zh: 無固定年限，與持續持有掛鉤。經濟發展局指引：外國人之居留許可持續有效，直至其不再持有該 G+2 住宅，或經指定人通知經濟發展局終止居留為止。《入出境法》第 6(1A) 條：依第 5(1)(g)、(ga)、(h)、(ha) 或 (hb) 條取得居民身分者，經經濟發展局認定已不符相關計畫要件時，即喪失居民身分。

stay.text_en: No minimum physical-presence requirement is imposed by the Immigration Act provisions creating this status.
stay.text_zh: 《入出境法》創設本身分之條文未課予最低實際居住要求。

leads_to.text_en: NO route to permanent residence via the property itself. Immigration Act s.5A(1)(aa) routes PR through Part IV of the First Schedule to the Economic Development Board Act 2017, which was REPEALED AND REPLACED by Act 18 of 2025 with effect from 9 August 2025 and now contains exactly four categories — Investor, Professional, Self-employed, Retired non-citizen — none of them property-based. The retired-non-citizen route requires 5 years' residence permit PLUS USD 200,000 transferred over 5 years. Citizenship: NOT VERIFIED — the Mauritius Citizenship Act was not examined and no naturalisation claim is published.
leads_to.text_zh: 不動產本身不通往永久居留。《入出境法》第 5A(1)(aa) 條將永久居留導向《2017 年經濟發展局法》附表一第四部，該部已由 2025 年第 18 號法自 2025 年 8 月 9 日起廢止並取代，現僅列四類——投資者、專業人士、自營作業者、退休外國人——均非以不動產為基礎。退休外國人途徑須持居留許可滿 5 年，並於 5 年內匯入 20 萬美元。公民身分：未查證——未檢視《模里西斯公民法》，不刊載歸化主張。

ownership_form.text_en: Freehold, but only within a permitted channel. A non-citizen may not freely buy Mauritian property; acquisition must fall within the Non-Citizens (Property Restriction) Act, i.e. under one of the EDB schemes or as a G+2 apartment at not less than MUR 6 million.
ownership_form.text_zh: 可持有完全所有權，惟須循許可管道。外國人不得自由購置模里西斯不動產；取得須落入《非公民（財產限制）法》範圍，即依經濟發展局各計畫之一，或以不低於 600 萬盧比購買 G+2 公寓。

offplan.text_en: NOT VERIFIED as such. Related and verified: under regulations in force 13 December 2024, 85% of the purchase price must be paid to the promoter in Mauritian rupees and the remaining 15% in USD/EUR/other hard currency or MUR; local loan financing is available only above USD 750,000 (raised from USD 500,000), with the first USD 750,000 to come from own funds transferred from abroad. Critically, 'The amendments do not apply to sale of apartment under the Ground+2 scheme.'
offplan.text_zh: 本身未查證。相關且已查證者：依 2024 年 12 月 13 日生效之規則，購價之 85% 須以模里西斯盧比支付予開發商，其餘 15% 得以美元/歐元/其他強勢貨幣或盧比支付；本地貸款融資僅於 75 萬美元以上部分可用（由 50 萬美元提高），首筆 75 萬美元須為自海外匯入之自有資金。關鍵在於「該等修正不適用於 Ground+2 計畫下之公寓買賣」。

mortgage.text_en: Local loan financing is permitted only for the portion above USD 750,000; the first USD 750,000 must come from the buyer's own funds transferred from abroad. This does NOT apply to G+2 apartments.
mortgage.text_zh: 本地貸款融資僅適用於 75 萬美元以上之部分；首筆 75 萬美元須為買方自海外匯入之自有資金。此規定不適用於 G+2 公寓。

dependants.text_en: Yes. Immigration Act s.5(1)(i) confers resident status on 'the spouse, dependent child, parent or other dependent of a person to whom paragraph (g), (ga), (h) or (ha) applies'. Note this expressly extends to PARENTS, which is unusually generous.
dependants.text_zh: 可攜眷。《入出境法》第 5(1)(i) 條賦予「適用第 (g)、(ga)、(h) 或 (ha) 款之人之配偶、受扶養子女、父母或其他受扶養人」居民身分。值得注意者，該條明文及於父母，條件相當寬鬆。

entry_tax.text_en: TWO taxes both rise to 10% for deeds registered on or after 1 July 2026 — this is a doubling on BOTH sides of the transaction. (1) REGISTRATION DUTY, payable by the buyer: Registration Duty Act s.3(1G) (added by Act 18 of 2025, in force 9 August 2025) makes duty on the registration of a deed transferring to a non-citizen, on or after 1 July 2026, a residential property under an EDB Property Scheme or under s.3(3)(c)(v) of the Non-Citizens (Property Restriction) Act — or one FIRST acquired under either — chargeable under Part I, Paragraph K of the First Schedule, which reads 'K. Rate 10%'. (2) LAND TRANSFER TAX, payable by the seller: Land (Duties and Taxes) Act s.4(9), same 1 July 2026 trigger and same property definitions, with the resale limb qualified by 'and the transferor is a non-citizen'; Seventh Schedule Part III sets the rate at 10 per cent.
entry_tax.text_zh: 兩項稅負於 2026 年 7 月 1 日或之後登記之契據均升至 10%——交易雙方同時加倍。(1) 登記稅，買方負擔：《登記稅法》第 3(1G) 條（由 2025 年第 18 號法增訂，2025 年 8 月 9 日生效）規定，2026 年 7 月 1 日或之後向外國人移轉「經濟發展局房產計畫」下或《非公民（財產限制）法》第 3(3)(c)(v) 條下住宅（或最初依該兩者取得之住宅）之契據登記，依附表一第一部 K 段課稅，該段載明「K. 稅率 10%」。(2) 土地移轉稅，賣方負擔：《土地（稅捐）法》第 4(9) 條，適用同一 2026 年 7 月 1 日起算點及相同房產定義，轉售部分另加「且移轉人為外國人」之限制；附表七第三部訂定稅率為 10%。

last_change.text_en: Act 18 of 2025, in force 9 August 2025, both introduced the 10% duty and tax provisions effective for deeds registered on or after 1 July 2026 AND replaced Part IV of the First Schedule to the EDB Act 2017 governing permanent residence.
last_change.text_zh: 2025 年第 18 號法自 2025 年 8 月 9 日生效，既導入適用於 2026 年 7 月 1 日或之後登記契據之 10% 稅率規定，亦取代《2017 年經濟發展局法》附表一規範永久居留之第四部。

programmes.notes_en: GOVERNMENT SOURCE FOUND — and the reason the earlier sweep failed is simply that edb.mu does not resolve. The Economic Development Board's live domain is edbmauritius.org. The thresholds here are taken from the consolidated statutes themselves on the Attorney-General's Laws of Mauritius portal, not from the EDB's summaries. G+2 ANSWERED: purchase of a G+2 apartment at USD 375,000 or more IS residence-granting, under Immigration Act s.5(1)(ga). The apparent 'buy without residence' case is real but is a PRICE BAND, not a scheme exclusion — between MUR 6 million (the minimum at which a non-citizen may buy a G+2 at all) and USD 375,000 (the minimum at which the purchase also carries residence). CITATION WARNING: the EDB's own guidelines PDF attributes the G+2 residence permit to 'Section 8 of the Immigration Act'. That is wrong — section 8 is 'Prohibited immigrants' and contains no such provision. The operative provisions are s.5(1)(g), (ga) and (i). Do not reproduce the EDB's citation. TWO ITEMS DELIBERATELY NOT PUBLISHED: (1) whether legacy IRS stock is caught by the new 10% duty is genuinely open on the face of the text — the statutory definition of 'EDB Property Scheme' inserted by Act 18 of 2025 lists only the RES Regulations 2022, Invest Hotel Scheme Regulations 2015, Smart City Scheme Regulations 2015 and PDS Regulations 2015, and does NOT list the legacy IRS regulations, even though IRS property is named in Immigration Act s.5(1)(g). (2) The short title of Act 18 of 2025 was not verified; cite it by act number, and note it is NOT the Budget 2026-2027, which is a different instrument.
programmes.notes_zh: 已找到政府來源——先前查核失敗之原因僅是 edb.mu 網域無法解析。經濟發展局現行網域為 edbmauritius.org。本處門檻取自檢察總長署「模里西斯法律」入口之彙編法規本文，而非經濟發展局之摘要。G+2 問題已答：以 37.5 萬美元以上購買 G+2 公寓確可取得居留，依據為《入出境法》第 5(1)(ga) 條。所謂「購買而不取得居留」之情形確實存在，但屬價格區間而非計畫排除——即介於 600 萬盧比（外國人得購買 G+2 之最低價）與 37.5 萬美元（購買同時取得居留之最低價）之間。引註警告：經濟發展局自身指引 PDF 將 G+2 居留許可歸諸「《入出境法》第 8 條」。此為錯誤——第 8 條為「禁止入境者」，並無該規定。實際依據為第 5(1)(g)、(ga) 及 (i) 條。不得沿用經濟發展局之引註。兩項刻意不予刊載：(1) 舊制 IRS 房產是否適用新 10% 稅率，就條文文義而言確有疑義——2025 年第 18 號法增訂之「經濟發展局房產計畫」定義僅列《2022 年 RES 規則》、《2015 年投資旅館計畫規則》、《2015 年智慧城市計畫規則》及《2015 年 PDS 規則》，並未列入舊制 IRS 規則，儘管 IRS 房產見於《入出境法》第 5(1)(g) 條。(2) 2025 年第 18 號法之簡稱未經查證；請以法律編號引用，並注意其非 2026-2027 年度預算案，二者為不同法案。

min_value.basis: 'a. USD 100,000 - for a 5 year visa.' Funds must be routed through an Inward Investment Account and then a Visa Programme Foreign Currency Account at a licensed commercial bank. Acquisition of immovable property is ONE of five permitted uses of those funds, alongside voting shares of at least 10% in a Sri Lankan company, an overseas company's place of business, government or CBSL debt securities of 5 years or more, and term deposits.

ownership_form.text_en: Condominium freehold on ANY floor above ground level — the fourth-floor restriction is GONE. Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014 s.2(1) prohibits transfer of title to land to a foreigner, to a Sri Lankan company with foreign shareholding of fifty per cent or above, or to a foreign company; the maximum lease tenure alternative 'shall not exceed ninety nine years'. The 2014 condominium exemption originally required a parcel 'situated on or above the fourth floor'. Act No. 21 of 2018 s.2(a) repealed that paragraph and substituted 'a condominium parcel specified under the Apartment Ownership Law', keeping only the proviso that 'the entire value shall be paid upfront through an inward foreign remittance prior to the execution of the relevant deed of transfer'. Certified 30 July 2018 and deemed in operation from 1 April 2018.
ownership_form.text_zh: 可持有地面層以上任何樓層之區分所有權完全所有權——四樓限制已廢除。《2014 年第 38 號土地（讓與限制）法》第 2(1) 條禁止將土地所有權移轉予外國人、外資持股達 50% 以上之斯里蘭卡公司或外國公司；替代之最長租期「不得逾 99 年」。2014 年之區分所有權豁免原要求須為「位於四樓或以上」之單元。《2018 年第 21 號法》第 2(a) 條廢止該款，代之以「《公寓所有權法》所定之區分所有權單元」，僅保留「全部價金須於簽立移轉契據前經自海外匯入方式一次付清」之但書。2018 年 7 月 30 日核可，並溯自 2018 年 4 月 1 日施行。

programmes.notes_en: THE MECHANISM IS A REMITTANCE, NOT A DEED. Property purchase qualifies, but it is one of five permitted uses of money that must first be remitted into an Inward Investment Account and then a Visa Programme Foreign Currency Account. The gating act is the inward remittance, not the conveyance — describing this as a 'buy property, get residency' route would be materially misleading. The ownership question posed is answered squarely: a foreigner CAN hold freehold title to a condominium unit on any floor above ground level, provided the entire price is paid upfront by inward foreign remittance before the deed is executed. Freehold LAND remains prohibited, with a 99-year lease as the alternative.
programmes.notes_zh: 關鍵在匯款而非契據。購置不動產確可符合資格，惟其為款項之五種許可用途之一，而該款項須先匯入「境外投資帳戶」再轉入「簽證計畫外幣帳戶」。門檻行為是資金匯入而非產權移轉；將其描述為「買房換居留」將造成實質誤導。所詢之所有權問題可明確回答：外國人可持有地面層以上任何樓層區分所有權單元之完全所有權，惟全部價金須於簽立移轉契據前以自海外匯入方式一次付清。土地之完全所有權仍禁止，替代方案為 99 年租賃。

programmes.notes_en: CONFIDENCE IS MEDIUM BECAUSE THE PROGRAMME'S CURRENT STATUS IS UNRESOLVED, not because the figures are shaky. The figures are tier-1. But two official signals from the same Department conflict: the Golden Paradise page is still live and still states USD 200,000 for 10 years, while the Department's own Residence Visa index now lists sixteen categories with NO Golden Paradise entry among them (it lists Employment, Investor, Religious, Educational, NGO, Registered Indians, Ex-Sri Lankan Citizens, Family Members, Diplomatic, Medical, Court, My Dream Home Visa Programme, Resident Guest Scheme, Digital Nomad, Port City Commission, and Relations of Sri Lankan Citizens). The Golden Paradise site footer still reads '2010-2022'. No tier-1 source, and no two agreeing tier-2 sources, say whether it is open, closed, or superseded; claims that it is closed trace only to social-media comments. Publish as status-unconfirmed and note that the Investor Visa Category appears to be the active route. SECOND AND MORE IMPORTANT POINT: as with the Investor Visa, the qualifying act is a DEPOSIT into a designated foreign currency account. A condominium is a permitted use of the deposited funds. Describing this as 'USD 200,000 for a condominium purchase' is materially misleading and should not be published in that form.
programmes.notes_zh: 可信度列為中等係因計畫現況未定，而非數字薄弱。數字均為一級來源。惟同一主管機關發出兩項相互衝突之官方訊號：黃金天堂頁面仍在線並仍載明 20 萬美元、10 年，而該局居留簽證索引現列 16 類，其中並無黃金天堂（所列為就業、投資、宗教、教育、非政府組織、登記印度人、前斯里蘭卡公民、家庭成員、外交、醫療、法院、我的夢想家園簽證計畫、居留賓客計畫、數位游牧、港口城市委員會、斯里蘭卡公民親屬）。黃金天堂網站頁尾仍顯示「2010-2022」。無一級來源，亦無兩份相互印證之二級來源說明其開放、關閉或已被取代；稱其已關閉之說法僅見於社群媒體留言。應以「現況未確認」刊載，並註明投資人簽證類別似為現行途徑。第二項且更重要：與投資人簽證相同，門檻行為係將款項存入指定外幣帳戶。區分所有權房產僅為該筆存款之許可用途。將其描述為「20 萬美元購買區分所有權房產」將造成實質誤導，不應以該形式刊載。

programmes.programme: Second Home limited-stay permit (rumah kedua)
programmes.programme_zh: 第二家園限期居留許可（rumah kedua）

min_value.basis: The PROPERTY limb. Permenkumham No. 22 of 2023 art.56(2)(b): a commitment statement to purchase property in the form of 'rumah susun atau apartemen' (a strata unit or apartment) in Indonesia worth at least US$1,000,000 or equivalent. The commitment must be satisfied within 90 days of ITAS issuance. Note the regulation says strata or apartment only — NOT landed houses — and contains no 'luxury' qualifier.

extra_tiers.label_en: The DEPOSIT limb, and the cheaper of the two. Permenkumham No. 22 of 2023 art.56(2)(a): a commitment statement to keep funds in an account in the applicant's OWN NAME at a STATE-OWNED bank worth at least US$130,000 or equivalent. The two limbs are alternatives ('atau'), so nobody needs to buy property to obtain this permit.

term.text_en: Maximum 5 years. Permenkumham No. 22 of 2023 art.105(10)(a): 'Orang Asing yang tinggal dalam rangka rumah kedua dengan jangka waktu paling lama 5 (lima) tahun.' The permit is a limited-stay permit (ITAS); the visa application doubles as the ITAS and re-entry permit application under art.33(6).
term.text_zh: 最長 5 年。《2023 年第 22 號法務暨人權部長條例》第 105 條第 10 項第 a 款：「以第二家園為由居留之外國人，期間最長 5 年。」該許可為限期居留許可（ITAS）；依第 33 條第 6 項，簽證申請同時作為 ITAS 及再入境許可之申請。

ownership_form.text_en: No Hak Milik (freehold over land) for foreigners — this is absolute. Permen ATR/BPN No. 18 of 2021 art.185: a foreigner holding valid immigration documents may own a landed house (rumah tapak) only on Hak Pakai — over State land, over Hak Milik by PPAT deed, or over Hak Pengelolaan — and may own a strata unit (rumah susun) built on Hak Pakai OR Hak Guna Bangunan land. Art.188(1): a strata unit owned by a foreigner on HP or HGB land is issued Hak Milik atas Satuan Rumah Susun (SHMSRS). Note a widening versus the older rule: since PP 18/2021 and Permen 18/2021, foreign strata ownership is permitted over HGB land as well as Hak Pakai. Art.186 limits landed houses to the luxury category, one plot per person or family, maximum 2,000 m2 (waivable by the Minister for exceptional economic impact), and limits strata to commercial rumah susun.
ownership_form.text_zh: 外國人不得取得土地之 Hak Milik（完全所有權），此為絕對限制。《2021 年農業及空間規劃部/國家土地局第 18 號部長條例》第 185 條：持有效移民文件之外國人，僅得以 Hak Pakai（使用權）持有有地住宅（rumah tapak）——包括國有地、經 PPAT 契據設定於 Hak Milik 之上者，或設定於 Hak Pengelolaan 之上者——並得持有建於 Hak Pakai 或 Hak Guna Bangunan（建物權）土地上之區分所有權單元（rumah susun）。第 188 條第 1 項：外國人持有之區分所有權單元，若坐落於 HP 或 HGB 土地，核發 SHMSRS（區分所有權完全所有權狀）。相較舊制已放寬：自第 18/2021 號政府條例及第 18/2021 號部長條例起，外國人之區分所有權亦得設定於 HGB 土地，而不限於 Hak Pakai。第 186 條並將有地住宅限於豪宅類別、每人或每一家庭 1 筆、最大 2,000 平方公尺（部長得就具重大經濟效益者豁免），區分所有權則限於商業型 rumah susun。

programmes.notes_en: THE DRAFT'S HEADLINE FIGURE IS SUPERSEDED. IDR 2,000,000,000 is the 2022 launch figure and does NOT stand in 2026. The current governing text states the thresholds in US DOLLARS, not rupiah: US$130,000 as a state-bank deposit, or US$1,000,000 in a strata unit or apartment. The IDR 2bn figure was simply that deposit amount re-denominated at roughly IDR 15,400/USD at the time. Do not publish IDR 2bn as current. SECOND CORRECTION: the permit is a maximum of FIVE years, not ten. THIRD: this programme has NOT been absorbed into the Golden Visa. 'Rumah kedua' (art.33(2)(j)) and the investor 5- and 10-year visas (art.33(2)(e)) are separate categories inside the same regulation and both are live. TWO CITATIONS DELIBERATELY NOT PUBLISHED: (1) Circular No. IMI-0740.GR.01.01 of 2022 could not be retrieved or confirmed from any source, and a tier-2 Indonesian source cites a DIFFERENT number (IMI-0820.GR.01.01 of 2022) for the same visa — do not cite either, and note the point is moot since the circular is superseded by Permenkumham 22/2023. (2) The index code 'E33' appears NOWHERE in Permenkumham 22/2023 or 11/2024 on a full-text search; index codes are set at Directorate-General level in the e-visa system and could not be sourced. Publish the article number and the threshold, not the index code. Work rights were not verified — do not assert them. FOR THE PER-PROVINCE MINIMUM PRICES, SEE THE FIELD BELOW: Mechanism verified, figures NOT. Permen ATR/BPN No. 18 of 2021 art.187(2) provides that the price of the residential house 'ditetapkan dengan Keputusan Menteri' — is set by Ministerial Decision, not in the regulation itself. The operative instrument is Keputusan Menteri ATR/BPN No. 1241/SK-HK.02/IX/2022, whose existence and citation were confirmed from a scanned Directorate-General circular (Dirjen Penetapan Hak dan Pendaftaran Tanah, letter HR.01/1963/XI/2022 of 1 November 2022) issued to implement art.187(2). The per-province figures themselves could NOT be verified: the ATR/BPN JDIH portal was unreachable throughout and Kepmen 1241 is not indexed on peraturan.bpk.go.id. CRITICAL — the widely-circulated table giving DKI Jakarta landed IDR 10bn and Bali IDR 5bn comes from the Annex to Permen ATR/BPN No. 29 of 2016, which BPK records as REVOKED by Permen 18/2021. Do not publish those figures.
programmes.notes_zh: 草稿之核心數字已被取代。20 億印尼盾為 2022 年開辦時之數字，2026 年已不適用。現行規範以美元而非印尼盾訂定門檻：國營銀行存款 13 萬美元，或區分所有權單元／公寓 100 萬美元。20 億印尼盾僅是當時以約 15,400 印尼盾兌 1 美元換算之同一存款金額。不得以 20 億印尼盾作為現行數字刊載。第二項更正：該許可最長為 5 年而非 10 年。第三項：本計畫並未被黃金簽證吸收。「第二家園」（第 33 條第 2 項第 j 款）與投資人 5 年及 10 年簽證（第 33 條第 2 項第 e 款）係同一條例下之不同類別，且均仍有效。兩項引註刻意不予刊載：(1) 2022 年第 IMI-0740.GR.01.01 號通函無法自任何來源取得或確認，且一份二級印尼來源就同一簽證引用不同文號（2022 年第 IMI-0820.GR.01.01 號）——兩者均不得引用；且因該通函已為《2023 年第 22 號部長條例》所取代，此點已無實益。(2) 索引代碼「E33」經全文檢索並未出現於《2023 年第 22 號》或《2024 年第 11 號》部長條例；索引代碼係由總局於電子簽證系統層級設定，無法取得來源。應刊載條號與門檻，而非索引代碼。工作權未經查證，不得主張。各省最低價格詳見下列欄位：機制已查證，數字未查證。《2021 年第 18 號部長條例》第 187 條第 2 項規定，住宅價格「由部長決定書訂定」，而非規定於該條例本身。實際依據為第 1241/SK-HK.02/IX/2022 號農業及空間規劃部長決定書，其存在與引註係自總局掃描版通函（土地權利設定及登記總局 2022 年 11 月 1 日 HR.01/1963/XI/2022 號函，為施行第 187 條第 2 項而發）確認。各省具體金額無法查證：農業及空間規劃部法規資訊入口全程無法連通，且第 1241 號部長決定書未收錄於 peraturan.bpk.go.id。關鍵提醒——流傳甚廣之「雅加達有地住宅 100 億印尼盾、峇里島 50 億印尼盾」表格，出自《2016 年第 29 號部長條例》附件，而審計署記載該條例已由第 18/2021 號條例廢止。不得刊載該等數字。

Property is one of four alternatives; the other three are Indonesian government bonds, shares in an Indonesian listed company, or mutual funds, each at US$700,000.

extra_tiers.label_en: THE 5-YEAR TIER, WHICH HAS NO PROPERTY OPTION AT ALL. There is no property limb. US$350,000 buys securities, not real estate.

For reference, the company-forming investor tiers, which are not property routes: US$2,500,000 for the 5-year visa and US$5,000,000 for the 10-year visa; for a corporate director or commissioner, US$25,000,000 (5-year) and US$50,000,000 (10-year).

ownership_form.text_en: No Hak Milik (freehold over land) for foreigners — this is absolute. Permen ATR/BPN No. 18 of 2021 art.185: a foreigner holding valid immigration documents may own a landed house (rumah tapak) only on Hak Pakai — over State land, over Hak Milik by PPAT deed, or over Hak Pengelolaan — and may own a strata unit (rumah susun) built on Hak Pakai OR Hak Guna Bangunan land. Art.188(1): a strata unit owned by a foreigner on HP or HGB land is issued Hak Milik atas Satuan Rumah Susun (SHMSRS). Note a widening versus the older rule: since PP 18/2021 and Permen 18/2021, foreign strata ownership is permitted over HGB land as well as Hak Pakai. Art.186 limits landed houses to the luxury category, one plot per person or family, maximum 2,000 m2 (waivable by the Minister for exceptional economic impact), and limits strata to commercial rumah susun.
ownership_form.text_zh: 外國人不得取得土地之 Hak Milik（完全所有權），此為絕對限制。《2021 年農業及空間規劃部/國家土地局第 18 號部長條例》第 185 條：持有效移民文件之外國人，僅得以 Hak Pakai（使用權）持有有地住宅（rumah tapak）——包括國有地、經 PPAT 契據設定於 Hak Milik 之上者，或設定於 Hak Pengelolaan 之上者——並得持有建於 Hak Pakai 或 Hak Guna Bangunan（建物權）土地上之區分所有權單元（rumah susun）。第 188 條第 1 項：外國人持有之區分所有權單元，若坐落於 HP 或 HGB 土地，核發 SHMSRS（區分所有權完全所有權狀）。相較舊制已放寬：自第 18/2021 號政府條例及第 18/2021 號部長條例起，外國人之區分所有權亦得設定於 HGB 土地，而不限於 Hak Pakai。第 186 條並將有地住宅限於豪宅類別、每人或每一家庭 1 筆、最大 2,000 平方公尺（部長得就具重大經濟效益者豁免），區分所有權則限於商業型 rumah susun。

programmes.notes_en: THE USD 1,000,000 FIGURE IS CONFIRMED, BUT THE DRAFT'S TIER STRUCTURE IS WRONG. There are not two property sub-tiers at US$350,000 and US$1,000,000. Property appears ONLY at the 10-year tier and ONLY at US$1,000,000; the US$350,000 figure is the 5-year tier and buys securities — government bonds, listed shares or mutual funds — with no property limb whatsoever. The asset is also narrower than 'residential property': the text says 'rumah susun atau apartemen', a strata unit or apartment, which is consistent with the underlying land law, since a foreigner cannot hold Hak Milik over land. A CAVEAT WORTH PUBLISHING: each threshold article ends with a delegation providing that the amounts are 'ditetapkan oleh Direktur Jenderal setelah berkoordinasi dengan kementerian atau lembaga terkait' — set by the Director General after coordination with relevant ministries or agencies. The Director General can therefore change these figures by decree without amending the regulation. No such decree was found, but the amounts are not fixed at ministerial level and should be re-checked before reliance. INDEX CODE NOT PUBLISHED: the strings 'E28', 'E28C' and 'E33' appear nowhere in Permenkumham 22/2023 or 11/2024 on a full-text search. They are e-visa system index codes set at Directorate-General level; no .go.id page listing them could be reached. Publish the threshold and the article number, not the index code. NOTE THE CONVERGENCE: the Second Home permit's property limb and this Golden Visa property limb are both US$1,000,000 for a strata unit or apartment. What differs is the term — 5 years versus 10 — and the fact that Second Home offers a US$130,000 deposit alternative while this route's cheapest non-property alternative is US$700,000. Mechanism verified, figures NOT. Permen ATR/BPN No. 18 of 2021 art.187(2) provides that the price of the residential house 'ditetapkan dengan Keputusan Menteri' — is set by Ministerial Decision, not in the regulation itself. The operative instrument is Keputusan Menteri ATR/BPN No. 1241/SK-HK.02/IX/2022, whose existence and citation were confirmed from a scanned Directorate-General circular (Dirjen Penetapan Hak dan Pendaftaran Tanah, letter HR.01/1963/XI/2022 of 1 November 2022) issued to implement art.187(2). The per-province figures themselves could NOT be verified: the ATR/BPN JDIH portal was unreachable throughout and Kepmen 1241 is not indexed on peraturan.bpk.go.id. CRITICAL — the widely-circulated table giving DKI Jakarta landed IDR 10bn and Bali IDR 5bn comes from the Annex to Permen ATR/BPN No. 29 of 2016, which BPK records as REVOKED by Permen 18/2021. Do not publish those figures.
programmes.notes_zh: 100 萬美元之數字已確認，惟草稿之級距結構有誤。並不存在 35 萬美元與 100 萬美元兩個不動產子級距。不動產僅出現於 10 年期級距，且僅為 100 萬美元；35 萬美元係 5 年期級距，購買標的為有價證券——政府公債、上市股票或共同基金——完全無不動產選項。標的範圍亦較「住宅不動產」為窄：條文用語為「rumah susun atau apartemen」（區分所有權單元或公寓），此與土地法制一致，因外國人不得就土地取得 Hak Milik。一項值得刊載之保留：各門檻條文末均有授權規定，載明金額「由總局長於與相關部會或機構協調後訂定」。故總局長得以決定書變更該等金額而無須修正條例。本次未查得此類決定書，惟該等金額並非固定於部長層級，援用前應重新查核。索引代碼不予刊載：經全文檢索，「E28」、「E28C」、「E33」等字串並未出現於《2023 年第 22 號》或《2024 年第 11 號》部長條例。該等代碼係由總局於電子簽證系統層級設定，且無法連通任何列載該等代碼之 .go.id 頁面。應刊載門檻與條號，而非索引代碼。請注意其匯流：第二家園許可之不動產選項與本黃金簽證之不動產選項，同為區分所有權單元或公寓 100 萬美元。差異在於期限（5 年對 10 年），以及第二家園另提供 13 萬美元存款替代方案，而本途徑最低之非不動產替代方案為 70 萬美元。機制已查證，數字未查證。《2021 年第 18 號部長條例》第 187 條第 2 項規定，住宅價格「由部長決定書訂定」，而非規定於該條例本身。實際依據為第 1241/SK-HK.02/IX/2022 號農業及空間規劃部長決定書，其存在與引註係自總局掃描版通函（土地權利設定及登記總局 2022 年 11 月 1 日 HR.01/1963/XI/2022 號函，為施行第 187 條第 2 項而發）確認。各省具體金額無法查證：農業及空間規劃部法規資訊入口全程無法連通，且第 1241 號部長決定書未收錄於 peraturan.bpk.go.id。關鍵提醒——流傳甚廣之「雅加達有地住宅 100 億印尼盾、峇里島 50 億印尼盾」表格，出自《2016 年第 29 號部長條例》附件，而審計署記載該條例已由第 18/2021 號條例廢止。不得刊載該等數字。

min_value.basis: KRW 1,000,000,000 (10억 원), and it is now UNIFORM across every designated zone — the older split under which some zones took KRW 500 million no longer exists. The Korea Visa Portal describes the scheme as granting Residence (F-2) status, permitting free economic activity, to a foreigner who invests at or above the threshold amount in designated investment property (tourism and resort facilities) within an investment zone designated and published by the Minister of Justice, and granting Permanent Residence (F-5) status according to set criteria where the investment is maintained for five years.

extra_tiers.label_en: A DIFFERENT SCHEME, listed here only to keep the two apart — the Public Business Investment Immigration programme (공익사업 투자이민제), which is NOT a property route. Ministry of Justice: 'the standard investment amount is KRW 1.5 billion or more (for high-value investment immigration, KRW 3 billion or more)'. The general route gives F-2 then F-5 after five years maintained, and the F-5 survives repayment of the principal once the five years have elapsed; the high-value route gives F-5 directly, conditional on holding for five years, and the F-5 is cancelled if the money is returned before then.

term.text_en: F-2 residence status on investment, converting to F-5 permanent residence after five years of maintained investment.
term.text_zh: 投資後取得 F-2 居住資格，投資維持滿 5 年後轉換為 F-5 永久居留資格。

leads_to.text_en: F-5 permanent residence after five years, and this is a genuine PR outcome rather than a renewable long-stay permit — which makes this route materially different from most others in this dataset. The investment must be MAINTAINED: the portal notes that pledging the asset as security, having it seized, or borrowing against it breaks the maintenance condition.
leads_to.text_zh: 5 年後取得 F-5 永久居留，且此為真正之永久居留結果而非可續延之長期居留許可——此點使本途徑與本資料集中多數途徑有實質差異。投資須持續維持：入口網註明設定擔保、遭查封或以之借款，均將使「維持投資」之條件不成立。

ownership_form.text_en: Investment must be in designated investment property — tourism and resort facilities — inside a zone designated and published by the Minister of Justice. This is not general residential real estate: ordinary housing outside a designated zone does not qualify no matter its value.
ownership_form.text_zh: 投資標的須為法務部長官指定並公告之投資地區內之指定投資不動產（觀光休閒設施）。此非一般住宅不動產：指定地區以外之一般住宅，無論價值多高均不符合資格。

programmes.notes_en: THE THRESHOLD IS SOLID; WHETHER THE SCHEME IS CURRENTLY OPEN IS NOT. Confidence is medium for that reason alone. THE ZONE AND EXPIRY QUESTION COULD NOT BE RESOLVED, and both sides are on the record, so both are reported. VERSION 1 — the Ministry of Justice's own operational Korea Visa Portal, read on 1 August 2026, lists eleven designations all at KRW 1 billion with these operating periods: Gangwon Mangsang to 31 Dec 2025 (lapsed); Gangwon Yongpyong Tourism Complex to 31 MARCH 2030; Jeju to 30 Apr 2026; Busan Osiria East Busan Tourism Complex to 19 May 2026; Yeosu Hwayang to 31 Dec 2025 (lapsed); Busan Haeundae Tourism Resort to 19 May 2026; Incheon Songdo, Cheongna and Yeongjong each to 30 Apr 2026; Yeosu Gyeongdo Marine Tourism Complex to 30 Apr 2026; and Gangwon Pyeongchang Alpensia to 30 Apr 2026. On that data most designations had ALREADY EXPIRED on 30 April or 19 May 2026 — that is, before today. VERSION 2 — Jeju Province announced on 17 February 2026 that the scheme's operating period is extended from 30 April to 31 DECEMBER 2027 with investment amount and eligible assets unchanged, and Korean media report the extension came via a Ministry of Justice notice (고시) dated 8 February 2026 covering five regions in a single instrument: Jeju; Busan Osiria; Incheon Yeongjong, Songdo and Cheongna; Gangwon Pyeongchang and Donghae; and Jeonnam Yeosu Gyeongdo and Hwayang. THE TWO HAVE NOT BEEN RECONCILED. The underlying zone-designation notice could not be located: these designations are gazetted in the 관보 rather than posted on the Ministry's notice board, and the only related instrument on the national law information centre is the PROCEDURAL notice 법무부고시 제2023-237호 setting the designation procedure, not the zone list or dates. Note also that a blanket 'all zones extended to end-2027' framing is inconsistent with the portal's own entry for Yongpyong, which runs to 31 March 2030. ANYONE ACTING ON THIS MUST CONFIRM WITH THE RELEVANT IMMIGRATION OFFICE BEFORE COMMITTING CAPITAL. SEPARATE CORRECTION: the draft's KRW 500 million and KRW 300 million figures for the public-business route are wrong — that scheme runs at KRW 1.5 billion and KRW 3 billion, and it is a bond and public-fund route, not property.
programmes.notes_zh: 門檻確實，但制度目前是否開放並不確實。可信度列為中等即因於此。地區指定與到期問題無法解決，且雙方各有官方記載，故並陳。版本一——法務部自身之簽證入口網（2026 年 8 月 1 日讀取）列出 11 處指定地區，金額均為 10 億韓元，施行期間如下：江原望祥地區至 2025 年 12 月 31 日（已失效）；江原龍平觀光園區至 2030 年 3 月 31 日；濟州至 2026 年 4 月 30 日；釜山 Osiria 東釜山觀光園區至 2026 年 5 月 19 日；麗水華陽地區至 2025 年 12 月 31 日（已失效）；釜山海雲台觀光度假村至 2026 年 5 月 19 日；仁川松島、青蘿、永宗各至 2026 年 4 月 30 日；麗水鏡島海洋觀光園區至 2026 年 4 月 30 日；江原平昌 Alpensia 至 2026 年 4 月 30 日。依此資料，多數指定已於 2026 年 4 月 30 日或 5 月 19 日屆期，即在今日之前。版本二——濟州道於 2026 年 2 月 17 日公告，該制度施行期間自 4 月 30 日延長至 2027 年 12 月 31 日，投資金額與投資標的維持現行標準；韓國媒體並報導該延長係經法務部 2026 年 2 月 8 日之告示，以單一文件涵蓋五個地區：濟州；釜山 Osiria；仁川永宗、松島、青蘿；江原平昌、東海；全南麗水鏡島、華陽。兩者尚未調和。相關地區指定告示無法查得：該等指定係刊載於官報而非公告於部會公告欄，而國家法令資訊中心上唯一相關文件為程序性之法務部告示第 2023-237 號，僅規定指定程序，未載地區清單或期限。另請注意，「所有地區一律延至 2027 年底」之表述與入口網自身之龍平條目（至 2030 年 3 月 31 日）並不一致。任何據此行動者，投入資金前必須向主管出入境暨外國人事務廳確認。另一項更正：草稿就公益事業途徑所載之 5 億韓元與 3 億韓元均為錯誤——該制度金額為 15 億韓元與 30 億韓元，且屬公債及公益基金途徑，非不動產。

programmes.programme_zh: 黃金簽證（房產投資人路徑）

min_value.basis: Purchase value of the property at the time of purchase; property must be wholly owned by the applicant, and one or more properties may be combined to reach the threshold

term.text_en: DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN TWO TIER-1 SOURCES. Dubai Land Department, which operates the application channel, states a '10-years renewable residence permit' and publishes a fee schedule for a 10-year permit (AED 9,884.75 total). ICP, the federal immigration authority, publishes a category table reading 'Investors in Public Investments or Real Estate — 10 years (public investments) / 5 years (real estate investments)'; the identical table is reproduced on the u.ae government portal (updated 28 July 2026, sourced to ICP). Both readings are cited below; do not publish a single figure.
term.text_zh: 兩個一級來源互相矛盾。負責受理申請的杜拜土地局（DLD）寫「10 年可續期居留許可」，並按 10 年許可收費（合計 AED 9,884.75）。聯邦身分公民海關與港口安全總局（ICP）的類別表則寫「公共投資或房地產投資人——公共投資 10 年／房地產投資 5 年」，u.ae 政府入口網站（2026 年 7 月 28 日更新，註明來源為 ICP）沿用同一張表。兩種說法並列，不得只寫一個數字。

stay.text_en: Could not be verified from any UAE government source consulted. ICP lists 'long-term residency without the need for a sponsor' among the benefits and u.ae lists 'the ability to stay outside the UAE for more than the usual period of six months needed to keep their residence visa valid', but neither states a numeric minimum-stay rule, and neither states that there is none. The widely repeated claim of 'no minimum stay' was not found in any official text.
stay.text_zh: 在所查閱的任何阿聯政府來源中都無法查證。ICP 列出的權益包括「無需擔保人的長期居留」，u.ae 列出「可在境外停留超過通常維持居留效力所需的六個月上限」，但兩者都未寫出具體的最低居留天數規則，也都沒有明說不存在此規則。廣為流傳的「無最低居留要求」說法，在官方文本中查無依據。

leads_to.text_en: No naturalisation pathway is attached to the Golden Visa in any source consulted. UAE citizenship is granted only under a separate discretionary nomination regime and is not an entitlement arising from this visa. Not verified further.
leads_to.text_zh: 所查來源中，黃金簽證本身不附帶入籍途徑。阿聯國籍另循一套裁量性提名制度授予，並非本簽證衍生的權利。未進一步查證。

ownership_form.text_en: Freehold, but only within designated areas: foreign nationals may hold freehold title only in areas designated for non-GCC ownership in each emirate. This general rule was NOT verified against a government source in this pass; what IS tier-1 verified is that DLD requires 'a certificate of ownership of the real estate from the competent authority' (an e-Certificate of Title / title deed) and that the property be wholly owned by the applicant. Treat the designated-areas point as unverified.
ownership_form.text_zh: 自由保有產權，但僅限指定區域：外籍人士僅能在各酋長國劃定供非海合會國民持有的區域內取得自由保有產權。此一般性規則本次未對照政府來源查證；經一級來源確認的是 DLD 要求提交「主管機關出具的不動產所有權證明」（產權電子證書／地契），且物業須由申請人完全持有。指定區域一節請視為未查證。

offplan.text_en: NOT CONFIRMED — and the available official evidence points the other way. The Dubai Land Department service page requires an 'e-Certificate of Title / Title deed' and, where the property is mortgaged, 'a bank letter indicating 2 million AED paid amount as a proof'. That wording is byte-identical in the Internet Archive captures of 7 January 2026 and 8 July 2026 — i.e. the competent authority's own published conditions did not change across the period in which a February-2026 liberalisation is said to have occurred. See notes for the full finding.
offplan.text_zh: 未獲證實——且現有官方證據指向相反方向。杜拜土地局服務頁要求提交「產權電子證書／地契」，若物業有貸款，則須提交「載明已付款 200 萬迪拉姆的銀行證明函」。此段文字在網際網路檔案館 2026 年 1 月 7 日與 2026 年 7 月 8 日兩份快照中逐字相同——亦即在所謂 2026 年 2 月放寬的期間前後，主管機關自己公布的條件並未改動。完整結論見備註。

mortgage.text_en: Mortgaged property is accepted. DLD service terms: 'The property may be mortgaged, and a no-objection bank letter to be submitted indicating that the bank does not object to issuing a residence permit on the property, indicating the paid amount and the balance.' The service description adds that the bank letter must indicate 'a 2 million AED paid amount as a proof'. No official UAE source consulted mentions a 50%-paid rule, either before or after February 2026 — the '50% rule' does not appear in any government text located.
mortgage.text_zh: 接受有貸款的物業。DLD 服務條款：「物業可設有抵押，須提交銀行無異議函，載明銀行不反對就該物業核發居留許可，並載明已付金額與餘額。」服務說明另要求銀行函載明「已付 200 萬迪拉姆作為證明」。所查閱的阿聯官方來源中，無論 2026 年 2 月之前或之後，都未出現「已付 50%」的規定——所謂「50% 規則」在已定位的任何政府文本中都不存在。

dependants.text_en: Spouse, children and parents may be sponsored (DLD). ICP additionally lists the ability to issue residency for spouse and children among the Golden Visa benefits. Family applications require a no-objection letter from the father where applicable.
dependants.text_zh: 可為配偶、子女與父母申請依親（DLD）。ICP 另將為配偶與子女核發居留列為黃金簽證權益之一。依親申請在適用情形下須附父親出具的無異議函。

entry_tax.text_en: Not covered by this research pass. DLD publishes only the visa service fee (AED 9,884.75 in total for the 10-year permit, covering medical examination, Emirates ID, residency confirmation, departmental and administrative charges). Dubai's 4% property transfer fee was not verified in this pass and is deliberately omitted rather than asserted.
entry_tax.text_zh: 本次研究未涵蓋。DLD 僅公布簽證服務費（10 年許可合計 AED 9,884.75，含體檢、Emirates ID、居留確認、部門與行政規費）。杜拜 4% 產權過戶費本次未查證，故刻意略去而不逕行宣稱。

last_change.text_en: The governing instrument is Cabinet Resolution No. 65 of 2022 issuing the Executive Regulation of Federal Decree-Law No. 29 of 2021 on entry and residence of foreigners: issued 12 July 2022, published in Official Gazette No. 731 of 15 July 2022, in force 3 October 2022 — which matches the reported 'October 2022' change. Its Article 77 provides that the Golden Residence Permit is governed by the Annex to the resolution. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the Annex is published only as a PDF that could not be text-extracted, so the AED 2,000,000 figure itself could NOT be traced into the gazetted text; it is sourced to ICP and DLD instead. The official legislation portal records the resolution as last updated 27 November 2025 with five recorded amendments — no 2026 amendment is listed. The claim that the threshold was cut from AED 10,000,000 was not independently verified in this pass and is not published.
last_change.text_zh: 母法為 2022 年第 65 號內閣決議，發布 2021 年第 29 號聯邦法令（外國人入境與居留）之施行細則：2022 年 7 月 12 日發布，刊登於 2022 年 7 月 15 日第 731 號官方公報，2022 年 10 月 3 日生效——與報導的「2022 年 10 月」改動時點吻合。其第 77 條規定黃金居留許可適用該決議之附件。重要保留：該附件僅以 PDF 形式公布且無法擷取文字，因此 AED 2,000,000 這個數字本身無法回溯到公報文本，改以 ICP 與 DLD 為來源。官方法規入口網站記載該決議最後更新日為 2025 年 11 月 27 日，共五次修正，未列任何 2026 年修正。門檻由 AED 10,000,000 調降的說法本次未獨立查證，故不予刊登。

short.term_zh: 兩筆第一級來源不一致：杜拜土地部稱 10 年，聯邦身分安全與海關港口總局稱 5 年

programmes.notes_en: THE FEBRUARY-2026 QUESTION — ANSWER: NOT CONFIRMED, with affirmative contrary evidence. (1) No official UAE text was located that removes a 50%-paid requirement in February 2026. (2) No official UAE text was located that ever imposed a 50%-paid requirement in the first place — the '50% rule' appears nowhere in ICP, u.ae, DLD or the Executive Regulation. (3) The official legislation portal shows Cabinet Resolution 65/2022 last updated 27 November 2025 with five amendments and no 2026 amendment. (4) Decisively: the Dubai Land Department 'Golden Visa application - Investor' service page — the actual application channel, and the competent authority for valuation — carries word-for-word identical text in the Internet Archive captures of 7 January 2026 (before) and 8 July 2026 (after), including the requirement that a mortgaged property be evidenced by 'a bank letter indicating 2 million AED paid amount as a proof' and service terms requiring the bank NOC to indicate 'the paid amount and the balance'. If a February-2026 liberalisation had taken effect, DLD's own conditions page did not reflect it five months later. (5) Every source asserting the change is a tier-3 agency or marketing blog, and they do not agree with each other on the date (20 February vs 22 February 2026). RECOMMENDATION: publish as unconfirmed, and note that DLD still requires the bank letter to evidence the paid amount. THE APRIL-2026 QUESTION: not verified at all — no source of any tier was located for an April 2026 decision. What can be said at tier 1 is that Article 53 of the Executive Regulation (the separate 'Foreigner Real Estate Owner Residence Permit', a different and shorter permit from the Golden Visa) sets NO minimum property value in its current published text: it requires only that the property be fully built, not vacant land, wholly owned, habitable, evidenced by a certificate of ownership, and that the applicant have monthly income of at least AED 10,000 or prove financial solvency. So no AED 750,000 floor exists in the current regulation — but the portal's last-update date of 27 November 2025 means this absence predates April 2026 and does not evidence an April 2026 change. LAPSE ON SALE: not verified. No government source consulted states that the visa lapses if the qualifying asset is sold; this commonly repeated point is therefore omitted rather than asserted. WORK RIGHTS: ICP states holders enjoy 'freedom to live, work, study, and invest in the UAE' — tier 1, src 0.
programmes.notes_zh: 2026 年 2 月的問題——答案：未獲證實，且有反向的正面證據。（1）未能定位到任何在 2026 年 2 月取消「已付 50%」要求的阿聯官方文本。（2）也未能定位到任何曾經課予「已付 50%」要求的阿聯官方文本——ICP、u.ae、DLD 與施行細則中都查無「50% 規則」。（3）官方法規入口網站顯示 2022 年第 65 號內閣決議最後更新於 2025 年 11 月 27 日，共五次修正，無 2026 年修正。（4）關鍵證據：杜拜土地局「黃金簽證申請——投資人」服務頁（實際受理管道，也是估值主管機關）在網際網路檔案館 2026 年 1 月 7 日（前）與 2026 年 7 月 8 日（後）兩份快照中逐字相同，包含有貸款物業須以「載明已付款 200 萬迪拉姆的銀行證明函」佐證，以及服務條款要求銀行無異議函載明「已付金額與餘額」。若 2026 年 2 月的放寬確已生效，DLD 自家的條件頁在五個月後仍未反映。（5）所有主張此變動的來源皆為三級仲介或行銷部落格，且彼此連日期都不一致（2 月 20 日對 2 月 22 日）。建議：以「未獲證實」刊登，並註明 DLD 迄今仍要求以銀行函佐證已付金額。2026 年 4 月的問題：完全未獲證實——任何層級的來源都未能定位到 2026 年 4 月的決定。可在一級來源層次陳述的是：施行細則第 53 條（另一項「外籍不動產所有權人居留許可」，與黃金簽證不同且期限較短）在現行公布文本中並未設定任何最低物業價值，僅要求物業已完工、非空地、完全持有、可居住、附所有權證明，且申請人月收入不低於 AED 10,000 或能證明財務能力。因此現行法規中不存在 AED 750,000 門檻——但入口網站最後更新日為 2025 年 11 月 27 日，代表此一「不存在」早於 2026 年 4 月，不能用來佐證 2026 年 4 月有任何改動。出售資產後失效：未獲證實。所查政府來源皆未說明出售合格資產後簽證即失效，故此一常見說法予以略去而不逕行宣稱。工作權：ICP 載明持有人享有「在阿聯居住、工作、就學與投資的自由」——一級來源，src 0。

programmes.notes_en: Included because it is the instrument the reported 'AED 750,000 two-year investor visa' would sit in, and because its full conditions are readable at tier 1 while the Golden Visa Annex is not. The full Article 53 text is: the permit issues without a guarantor/host party where (1) the real estate is fully built and does not include vacant land owners; (2) a certificate of ownership from the competent registration authority is submitted; (3) the real estate is wholly owned by the applicant; (4) the real estate is habitable; (5) the applicant has monthly income of not less than AED 10,000 or its foreign-currency equivalent, or proves financial solvency throughout his stay. Confidence is medium only because term and stay could not be established, not because the conditions are doubtful — those are verbatim from the gazetted regulation.
programmes.notes_zh: 納入的理由：報導中的「AED 750,000 兩年投資人簽證」若存在，法源即在此條；且此條的完整條件在一級來源可讀，而黃金簽證附件不可讀。第 53 條全文為：在無擔保人／接待方的情況下核發居留許可，須符合（1）不動產已完工且不包含空地所有權人；（2）提交登記主管機關出具的所有權證明；（3）不動產由申請人完全持有；（4）不動產適於居住；（5）申請人月收入不低於 AED 10,000 或等值外幣，或能證明在境內停留期間的財務能力。信心度僅列為 medium，是因為期限與居留要求無法確立，而非條件本身有疑——條件係逐字取自公報法規。

leads_to.text_en: This property route grants RESIDENCY only. Jordan does separately operate a Citizenship by Investment Programme, introduced in 2018, under which 681 investors had been granted citizenship as at the date of this announcement — but the routes to citizenship in the revised criteria are other instruments (notably the Amman Stock Exchange route, whose threshold was raised in the same decision), not the property purchase described here. Do not publish 'property buys Jordanian citizenship'.
leads_to.text_zh: 本不動產路徑僅授予居留權。約旦另設有 2018 年推出的投資入籍計畫，截至本公告日已有 681 名投資人循此取得公民身分——但修訂標準中通往公民身分的是其他工具（尤以安曼證券交易所路徑為主，其門檻在同一決議中調高），並非此處所述的購置不動產。不得刊登「買房可取得約旦國籍」。

ownership_form.text_en: Freehold purchase, valued by the Department of Lands and Survey. The property must be retained for no less than five years and neither sold nor mortgaged during that period. offplan.text_en: Not addressed in the published criteria. Note that value is set by Department of Lands and Survey valuation, which implies a registered, valued property. Deliberately not asserted.

mortgage.text_en: PROHIBITED during the holding period. The property must be 'retained for no less than five years and is neither sold nor mortgaged during that period'. A mortgaged property therefore cannot support this residency.
mortgage.text_zh: 持有期間內禁止設定抵押。物業須「持有不少於五年，且在該期間內不得出售亦不得設定抵押」。因此已設抵押的物業無法支撐此居留權。

dependants.text_en: Not specified for the residency route in the published criteria. (The criteria do detail dependants for the separate citizenship route — spouse, dependent daughters, unmarried sons under 24, dependent parents, and where investment exceeds JOD 2 million also male children under 30 with their spouses and children — but that is the citizenship route, not this one. programmes.notes_en: This entry CORRECTS three claims made by a parallel research sweep. (1) HOLDING PERIOD: the sweep reported '4 years inside the zoning area / 6 outside'. The Invest Jordan text states a single, uniform period: 'retained for no less than five years'. Publish five years. (2) CITIZENSHIP: the sweep reported 'never citizenship'. That is right about this route but wrong as a statement about Jordan, which has run a Citizenship by Investment Programme since 2018 with 681 grants to date; the same Cabinet decision raised the Amman Stock Exchange citizenship threshold. State it as 'this route gives residency; Jordan's citizenship route is a different instrument'. (3) FEES and the Minister of Interior approval step: not present in the Invest Jordan text and not published. The three thresholds themselves (JOD 150,000 / 200,000 / 300,000) and their triggers are confirmed verbatim at tier 1 and match the sweep.
programmes.notes_zh: 本條修正另一路研究的三項說法。（1）持有期間：該路研究報稱「分區內 4 年／區外 6 年」。Invest Jordan 文本載明單一且一致的期間：「持有不少於五年」。應刊登五年。（2）公民身分：該路研究稱「絕不授予公民身分」。就本路徑而言正確，但作為對約旦整體的陳述則有誤——約旦自 2018 年起即設有投資入籍計畫，迄今已核發 681 例；同一份內閣決議並調高了安曼證交所的入籍門檻。正確寫法為「本路徑給居留權；約旦的入籍路徑是另一套工具」。（3）規費與內政部長核准程序：未見於 Invest Jordan 文本，不予刊登。三檔門檻本身（JOD 150,000／200,000／300,000）及其適用條件，已在一級來源逐字確認，且與該路研究一致。

sources.publisher: Invest Jordan / Ministry of Investment — 'Cabinet Approves Amendments to the Criteria for Granting Residency and Jordanian Citizenship to Investors'

programmes.programme: Property-linked residency (two tiers, under the non-Qatari real estate ownership regime)
programmes.programme_zh: 不動產連結居留（兩檔門檻，隸屬非卡達人不動產所有權制度）

min_value.basis: Real Estate Regulatory Authority, verbatim: 'Residency tied to property is granted for properties valued at 730,000 Qatari Riyals (equivalent to 200,000 US Dollars).' The USD equivalent is the authority's own.

extra_tiers.label_en: Higher tier — PERMANENT RESIDENCY BENEFITS ONLY, not a permanent residency card. Authority verbatim: 'Permanent residency benefits are available for properties valued at no less than 3,650,000 Qatari Riyals (equivalent to 1 million US Dollars), which include benefits related to health, education, and investment.'
extra_tiers.label_zh: 高檔門檻——僅取得永久居留「權益」，並非永久居留卡。主管機關原文：「不動產價值不低於 3,650,000 卡達里亞爾（相當於 100 萬美元）者，可享永久居留權益，包括醫療、教育與投資方面的權益。」

term.text_en: NOT ESTABLISHED. The Real Estate Regulatory Authority publishes no term or renewal cycle for either tier, and no other tier-1 Qatari source was opened in this pass. Deliberately omitted rather than estimated.
term.text_zh: 未能確立。不動產監理總署未就任一檔門檻公布期限或續期週期，本次亦未能開啟其他卡達一級來源。故刻意略去而不作估算。

stay.text_en: REPORTED at 90 days per year, published here only because two independent tier-2 sources agree: the US Department of State's 2025 Investment Climate Statement for Qatar ('provided they reside in Qatar for a minimum of 90 days a year', in the context of the 730,000-riyal usufruct threshold) and Fragomen, the immigration law firm ('They must reside in Qatar for at least 90 days annually'). The requirement does NOT appear in the Qatari Real Estate Regulatory Authority's own text. The two sources also differ in emphasis on which tier the rule attaches to — State ties it to the lower threshold, Fragomen to the permanent-residency tier. Treat 90 days as the working figure, not as a verified statutory rule.
stay.text_zh: 報導值為每年 90 天，此處刊登僅因兩個彼此獨立的二級來源說法一致：美國國務院《2025 年卡達投資環境報告》（在 73 萬里亞爾用益權門檻的脈絡下稱「須每年在卡達居住至少 90 天」）與移民律師事務所 Fragomen（「須每年在卡達居住至少 90 天」）。此要求並未出現在卡達不動產監理總署自身的文本中。兩來源對此規則附著於哪一檔門檻的側重也不同——國務院繫於較低門檻，Fragomen 繫於永久居留檔。請將 90 天視為工作假設值，而非已查證的法定規則。

leads_to.text_en: Residency only. Critically, the higher QAR 3,650,000 tier does NOT confer a permanent residency card: the authority's wording is 'permanent residency BENEFITS ... which include benefits related to health, education, and investment'. The Qatari permanent residency card is governed by a separate statute — Law No. (10) of 2018 on Permanent Residency — which appears as its own entry in the authority's legislation index, distinct from Law No. (16) of 2018 on non-Qatari real estate ownership. Do not publish 'buy property for QAR 3.65m and get Qatari permanent residency'.
leads_to.text_zh: 僅取得居留權。關鍵在於：QAR 3,650,000 這一檔並不授予永久居留卡；主管機關的用語是「永久居留『權益』……包括醫療、教育與投資方面的權益」。卡達的永久居留卡另有法源——2018 年第 10 號永久居留法，在主管機關的法規索引中自成一條，與規範非卡達人不動產所有權的 2018 年第 16 號法律有別。不得刊登「花 365 萬里亞爾買房即可取得卡達永久居留」。

ownership_form.text_en: Freehold within designated areas, plus a separate usufruct regime. The authority's project page states 'Non-Qataris are allowed to own real estate in (9) specific areas' and separately that 'Non-Qataris have the right to use real estate in (16) areas, and the use of the real estate shall be for a period not exceeding (99) years, renewable'. NOTE THE INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY, which is the actual answer to the 9-versus-10 question: the same page's prose still says nine, while the accompanying list already includes the Simaisma Resort & Beach Project (zone 70) as a tenth entry. The list has been updated for Cabinet Decision 21/2026; the sentence counting the areas has not. Publish 'nine listed in the authority's prose, ten in its own list following the 2026 amendment' rather than picking a number.
ownership_form.text_zh: 指定區域內的自由保有產權，另有一套獨立的用益權制度。主管機關的建案頁載明「非卡達人得在（9）個特定區域持有不動產」，並另載「非卡達人得在（16）個區域享有不動產使用權，使用期限不超過（99）年，可續期」。請注意其內部矛盾——這正是「9 個還是 10 個」問題的真正答案：同一頁的敘述文字仍寫九個，但隨附清單已納入西邁斯馬度假村與海灘專案（第 70 號分區）作為第十筆。清單已依 2026 年第 21 號內閣決議更新，計數的那句話則尚未更新。應刊登「主管機關敘述文字寫九個，其自身清單在 2026 年修正後為十個」，而非逕自擇一數字。

offplan.text_en: Not addressed by any Qatari government source consulted. Deliberately omitted.
offplan.text_zh: 所查卡達政府來源皆未處理此點。刻意略去。

mortgage.text_en: Not addressed by any Qatari government source consulted. Deliberately omitted.
mortgage.text_zh: 所查卡達政府來源皆未處理此點。刻意略去。

dependants.text_en: Not stated on the pages consulted. Deliberately omitted.
dependants.text_zh: 所查頁面未載明。刻意略去。

entry_tax.text_en: Not covered by this research pass.
entry_tax.text_zh: 本次研究未涵蓋。

last_change.text_en: CONFIRMED THAT THE INSTRUMENT EXISTS. The Real Estate Regulatory Authority's own legislation index lists, as its most recent entry, 'Cabinet Decision No. (21) of 2026 Amending certain provisions of Decision No. (28) of 2020 on determining the areas in which non-Qataris are permitted to own real estate'. So Cabinet Decision 21/2026 is real and does amend the areas schedule of Decision 28/2020 — that much is tier-1. The reported date of 14 May 2026 for the addition of Simaisma is NOT confirmed and should not be published: every source carrying that date is tier-3 social media, and the wave of such posts dates to late June / July 2026, which sits awkwardly with a mid-May decision. The same index also records two other 2025-26 changes not mentioned in the brief: Law No. (1) of 2025 amending Law No. (16) of 2018, and Cabinet Decision No. (1) of 2025 on GCC citizens' ownership.
last_change.text_zh: 已確認該法令存在。不動產監理總署自身的法規索引以「2026 年第 21 號內閣決議——修正 2020 年第 28 號決議關於劃定非卡達人得持有不動產區域之部分條文」為最新一筆。因此 2026 年第 21 號內閣決議確實存在，且確實修正了第 28 號決議的區域表——此點屬一級來源。至於將西邁斯馬（Simaisma）納入的日期為 2026 年 5 月 14 日之說，未獲證實，不應刊登：載有該日期的來源全為三級社群貼文，而這波貼文集中在 2026 年 6 月底至 7 月，與 5 月中旬的決議日期在時序上並不相稱。同一索引另記載簡報未提及的兩項 2025–26 年變動：修正 2018 年第 16 號法律的 2025 年第 1 號法律，以及關於海合會公民持有的 2025 年第 1 號內閣決議。

short.term_en: Not established; the authority publishes no term or renewal cycle
short.term_zh: 未查證；主管機關未公布期限或續期週期
short.stay_en: Reported at 90 days per year on two agreeing tier-2 sources
short.stay_zh: 據兩筆一致之第二級來源，每年 90 天
short.outcome_en: Residency only; the higher tier confers benefits, not a permanent residency card
short.outcome_zh: 僅取得居留權；較高級距給予相關待遇，非永久居留證
short.own_en: Freehold in designated areas; the authority’s own prose and list disagree on how many
short.own_zh: 指定區域內之完全所有權；主管機關敘述文字與其清單所載區域數不一致

programmes.notes_en: WHAT THIS PASS CONFIRMED, all at tier 1 from the Real Estate Regulatory Authority (aqarat.gov.qa), the Qatari body competent for the non-Qatari ownership regime: (1) both thresholds, QAR 730,000 and QAR 3,650,000, verbatim, with the authority's own USD equivalents; (2) THE KEY NUANCE IS CORRECT — the QAR 3.65m tier gives 'permanent residency benefits ... health, education, and investment', not a permanent residency card, and the PR card sits under a separate statute (Law No. 10 of 2018) that appears as its own line in the authority's legislation index; (3) Cabinet Decision No. 21 of 2026 exists and amends Decision No. 28 of 2020 on the areas schedule. WHAT THIS PASS COULD NOT CONFIRM: (a) the article attribution 'Decision 28/2020 Art. 7' — the authority's page carries the substance but not the article number, so cite the authority, not the article; (b) the 14 May 2026 date for Simaisma; (c) the term of either residency; (d) the 90-day presence rule at tier 1 — it rests on two agreeing tier-2 sources and is flagged as such. The freehold count is best reported as the authority's own inconsistency rather than as nine or ten.
programmes.notes_zh: 本次查證確認的事項，全部來自卡達不動產監理總署（aqarat.gov.qa）——非卡達人所有權制度的主管機關——屬一級來源：（1）QAR 730,000 與 QAR 3,650,000 兩檔門檻的逐字內容，含主管機關自訂的美元對價；（2）關鍵細節屬實——365 萬里亞爾這一檔給的是「永久居留權益……醫療、教育與投資」，而非永久居留卡，且永久居留卡另有法源（2018 年第 10 號法律），在主管機關法規索引中自成一條；（3）2026 年第 21 號內閣決議確實存在，且修正 2020 年第 28 號決議的區域表。本次未能確認的事項：（a）「第 28 號決議第 7 條」的條號歸屬——主管機關頁面有實質內容但無條號，故引用時應引主管機關而非條號；（b）西邁斯馬的 2026 年 5 月 14 日日期；（c）兩檔居留權的期限；（d）90 天居留規則在一級來源的依據——該規則立基於兩個說法一致的二級來源，已據此標註。自由保有區域數量以「主管機關自身前後不一致」的形式報導，優於逕自寫九或十。

programmes.programme: Golden Residency — Property Owner route
programmes.programme_zh: 黃金居留——不動產所有權人路徑

min_value.basis: Official programme site, verbatim: 'Real estate investors who own property with a total personal share value of BHD 130,000' or higher.

term.text_en: Permanent. Official programme site, verbatim: 'A permanent residency with no restrictions on length of stay', allowing the holder to 'stay as long as you wish'.
term.text_zh: 永久。官方計畫網站原文：「永久居留權，停留期間不設限制」，持有人可「想住多久就住多久」。

stay.text_en: No minimum stay is imposed. The benefits page states the residency carries 'no restrictions on length of stay'. Note this is a statement about the absence of a cap, phrased as a benefit; the site does not separately assert 'there is no minimum'. The natural reading of a permanent residency with unrestricted length of stay is that no minimum applies, and no minimum appears anywhere on the official site.
stay.text_zh: 不設最低居留天數。權益頁載明該居留權「停留期間不設限制」。請注意：這是以權益的語氣陳述「無上限」，官網並未另行明說「無下限」。永久居留且停留期間不受限制，其自然解讀即為不存在最低居留要求，且官網任何處均未出現最低天數。

leads_to.text_en: Not addressed on the official pages consulted. The programme grants residency and access to a National ID Card; citizenship is not mentioned. Deliberately not asserted either way.
leads_to.text_zh: 所查官方頁面未處理此點。該計畫授予居留權與國民身分證，未提及公民身分。此處刻意不作任何方向的斷言。

ownership_form.text_en: Aggregation across properties IS allowed — this confirms the reported claim. Official site, verbatim: applicants may qualify through 'a single property or multiple properties, provided the combined value of the applicant's shares meets or exceeds the threshold of BHD 130,000.' Note the threshold is measured on the applicant's SHARES, so a part-interest in a larger asset counts at its share value.
ownership_form.text_zh: 確實允許跨物業合併計算——此點證實了報導中的說法。官方網站原文：申請人可透過「單一物業或多個物業」符合資格，「惟申請人各該持分之合計價值須達到或超過 BHD 130,000 門檻」。請注意門檻是以申請人的「持分」衡量，因此持有較大資產的部分權益，按其持分價值計入。

offplan.text_en: Not addressed on the official pages consulted. Deliberately omitted.
offplan.text_zh: 所查官方頁面未處理。刻意略去。

mortgage.text_en: Not addressed on the official pages consulted. Note that the threshold is expressed as the applicant's 'total personal share value', which is an equity concept rather than a purchase-price concept, but no inference is drawn.
mortgage.text_zh: 所查官方頁面未處理。惟門檻的表述為申請人的「個人持分總價值」，屬權益概念而非買價概念，此處不作推論。

dependants.text_en: Benefits extend to 'your spouse, parents, and children', with access to healthcare and education.
dependants.text_zh: 權益及於「配偶、父母與子女」，並可使用醫療與教育資源。

entry_tax.text_en: Not covered by this research pass.
entry_tax.text_zh: 本次研究未涵蓋。

last_change.text_en: THE BHD 200,000 FIGURE IS SUPERSEDED — CONFIRMED, and confirmed from the government's own site on both sides of the change. The official Golden Residency site's own news item of 10 April 2025 described the property-owner category as 'Investors who own real estate in Bahrain valued at BHD 200,000 (equivalent to USD 530,555) or more at the time of purchase'; the same site's current eligibility page states BHD 130,000. The reduction was reported by IMI Daily on 28 November 2025 as a 35% cut from BHD 200,000 to BHD 130,000. Publish BHD 130,000. Anything still quoting BHD 200,000 is quoting the 2022-2025 figure.
last_change.text_zh: BHD 200,000 一數已遭取代——已確認，且在變動前後皆由政府自家網站佐證。官方黃金居留網站 2025 年 4 月 10 日的新聞稿將不動產所有權人類別描述為「於購置時持有巴林境內價值 BHD 200,000（相當於 530,555 美元）以上不動產之投資人」；同一網站現行的資格頁則載明 BHD 130,000。IMI Daily 於 2025 年 11 月 28 日報導此次調降，幅度為由 BHD 200,000 降至 BHD 130,000，減幅 35%。應刊登 BHD 130,000。任何仍引用 BHD 200,000 的資料，引的都是 2022–2025 年的舊值。

short.term_zh: 永久，且不限停留期間
short.outcome_en: Not addressed on the official pages; citizenship is not mentioned
short.outcome_zh: 官方頁面未觸及；未提及公民身分
short.own_en: Measured on the applicant’s shares; multiple properties may be combined
short.own_zh: 以申請人持分計算，得合併多筆物件

programmes.notes_en: Every substantive field here comes from the Bahraini government's own dedicated programme site, goldenresidency.gov.bh, which was reachable from this environment even though the National Portal for Residency Affairs (npra.gov.bh) refuses connections — that refusal is what defeated the previous pass, and it is now moot because goldenresidency.gov.bh is the programme's own site. All three of the reported claims check out: BHD 130,000, permanence, and aggregation of properties. The BHD 200,000 figure is confirmed as the superseded launch-era figure, and the confirmation is unusually clean because the same government site carries both numbers at different dates. Two things are NOT published: a minimum-stay statement framed as 'there is explicitly no minimum' (the site says no restriction on length of stay, which is not quite the same sentence), and the governing legal instrument, which was not located. The non-property Golden Residency categories are Retired, Talented and long-term Residents; those were not researched here.
programmes.notes_zh: 本條所有實質欄位皆取自巴林政府自設的計畫官網 goldenresidency.gov.bh。該站在本環境可正常連線，儘管居留事務國家入口網站（npra.gov.bh）拒絕連線——前一輪查證正是敗在該拒絕連線上，如今已不成問題，因為 goldenresidency.gov.bh 就是該計畫自身的網站。三項報導說法全部成立：BHD 130,000、永久性、可跨物業合併計算。BHD 200,000 確認為已遭取代的上路初期數字，且此一確認格外乾淨，因為同一政府網站在不同時點分別載有兩個數字。有兩點不予刊登：一是把最低居留寫成「明文規定無最低要求」（官網寫的是停留期間不設限制，與該句並不完全等同）；二是母法法源，本次未能定位。黃金居留的非不動產類別為退休人士、專業人才與長期居民，本次未予研究。

programmes.programme: Residence Visa for Property Owner (Integrated Tourism Complexes) — Royal Oman Police
programmes.programme_zh: 不動產所有權人居留簽證（綜合旅遊綜合體）——阿曼皇家警察
programmes.label_en: Residence visa for ITC property owners
programmes.label_zh: 綜合旅遊綜合體業主居留簽證

min_value.basis: NO minimum property value is stated by the competent authority. The Royal Oman Police service description on the national government portal sets only a qualitative condition: the applicant must be an owner of a residential unit within one of the Integrated Tourism Complexes in the Sultanate. This confirms the reported 'no value threshold' claim at tier 1.

term.text_en: TWO YEARS — this CONTRADICTS the reported claim of a 10-year Golden Residency. The Royal Oman Police service description reads, verbatim: 'This service allows residential unit owners within one of the integrated tourism complexes in the Sultanate of Oman to obtain a residence visa valid for two years.' See notes for what the 10-year programme actually is.
term.text_zh: 兩年——此點與「10 年黃金居留」的報導說法相牴觸。阿曼皇家警察的服務說明原文為：「本服務讓阿曼蘇丹國境內綜合旅遊綜合體之住宅單位所有權人，得取得為期兩年之居留簽證。」10 年計畫實際所指為何，見備註。

stay.text_en: Not stated in the service description. Note one condition that cuts the other way: 'The applicant must be outside the country when applying for the visa.' Deliberately not asserted.
stay.text_zh: 服務說明未載明。惟有一項條件方向相反，值得注意：「申請人於申請簽證時須人在境外。」此處刻意不作斷言。

leads_to.text_en: Not addressed. Two adjacent Royal Oman Police services exist for family — 'Get a Visa to Join a Residential Unit Owner' and 'Renew Residency for a Residential Unit Owner's Immediate Family' — so the status is renewable and sponsorable in practice, but no naturalisation pathway is stated. Deliberately not asserted.
leads_to.text_zh: 未處理此點。阿曼皇家警察另設兩項與家屬相關的鄰接服務——「取得依親住宅單位所有權人之簽證」與「住宅單位所有權人直系親屬居留續期」——顯示該身分在實務上可續期並可為家屬擔保，但未載明任何入籍途徑。此處刻意不作斷言。

ownership_form.text_en: Ownership of a residential unit inside a licensed Integrated Tourism Complex. Non-GCC foreigners may hold title only within such complexes — a geographic restriction that is the real constraint on this route, since it confines purchases to a handful of master-planned resort developments rather than the open market.
ownership_form.text_zh: 持有領照綜合旅遊綜合體內住宅單位的所有權。非海合會外籍人士僅能在此類綜合體內取得產權——這項地理限制才是本路徑的真正約束，因為它把購置範圍限縮在少數幾個總體規劃的度假開發案，而非公開市場。

offplan.text_en: Not directly addressed, but the required documents are 'Copy of the property ownership' and a 'Letter indicating the location of the property', which implies a registered, located unit. The reported claim that the property must be BUILT is neither confirmed nor refuted by the service page; it is not published.
offplan.text_zh: 未直接處理，惟所需文件為「不動產所有權影本」與「載明不動產位置之函件」，隱含須為已登記且有具體位置的單位。關於物業須「已完工」的報導說法，服務頁既未證實亦未否證，故不予刊登。

mortgage.text_en: Not addressed. Deliberately omitted.
mortgage.text_zh: 未處理。刻意略去。

dependants.text_en: Provided for through a separate service, 'Get a Visa to Join a Residential Unit Owner': 'An expatriate owner of a residential unit holding a property owner's residence permit ... may obtain a [joining visa]'. Terms not read in detail.
dependants.text_zh: 另由「取得依親住宅單位所有權人之簽證」一項服務規範：「持有不動產所有權人居留許可之外籍住宅單位所有權人……得取得〔依親簽證〕。」細部條件未逐一查閱。

entry_tax.text_en: The service page shows a fixed cost but the fee schedule was behind a 'Show' control that was not expanded. Not published.
entry_tax.text_zh: 服務頁顯示為固定收費，惟費用明細藏在未展開的「顯示」控制項後方。不予刊登。

last_change.text_en: The Royal Oman Police service record carries 'Updated: August 05, 2025'. Royal Decree 12/2006 is the underlying instrument for Integrated Tourism Complex ownership by non-Omanis, but the decree text itself was NOT read in this pass and the reported attribution to its Article 8 is not confirmed. Cite the Royal Oman Police service, not the article number.
last_change.text_zh: 阿曼皇家警察的服務紀錄載明「更新日期：2025 年 8 月 5 日」。2006 年第 12 號蘇丹令為非阿曼人於綜合旅遊綜合體持有不動產的母法，惟本次未讀取該令原文，報導中歸屬於其第 8 條之說法未獲證實。引用時請引阿曼皇家警察的服務說明，勿引條號。

short.term_en: Two years, per the Royal Oman Police service description
short.term_zh: 2 年，依阿曼皇家警察服務說明
short.stay_en: Not stated; the applicant must be outside Oman when applying
short.stay_zh: 未載；申請時申請人須在境外
short.outcome_en: Not addressed; family join and renewal services exist but no naturalisation is stated
short.outcome_zh: 未見規定；設有眷屬依親與續期服務，惟未載歸化途徑
short.own_en: A residential unit inside a licensed Integrated Tourism Complex only
short.own_zh: 僅限領照綜合旅遊綜合體內之住宅單位

programmes.notes_en: THIS ENTRY CORRECTS THE REPORTED CLAIM. The parallel sweep said Integrated Tourism Complex ownership leads to a 10-year Golden Residency with no value threshold and a built-property requirement. The 'no value threshold' half is right and is now confirmed at tier 1. The '10-year Golden Residency' half is wrong for this route: the competent authority — the Royal Oman Police, publishing on the national government portal gov.om — describes the property-owner service as producing 'a residence visa valid for two years'. That is a 2-year visa, not a 10-year golden residency. Oman does separately run an Investor Residency Programme with 5-year and 10-year tiers, administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, but that programme is CAPITAL-based, not property-purchase-based; indeed the ministry's own summary lists 'property ownership OUTSIDE integrated tourism complexes' among the programme's PRIVILEGES — i.e. in Oman, property is a benefit you unlock by qualifying for the golden visa, not the thing that qualifies you for it. That inversion is the substantive finding here and it is the opposite of how agency material presents Oman. The Investor Residency Programme's own OMR thresholds were NOT verified in this pass and are not published. One oddity is recorded rather than resolved: among the service's special conditions is 'The applicant must have a commercial register', which sits strangely with a purely residential purchase and may be a portal data error; it is quoted, not interpreted.
programmes.notes_zh: 本條修正報導中的說法。另一路研究稱綜合旅遊綜合體的所有權可導向 10 年黃金居留，無價值門檻，但物業須已完工。「無價值門檻」這一半正確，現已由一級來源確認。「10 年黃金居留」這一半就本路徑而言有誤：主管機關——在國家政府入口網站 gov.om 上公布資訊的阿曼皇家警察——將不動產所有權人服務描述為核發「為期兩年之居留簽證」。那是兩年簽證，不是 10 年黃金居留。阿曼確另設有 5 年與 10 年兩檔的投資人居留計畫，由商工投資推廣部主管，但該計畫以「資本」為基礎，而非以購置不動產為基礎；該部自身的摘要更把「在綜合旅遊綜合體『之外』持有不動產」列為該計畫的「權益」之一——換言之在阿曼，不動產是取得黃金簽證後才解鎖的好處，而非取得黃金簽證的門票。這一因果倒置正是此處的實質發現，且與仲介文宣呈現阿曼的方式完全相反。投資人居留計畫本身的阿曼里亞爾門檻本次未查證，不予刊登。另記錄一項未解的怪異之處：服務的特別條件中包含「申請人須具備商業登記」，這與純住宅購置格格不入，可能是入口網站的資料錯誤；此處僅引述，不作詮釋。

sources.publisher: Sultanate of Oman national government portal (gov.om) — Royal Oman Police service 'Get Residence Visa for Property Owner', updated 5 August 2025
Sultanate of Oman national government portal (gov.om) — 'Get a Visa to Join a Residential Unit Owner'
Oman Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion — Investor Residency Programme summary (property ownership outside ITCs listed as a programme privilege)

programmes.programme: Green Card — Autorização de Residência Permanente no País (second-residence status by property purchase)
programmes.programme_zh: 綠卡——國內永久居留許可（以購置不動產取得第二居所身分）

min_value.basis: Lei n.º 30/IX/2018, Article 3(a), verbatim: foreigners who, for residence, have bought built or under-construction real estate 'de valor igual ou superior a €80.000 (oitenta mil euros), correspondente a 8.821.200$00 ..., em município de produto interno bruto (PIB) per capita inferior à média nacional, desde que pago com recursos transferidos do estrangeiro'. Three conditions, all cumulative: the value, the municipality's GDP per capita being BELOW the national average, and payment from funds transferred from abroad.

extra_tiers.label_en: Municipality whose GDP per capita is EQUAL TO OR ABOVE the national average — Article 3(b): value of EUR 120,000 or more (13,231,800 CVE), likewise payable only with funds transferred from abroad. Article 3(c): where GDP per capita cannot be calculated per municipality, the criterion becomes GDP per capita by ISLAND.
extra_tiers.label_zh: 人均 GDP「等於或高於」全國平均之市鎮——第 3 條 b 款：價值 120,000 歐元以上（13,231,800 埃斯庫多），同樣須以自境外匯入之資金支付。第 3 條 c 款：無法按市鎮計算人均 GDP 時，改採「按島」計算的人均 GDP 為判準。

term.text_en: Indefinite in status, five-yearly in paperwork — both halves are statutory and must be published together. Lei n.º 30/IX/2018 Article 4: 'O Green Card confere ao seu titular direito a autorização de residência permanente no país, nos limites e para os fins exclusivos nele previstos' — a permanent residence authorisation, but expressly within the limits and for the exclusive purposes provided in the Act. Article 5(2): 'O título de residência permanente deve, porém, ser renovado de cinco em cinco anos' — the permanent residence title must NONETHELESS be renewed every five years, or whenever the identifying particulars recorded on it change. Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2020 Article 11(1) adds the cycle: 'O Green Card é renovável de 5 em 5 anos, e por 10 anos a partir da segunda renovação' — renewable every 5 years, and for 10 years from the second renewal onwards.
term.text_zh: 身分上是無限期，文件上是五年一輪——兩半都有法源，必須併同刊登。2018 年第 30/IX 號法律第 4 條：「綠卡賦予持有人於國內取得永久居留許可之權利，惟以本法所定之範圍與專屬目的為限。」第 5 條第 2 項：「惟永久居留證照須每五年續發一次」，或於其上登載之識別資料變動時續發。2020 年第 1 號規則命令第 11 條第 1 項補足週期：「綠卡每 5 年可續期一次，自第二次續期起改為每 10 年。」

stay.text_en: No minimum stay is imposed by either instrument — the reported claim holds. Neither the Act nor the Regulation states a number of days. One conditional presence test does exist and should be published alongside: Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2020 Article 11(6) provides that where a renewal application is filed AFTER the card's validity has expired, the application 'deve ser sempre acompanhado de prova de permanência em território nacional ou comprovativo dos motivos de ausência' — it must always be accompanied by proof of presence in national territory or evidence of the reasons for absence. So absence is never counted while you renew on time, but becomes something you must justify if you renew late.
stay.text_zh: 兩份文件皆未課予最低居留天數——報導說法成立。法律與規則命令均未載明天數。惟確有一項附條件的在境檢驗，應併同刊登：2020 年第 1 號規則命令第 11 條第 6 項規定，續期申請若於卡片效期「屆滿之後」提出，該申請「均須檢附在國境內停留之證明，或缺席事由之佐證文件」。因此按時續期者從不計算缺席天數，逾期續期者則須就缺席提出說明。

leads_to.text_en: Not addressed by either instrument. The Act's own statement of purpose (Article 1) is 'to promote the country's economy, in particular the real estate sector' via a differentiated status for the holder of a SECOND residence — framing that points away from, not towards, naturalisation. No citizenship claim is published.
leads_to.text_zh: 兩份文件均未處理此點。該法自述的立法目的（第 1 條）是透過為「第二居所」持有人設立差異化身分，「促進國家經濟，尤其是不動產部門」——此一定位指向的是與入籍相反的方向。不刊登任何公民身分主張。

ownership_form.text_en: Purchase of built or under-construction real estate, held continuously. The renewal file must include 'Comprovativo da manutenção da propriedade do património imobiliário que deu origem à sua aquisição' (Regulation Article 11(4)(a)) — proof that the applicant still owns the property that gave rise to the card. There is therefore no fixed holding period in the sense of 'five years then free': the property must be held for as long as the status is to be kept, which is a stronger and open-ended constraint. The instruments do not describe the tenure as freehold or otherwise, so the commonly repeated 'full freehold' claim is NOT published here.
ownership_form.text_zh: 購置已建成或興建中之不動產，並須持續持有。續期文件須包含「證明仍維持持有該取得之不動產」（規則命令第 11 條第 4 項 a 款）——即申請人仍持有當初據以取得綠卡之物業。因此並不存在「持滿五年即可自由處分」意義下的固定持有期：物業須持有至不再需要維持該身分為止，這是一項更強且無期限上限的約束。兩份文件均未將產權型態描述為自由保有或其他形式，故常見的「完全自由保有產權」說法，此處不予刊登。

offplan.text_en: OFF-PLAN QUALIFIES — confirmed verbatim and in both instruments. Lei n.º 30/IX/2018 Article 3 and Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2020 Article 2(1) both use the phrase 'património imobiliário edificado OU EM FASE DE CONSTRUÇÃO' — real estate built OR UNDER CONSTRUCTION. This is unusually explicit; most comparable regimes are silent and have to be inferred.
offplan.text_zh: 預售屋符合資格——已由兩份文件逐字確認。2018 年第 30/IX 號法律第 3 條與 2020 年第 1 號規則命令第 2 條第 1 項均使用「已建成『或興建中』之不動產」一語。此一寫法異常明確；多數可資比較的制度對此保持沉默，只能靠推論。

mortgage.text_en: Not addressed — but the funds-from-abroad condition is the operative constraint and it is stated three times. Article 3(a) and (b) both require the purchase be 'pago com recursos transferidos do estrangeiro', and Article 7(2)(a) makes it an access condition that the applicant 'Demonstrar ter adquirido o património imobiliário com recursos transferidos do estrangeiro, nos montantes mínimos previstos'. A purchase financed by a Cape Verdean lender therefore does not obviously satisfy the qualifying condition, whatever the mortgage's own legality. No inference beyond that is drawn.
mortgage.text_zh: 未處理——但「資金須自境外匯入」才是實際的約束，且法條三度重申。第 3 條 a、b 兩款均要求購置須「以自境外匯入之資金支付」，第 7 條第 2 項 a 款更將其列為准入條件：申請人須「證明係以自境外匯入之資金、按所定最低金額取得該不動產」。因此，由維德角本地放款人融資的購置，顯然無法當然滿足資格條件，無論該抵押貸款本身是否合法。此外不作進一步推論。

dependants.text_en: Lei n.º 30/IX/2018 Article 5(1): the residence authorisation extends to the spouse or the de facto partner judicially recognised in the country of origin, under Articles 59 and 60 of Lei n.º 66/VIII/2014 as amended, and to a minor under 14 and/or a dependant in the applicant's charge, on terms to be regulated. Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2020 devotes a full chapter to family reunification, handled through the same one-stop shop.
dependants.text_zh: 2018 年第 30/IX 號法律第 5 條第 1 項：居留許可及於配偶，或在原籍國經司法承認之事實伴侶（依 2014 年第 66/VIII 號法律第 59、60 條及其修正），並及於 14 歲以下未成年人及／或由申請人扶養之受扶養人，具體條件另以命令定之。2020 年第 1 號規則命令另闢一整章規範家庭團聚，由同一單一窗口辦理。

entry_tax.text_en: THE TAX BREAK IS REAL, IS DISCRETIONARY, AND ITS OBJECT HAS BEEN ABOLISHED — publish all three points together. Lei n.º 30/IX/2018 Article 6(1): property acquired under the Act is exempt from Imposto Único sobre o Património (IUP) on the transfer and on transmission by mortis causa succession, 'e sujeito a redução em 50% (cinquenta por cento) do IUP devido nos dez anos seguintes, MEDIANTE DELIBERAÇÃO DA ASSEMBLEIA MUNICIPAL do Concelho onde se localiza o imóvel' — the 50%/ten-year reduction requires a resolution of the Municipal Assembly of the council where the property sits, so it is a municipal discretion, not an entitlement. Article 6(2): where the Green Card holder is a retiree whose pension income was not generated in Cape Verde, that income is exempt under the personal income tax code (CIRPS). CRITICALLY: the IUP was repealed with effect from 1 January 2026 and replaced by two new codes, the Imposto sobre a Propriedade de Imóveis (IPI) and the Imposto sobre Transmissões de Imóveis (ITI). A Cape Verdean parliamentary Deliberação published in the Boletim Oficial of 22 October 2025 refers to the IUP as running 'até 31 de dezembro de 2025, que em 2026 deve ser revogado'. Article 6 of the 2018 Act grants exemption from a tax that no longer exists; whether the exemption carries across to IPI and ITI was NOT established and must not be assumed. Green Card issuance fees are set by a joint ministerial Portaria (Regulation Article 8) and are not stated in either instrument.
entry_tax.text_zh: 稅賦優惠確實存在、屬裁量性質、且其課稅客體已被廢除——三點應併同刊登。2018 年第 30/IX 號法律第 6 條第 1 項：依本法取得之不動產，於移轉時及因死亡繼承移轉時免徵單一財產稅（IUP），「並就其後十年應納之 IUP 減徵 50%（百分之五十），惟須經不動產所在市鎮之市議會決議」——五成／十年的減徵須經物業所在市鎮的市議會決議，故屬市鎮裁量，並非當然權利。第 6 條第 2 項：綠卡持有人若為退休人士，且其退休金來源所得非於維德角產生，該所得依個人所得稅法（CIRPS）免稅。關鍵在於：IUP 已自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起廢止，由兩部新法典取代——不動產財產稅（IPI）與不動產移轉稅（ITI）。維德角國民議會 2025 年 10 月 22 日刊登於官方公報之決議提及 IUP 施行「至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止，並應於 2026 年廢止」。2018 年法律第 6 條所免徵的，是一個已不復存在的稅目；該免稅是否延續適用於 IPI 與 ITI，本次未能確立，不得逕予假設。綠卡核發規費由部長聯合命令（規則命令第 8 條）定之，兩份文件均未載明金額。

last_change.text_en: THE INSTRUMENT CITATION IS SETTLED — the sweep was right and the law firm was wrong. The governing Act is Lei n.º 30/IX/2018 de 23 de abril, published in the Boletim Oficial da República de Cabo Verde, I Série n.º 23, 23 April 2018, at page 540. The implementing text is Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2020 de 7 de janeiro, published in the Boletim Oficial, I Série n.º 2, 7 January 2020. Both were read in full from the official gazette. The competing citation 'Law No. 31/IX/2018' reported by the law firm Miranda is incorrect. No later amendment to either instrument was located.
last_change.text_zh: 法源引註已定案——另一路研究正確，該律師事務所有誤。母法為 2018 年 4 月 23 日第 30/IX 號法律，刊登於《維德角共和國官方公報》第一輯第 23 號，2018 年 4 月 23 日，第 540 頁。施行文件為 2020 年 1 月 7 日第 1 號規則命令，刊登於官方公報第一輯第 2 號，2020 年 1 月 7 日。兩者皆已自官方公報全文讀取。Miranda 律師事務所所報「2018 年第 31/IX 號法律」之引註有誤。未發現兩份文件的後續修正。

short.term_en: Permanent in status, five-yearly in paperwork; ten-yearly from the second renewal
short.term_zh: 身分為永久，證件 5 年換發，自第二次換發起為 10 年
short.outcome_en: Permanent residence; naturalisation not addressed
short.outcome_zh: 永久居留；歸化未見規定
short.own_en: Continued ownership must be proved at every renewal, so there is no sell-and-keep exit
short.own_zh: 每次換發均須證明仍持有該物件，故不存在售出後保留身分之退出路徑

programmes.notes_en: THE THREE TEST CLAIMS, ALL RESOLVED AT TIER 1 AGAINST THE OFFICIAL GAZETTE. (1) NO ZDTI / TOURISM-ZONE REQUIREMENT — CONFIRMED. Neither Lei n.º 30/IX/2018 nor Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2020 mentions ZDTI, tourism zones, or any designated-area concept at all. The one and only geographic criterion in the whole scheme is whether the MUNICIPALITY's GDP per capita sits below, or at or above, the national average — and where that cannot be computed per municipality, per island. Anyone telling a buyer the property must sit in a tourism development zone is inventing it. (2) THE EUR 200,000 TIER DOES NOT EXIST — CONFIRMED. Article 3 of the Act contains exactly two figures, EUR 80,000 and EUR 120,000, and Article 2 of the Regulation reproduces the same two. No third tier appears anywhere in either instrument. (3) THE TAX BREAK WAS WRITTEN AGAINST THE IUP AND THE IUP IS GONE — CONFIRMED, and worse than reported. Article 6 exempts the property from IUP; the IUP was repealed effective 1 January 2026 and replaced by IPI and ITI. Additionally, the part of the benefit most often marketed — the 50% reduction over ten years — was never automatic even while IUP existed: it requires a resolution of the Municipal Assembly of the relevant council. So the tax argument for this programme should be treated as unsupported until someone produces the IPI/ITI transitional provision. TWO FURTHER CORRECTIONS TO THE CIRCULATING DESCRIPTION. First, 'indefinite residence' oversells it: the status is permanent but the title must be renewed every five years, then every ten from the second renewal, and each renewal requires proof of continued ownership. Second, the funds-transferred-from-abroad condition is stated three separate times across the two instruments and is a genuine gate — it is not boilerplate. One point that could NOT be verified and is therefore omitted: the tenure type. Neither instrument says 'freehold'. Also note the gazette itself contains a typographical error at Article 2(1)(b) of the Regulation, which reads 'cento e vinte mil escudos' where the parent Act correctly reads 'cento e vinte mil euros'; the escudo figure printed alongside (13,231,800$00) confirms euros is meant.
programmes.notes_zh: 三項待驗說法，全部依官方公報以一級來源解決。（1）不存在 ZDTI／旅遊區要求——確認成立。2018 年第 30/IX 號法律與 2020 年第 1 號規則命令，皆完全未提及 ZDTI、旅遊區或任何指定區域概念。整套制度中唯一的地理判準，是該「市鎮」的人均 GDP 低於全國平均、抑或等於或高於全國平均；無法按市鎮計算時則按島計算。任何告訴買方物業須位於旅遊開發區的說法，都是憑空杜撰。（2）不存在 20 萬歐元檔——確認成立。法律第 3 條恰恰只有兩個數字：80,000 歐元與 120,000 歐元；規則命令第 2 條原樣重複同樣兩個數字。兩份文件任何處都沒有第三檔。（3）稅賦優惠是針對 IUP 而寫，而 IUP 已不存在——確認成立，且情況比報導更差。第 6 條免徵的是該不動產的 IUP；IUP 已自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起廢止，由 IPI 與 ITI 取代。此外，最常被行銷的那一部分優惠——十年內減徵五成——即使在 IUP 仍存在時也從來不是自動適用：它需要相關市鎮的市議會決議。因此，在有人拿出 IPI／ITI 的過渡條款之前，本計畫的稅務論點應視為欠缺依據。另有兩項對流通版本描述的修正。其一，「無限期居留」的說法言過其實：身分雖為永久，但證照須每五年續發，自第二次續期起改為每十年，且每次續期都須提出持續持有物業的證明。其二，「資金須自境外匯入」的條件在兩份文件中三度出現，是真正的關卡，而非樣板文字。有一點未能查證因而略去：產權型態。兩份文件都沒有出現「自由保有」字樣。另附記：官方公報本身在規則命令第 2 條第 1 項 b 款有排印錯誤，寫成「一十二萬『埃斯庫多』」，而母法正確寫為「一十二萬『歐元』」；並列印出的埃斯庫多數字（13,231,800$00）足證原意為歐元。

programmes.notes_en: PUBLISHED BUT DELIBERATELY CAPPED AT MEDIUM. The threshold clears the two-independent-tier-2 bar comfortably — IPAL (Infante & Pérez Almillano), Kraemer & Kraemer, Kovalenko & Vera, Limitless Legal and Motta, Yaafar & Díaz all state US$300,000 in real estate free of encumbrances, and all attribute the 15 October 2026 reversion to US$500,000 to Decreto Ejecutivo 193 de 2024. But no tier-1 read was achieved: migracion.gob.pa's service page could not be located and the Gaceta Oficial was not opened. Given that the operative fact here is a DEADLINE falling inside the publication window, and given that the last pass excluded Panama for exactly this reason, the honest position is to publish the figure with the expiry attached and the sourcing tier stated plainly. If any single item in this file is worth one more verification round before going live, it is the 15 October 2026 date. SEPARATELY, Panama's Friendly Nations route was NOT researched in this pass and nothing about it is published here — do not carry the Qualified Investor figures across to it, as it is a different decree with different conditions.
