min_value.basis: PROPERTY DOES QUALIFY, BUT THE MULTIPLE IS NOT PUBLISHED. The answer to the question asked is yes: the Lineamientos Generales para la Expedición de Visas contain a route for an applicant who owns real estate in Mexico, free of encumbrances, above a stated value. The value is expressed as 'cuarenta mil días de salario mínimo general vigente en el Distrito Federal' — forty thousand days of the general minimum wage then in force in the Federal District. Following Mexico's 2016 de-indexation reform, references of this kind are read against the Unidad de Medida y Actualización (UMA) rather than the minimum wage, which is where the '40,000 UMA' formulation in circulation comes from. NO NUMBER IS PUBLISHED because the wording was obtained from a single tier-2 source (a Mexican law firm) plus a tier-3 real estate site, which does not meet the publication rule, and because the minimum-wage-versus-UMA substitution was not verified against a tier-1 text.

finding.text_en: CONFIRMED STILL ABOLISHED. The real-estate routes to the Golden Visa (ARI) were closed to new applications by Lei n.º 56/2023 ('Mais Habitação'), published in Diário da República n.º 194/2023, Série I, on 6 October 2023 and in force 7 October 2023 (art. 55.º: 'A presente lei entra em vigor no dia seguinte ao da sua publicação'). MECHANISM CORRECTION: Lei 56/2023 did NOT amend art. 90.º-A of Lei 23/2007 — it leaves 90.º-A textually intact and instead imposes a standalone prohibition in art. 42.º, which provides that no new applications are admitted under subalíneas i), iii) and iv) of alínea d) of n.º 1 of art. 3.º of Lei 23/2007. Existing permits may still be RENEWED under the prior regime, family reunification is preserved, permanent ARI remains available to existing holders meeting art. 80.º, and renewals convert into an 'autorização de residência para imigrantes empreendedores' under art. 89.º n.º 4 with a minimum stay of 7 days in year one and 14 days in each subsequent two-year period. NO RESTORATION: AIMA's current official ARI page lists only subalíneas ii (10 jobs), v (EUR 500,000 research), vi (EUR 250,000 cultural heritage), vii (EUR 500,000 into Portuguese collective investment undertakings, expressly 'não imobiliários'), and viii (EUR 500,000 company incorporation with jobs). Subalíneas i, iii and iv are absent, and the only occurrence of 'imobiliári*' on the page is the express exclusion in category vii.
finding.text_zh: 確認仍為廢止狀態。黃金簽證（ARI）之不動產途徑經第 56/2023 號《更多住房法》關閉，該法於 2023 年 10 月 6 日刊登於《共和國公報》第 194/2023 號第一輯，2023 年 10 月 7 日生效（第 55 條：「本法自公布之翌日起施行」）。機制更正：第 56/2023 號法律並未修正第 23/2007 號法律第 90-A 條——該條文義維持不變，而係於第 42 條另設獨立禁止規定，明定自本法生效日起不再受理依第 23/2007 號法律第 3 條第 1 項第 d 款第 i、iii、iv 目提出之新申請。既有許可仍得依舊制續期，家庭團聚獲保留，符合第 80 條之既有持有人仍可取得永久 ARI，且續期將轉換為第 89 條第 4 項之「創業移民居留許可」，最低居留為第一年 7 日、其後每 2 年期間各 14 日。並未恢復：AIMA 現行官方 ARI 頁面僅列第 ii 目（創造 10 個就業機會）、第 v 目（50 萬歐元研究）、第 vi 目（25 萬歐元文化資產）、第 vii 目（50 萬歐元投入葡萄牙集合投資機構，並明文限「非不動產類」）及第 viii 目（50 萬歐元設立公司並創造就業）。第 i、iii、iv 目均已不存在，該頁面唯一出現「不動產」字樣之處即為第 vii 目之明文排除。

finding.text_en: CONFIRMED ABOLISHED, and the repealing provision is now pinned. Ley Orgánica 1/2025, de 2 de enero, de medidas en materia de eficiencia del Servicio Público de Justicia, published in BOE núm. 3 on 3 JANUARY 2025 (not 6 January, as one tier-2 source states), entered into force 3 April 2025. The operative provision is DISPOSICIÓN FINAL VIGESIMOPRIMERA, sub-paragraph Uno: 'Se dejan sin contenido los artículos 63, 64, 65, 66 y 67' of Ley 14/2013. The BOE consolidated text of Ley 14/2013 now shows all five articles as '(Sin contenido)', each carrying the note 'Se deja sin contenido, con efectos de 3 de abril de 2025, por la disposición final 21.1 de la Ley Orgánica 1/2025, de 2 de enero'. The emptied articles are 63 investor residence visa, 64 form of proof of investment, 65 effects of the investor residence visa, 66 investor residence authorisation, 67 duration of the investor residence authorisation. ALL investor categories were eliminated, not only real estate — property, public debt, shares, funds, bank deposits and business projects. TRANSITIONAL PROTECTION is written into the same disposición final: applications filed before entry into force are decided under the rules in force at filing, and visas and authorisations valid at entry into force keep their validity for their stated term, with renewals processed under the rules in force when the initial authorisation was granted.
finding.text_zh: 確認廢止，且廢止條款已鎖定。2025 年 1 月 2 日第 1/2025 號組織法《司法公共服務效能措施法》於 2025 年 1 月 3 日刊登於《官方公報》第 3 號（非某第二級來源所稱之 1 月 6 日），2025 年 4 月 3 日生效。關鍵條款為第 21 附則第 1 目：「第 14/2013 號法律第 63、64、65、66、67 條刪除內容」。《官方公報》第 14/2013 號法律彙編版現將該五條均標示為「（無內容）」，並各附註記「依 2025 年 1 月 2 日第 1/2025 號組織法第 21 附則第 1 目，自 2025 年 4 月 3 日起刪除內容」。遭刪除之條文為：第 63 條投資人居留簽證、第 64 條投資證明方式、第 65 條投資人居留簽證之效力、第 66 條投資人居留授權、第 67 條投資人居留授權之期間。所有投資類別均遭取消，不限於不動產——尚包括公債、股份、基金、銀行存款及營運計畫。同一附則並明定過渡保障：生效前提出之申請依提出時之法規審定；生效時有效之簽證與授權於其所載期間內維持效力，續期則依原授權核准時之法規辦理。

negatives.short_zh: 投資入籍於歐盟法院第 C-181/23 號判決後關閉，歸化改為僅限功績類。MPRP 居留計畫屬另一法令，仍然開放。

finding.text_en: CLOSED — do NOT publish the EUR 700,000 property component or the EUR 600,000/EUR 750,000 contribution as a live programme. On 29 April 2025 the CJEU (Grand Chamber) in Case C-181/23, Commission v Malta, held that the 2020 investor citizenship scheme 'amounts to the commercialisation of the grant of the nationality of a Member State and, by extension, of Union citizenship', infringing art. 20 TFEU and art. 4(3) TEU. Malta responded with Act No. XXI of 2025, the Maltese Citizenship (Amendment) Act, passed by the House on 23 July 2025 and assented on 24 JULY 2025. That Act substituted art. 10(9) of the Maltese Citizenship Act so that naturalisation is now available only 'by merit' — for 'a person who renders exceptional services or who makes an exceptional contribution, including through job creation', defined by reference to scientists, researchers, athletes, artists, cultural performers, entrepreneurs, philanthropists and technologists. The direct-investment limb is gone; the definition 'individual investor programme' was deleted from art. 2; and the Regulator's remit was re-scoped to naturalisation on the basis of merit. Applications filed under the old art. 10(9) BEFORE the Act came into force continue under the old rules. RESIDUAL GAP, stated honestly: no Legal Notice formally repealing L.N. 437 of 2020 itself was located — its enabling provision was substituted, which removes its legal basis, so the safe formulation is 'the enabling provision was replaced by Act XXI of 2025', not 'L.N. 437 of 2020 was repealed by X'.
finding.text_zh: 已關閉——不得將 70 萬歐元之不動產部分或 60 萬／75 萬歐元捐獻作為現行計畫刊登。2025 年 4 月 29 日，歐盟法院大法庭於 C-181/23 號執委會訴馬爾他案判決，認 2020 年投資入籍制度「構成會員國國籍、進而歐盟公民身分之商品化」，違反《歐盟運作條約》第 20 條與《歐盟條約》第 4 條第 3 項。馬爾他以 2025 年第 XXI 號《馬爾他公民身分（修正）法》回應，該法於 2025 年 7 月 23 日經眾議院通過，2025 年 7 月 24 日獲同意。該法替換《馬爾他公民身分法》第 10 條第 9 項，使歸化僅限「憑功績」——即「提供卓越服務或作出卓越貢獻（含創造就業）之人」，並以科學家、研究人員、運動員、藝術家、文化表演者、企業家、慈善家與技術專才為例示。直接投資分支已刪除；第 2 條中「個人投資者計畫」之定義遭刪；監理機關職權亦重新界定為憑功績之歸化。於該法生效前依舊第 10 條第 9 項提出之申請仍依舊制辦理。誠實揭露之殘餘缺口：未查得正式廢止 2020 年第 437 號法律公告本身之法律公告——其授權條款已遭替換，法源因而消滅，故穩健之表述為「授權條款已由 2025 年第 XXI 號法律取代」，而非「2020 年第 437 號公告經 X 廢止」。

negatives.short_en: No property ground exists in the Foreigners Act; the marketed BGN 600,000 figure is agency material rather than law.
negatives.short_zh: 《外國人法》未設不動產事由；坊間流傳的 60 萬列弗屬仲介資料而非法律規定。

finding.text_en: NO PROPERTY ROUTE EXISTS IN BULGARIAN LAW — the widely marketed 'BGN 600,000 property' figure is agency material, not law. The full consolidated text of the Foreigners in the Republic of Bulgaria Act (Закон за чужденците в Република България), current to State Gazette issue 55 of 16 June 2026, was examined. The string '600 000' does not occur anywhere in art. 25, the exhaustive list of permanent-residence grounds, and neither does 'недвижим имот' (real estate). The investment grounds are: art. 25(1)(6) — shares or bonds of Bulgarian companies traded on a regulated market, at least BGN 2,000,000; rights under concession contracts, at least BGN 1,000,000; units in Bulgarian collective investment schemes, at least BGN 1,000,000; or units in Bulgarian alternative investment funds, at least BGN 1,000,000; art. 25(1)(7) — at least BGN 2,000,000 into the capital of a Bulgarian company for a certified priority investment project; art. 25(1)(8) — at least BGN 6,000,000 into the capital of a Bulgarian company whose shares are not traded on a regulated market. CITIZENSHIP BY INVESTMENT was abolished: the Bulgarian Citizenship Act now refers to 'the repealed art. 12a' and 'the repealed art. 14a', and the parallel amendment to the Foreigners Act carries the notation 'State Gazette issue 22 of 2022, in force from 18.03.2022'. Publish this as 'March 2022'; the exact gazette issue for the Citizenship Act repealing section was not independently confirmed. CURRENCY NOTE: Bulgaria joined the euro area on 1 January 2026 at BGN 1.95583 = EUR 1, but the consolidated Act as amended to 16 June 2026 still expresses all thirty threshold occurrences in BGN with zero euro-denominated amounts.
finding.text_zh: 保加利亞法律中並不存在不動產途徑——廣為行銷之「60 萬列弗不動產」係仲介資料而非法律。已檢視《保加利亞共和國外國人法》之完整彙編條文（更新至 2026 年 6 月 16 日《國家公報》第 55 期）：第 25 條（永久居留事由之列舉規定）全文並無「600 000」字串，亦無「不動產」一詞。投資類事由為：第 25 條第 1 項第 6 款——於受規範市場交易之保加利亞公司股票或債券至少 200 萬列弗；特許契約權利至少 100 萬列弗；保加利亞集合投資計畫受益權至少 100 萬列弗；保加利亞另類投資基金受益權至少 100 萬列弗。第 7 款——投入保加利亞公司資本至少 200 萬列弗，用於經認證之優先投資計畫。第 8 款——投入股票未於受規範市場交易之保加利亞公司資本至少 600 萬列弗。投資入籍已廢止：《保加利亞公民法》現行條文提及「已廢止之第 12a 條」與「已廢止之第 14a 條」，《外國人法》之對應修正並註記「2022 年《國家公報》第 22 期，自 2022 年 3 月 18 日施行」。宜以「2022 年 3 月」刊登；《公民法》廢止條款之確切公報期別未經獨立查證。幣別備註：保加利亞於 2026 年 1 月 1 日以 1 歐元兌 1.95583 列弗之固定匯率加入歐元區，惟更新至 2026 年 6 月 16 日之彙編條文仍以列弗表示全部 30 處門檻金額，無任何歐元計價金額。

negatives.short_en: The Investor Visa list of qualifying investments is closed and exhaustive, and property appears nowhere in it.
negatives.short_zh: 投資人簽證之合格投資屬封閉式窮盡列舉，其中不含不動產。

finding.text_en: REAL ESTATE IS EXCLUDED BY DESIGN. Art. 26-bis of Legislative Decree 286/1998 (introduced by Law 232/2016) sets out a CLOSED, EXHAUSTIVE list of qualifying investments for the Investor Visa, and property appears nowhere in it: (a) at least EUR 2,000,000 in Italian government securities held at least 2 years; (b) at least EUR 500,000 in capital instruments of a company OR A VENTURE CAPITAL FUND constituted and operating in Italy, held at least 2 years, reduced to at least EUR 250,000 where the company is a registered innovative start-up; (c) a philanthropic donation of at least EUR 1,000,000 to a public-interest project in culture, education, immigration management, scientific research or restoration of cultural or landscape assets. Two precision points: the EUR 250,000 start-up figure is a SUB-CASE of letter (b), not a separate lettera — the statute has three letters, not four; and letter (b) also covers a venture capital fund, which the official portal's summary omits. The separate elective residence visa (visto per residenza elettiva) is a distinct national type-D category listed separately from 'INVESTITORI' on the official MAECI visa portal; property purchase is not a qualifying investment under it and does not itself confer residence. URL CORRECTION for the draft: investorvisa.esteri.it DOES NOT RESOLVE — the live portal remains at investorvisa.mise.gov.it, rebranded to MIMIT only in the page furniture. Also of note: the programme is suspended for Russian and Belarusian citizens by Committee Chair order of 14 July 2023, extended on 20 March 2024 to dual nationals holding a Russian or Belarusian passport.
finding.text_zh: 不動產係經制度設計而排除。第 286/1998 號立法命令第 26-bis 條（由第 232/2016 號法律引入）就投資人簽證訂有封閉且窮盡之合格投資清單，其中完全不含不動產：（a）義大利政府債券至少 200 萬歐元，持有至少 2 年；（b）在義大利設立並營運之公司或創投基金之資本工具至少 50 萬歐元，持有至少 2 年，若該公司為登記在案之創新新創企業則降為至少 25 萬歐元；（c）就文化、教育、移民管理、科學研究或文化與景觀資產修復之公益計畫捐贈至少 100 萬歐元。兩點精確說明：25 萬歐元之新創數字係第（b）款之次類型而非獨立款項，法條為三款而非四款；第（b）款並涵蓋創投基金，官方入口網站之摘要漏未提及。另一套「選擇性居留簽證」（visto per residenza elettiva）在外交部官方簽證入口網站中係與「投資人」並列之獨立 D 類國家簽證類別，購置不動產並非其合格投資，本身亦不賦予居留權。草稿之網址更正：investorvisa.esteri.it 無法解析，現行入口網站仍為 investorvisa.mise.gov.it，僅頁面外觀改為 MIMIT 品牌。另須註記：依 2023 年 7 月 14 日委員會主席令，該計畫對俄羅斯與白俄羅斯公民停止適用，並於 2024 年 3 月 20 日擴及持有俄羅斯或白俄羅斯護照之雙重國籍者。

negatives.short_en: The Immigrant Investor Programme closed to new applications on 15 February 2023, and property was never a qualifying investment in its own right.
negatives.short_zh: 投資移民計畫於 2023 年 2 月 15 日停止受理新申請，且不動產從未單獨構成合格投資。

finding.text_en: IIP CLOSED, AND PROPERTY WAS NEVER A QUALIFYING INVESTMENT IN ITS OWN RIGHT. Minister for Justice Simon Harris TD obtained Government approval and announced closure of the Immigrant Investor Programme to further applications from close of business on 15 FEBRUARY 2023; the announcement itself was made on 14 February 2023. Existing applications on hand continued to be processed and approved projects were unaffected; the Start-up Entrepreneur Programme continues. The four options at closure were: Enterprise Investment, minimum EUR 1 million in an Irish enterprise for at least 3 years; Investment Fund, minimum EUR 1 million in a Central Bank–approved and regulated fund for at least 3 years; Real Estate Investment Trusts, minimum EUR 2 million in an Irish REIT listed on the Irish Stock Exchange for at least 3 years; and Endowment, minimum EUR 500,000 philanthropic donation, reduced to EUR 400,000 where five or more applications were received. Applicants also needed personal wealth of at least EUR 2 million. The programme approved approximately EUR 1.252 billion of investment over its life and was introduced in 2012. DRAFT SWEEP WAS WRONG: the REIT option was NOT suspended or removed before closure — it was live and listed as one of the four available options at the moment of closure. What was suspended in 2016 was a different pair, the Government bond and Mixed investment options. ACCESS CAVEAT: irishimmigration.ie returns HTTP 403 to automated requests; verification used the Internet Archive capture of the official page taken on 15 February 2023, i.e. contemporaneous.
finding.text_zh: 移民投資人計畫（IIP）已關閉，且不動產從未單獨構成合格投資。司法部長 Simon Harris 取得內閣同意後宣布，該計畫自 2023 年 2 月 15 日營業時間結束起停止受理新申請；宣布本身係於 2023 年 2 月 14 日作出。已受理之申請繼續審理，已核准之計畫不受影響；新創企業家計畫則持續運作。關閉時之四種選項為：企業投資，投入愛爾蘭企業至少 100 萬歐元、持有至少 3 年；投資基金，投入央行核准並受監理之基金至少 100 萬歐元、持有至少 3 年；不動產投資信託，投入在愛爾蘭證券交易所上市之愛爾蘭 REIT 至少 200 萬歐元、持有至少 3 年；以及捐贈，公益捐贈至少 50 萬歐元，若同時收到 5 件以上申請則降為 40 萬歐元。申請人並須具備至少 200 萬歐元之個人財富。該計畫存續期間共核准約 12.52 億歐元投資，於 2012 年設立。草稿有誤：REIT 選項在關閉前並未遭停止或移除——關閉當下該選項仍在運作，且列為四種可用選項之一。2016 年遭停止者為另外兩項，即政府公債選項與混合投資選項。取用保留：irishimmigration.ie 對自動請求回應 403，查證係採用網際網路檔案館於 2023 年 2 月 15 日對官方頁面所作之同期存檔。

negatives.short_en: The direct property option existed for about six months in 2024. The surviving route is EUR 250,000 of units in a real-estate fund registered by the Magyar Nemzeti Bank.
negatives.short_zh: 直接購屋選項於 2024 年僅存續約六個月。現存途徑為認購匈牙利央行登記之不動產基金受益權 25 萬歐元。

finding.text_en: NO DIRECT PROPERTY-PURCHASE OPTION AS AT 1 AUGUST 2026 — but the draft sweep was wrong on two points and the surviving option is more property-linked than a flat negative implies. The consolidated text of Act XC of 2023 (Btátv.) with validity stamp 'Hatály: 2026.I.1. – 2026.IX.26.' — the law literally in force today — provides at §16(3) only TWO qualifying investments: (a) acquisition of investment fund units worth at least EUR 250,000 issued by a real estate fund registered by the Magyar Nemzeti Bank, and (b) a monetary donation of at least EUR 1,000,000 to a higher-education institution maintained by a public-interest asset management foundation. WRONG PREMISE 1: the fund amount was NOT raised — it is still EUR 250,000, verified both in the text in force now and in the future time-state from 27 September 2026. WRONG PREMISE 2: 'deleted before it was ever activated' is not accurate. Act XC of 2023 entered into force 1 January 2024, but §286(17) provides that the guest investor visa and residence permit subtitles 'shall be applied from 1 July 2024'. The EUR 500,000 residential property option was therefore applicable from 1 July 2024 until 29 December 2024 — a live window of roughly six months — before being removed with effect from 30 DECEMBER 2024 by Act LXXXIV of 2024 §135(2) (the CER Directive transposition act, which carried the immigration amendments as a rider). Whether any permits were in fact ISSUED on the property basis in that window is an empirical question that was not sourced; do not assert zero. NUANCE THAT MUST BE CARRIED: the surviving EUR 250,000 option is genuinely property-linked. §22(9) requires the applicant to directly subscribe and continuously hold for at least five years units of a real estate fund whose net asset value is at least 40% invested in RESIDENTIAL-FUNCTION REAL ESTATE LOCATED IN HUNGARY, and whose fund manager appears on the qualified market participants list under Act XXX of 2016, vetted by the Constitution Protection Office. The investor never owns real estate, so it is not a property purchase — but a negative entry saying 'no property connection whatsoever' would overstate the position. This is the closest surviving analogue to a residency-by-property route in the EU.
finding.text_zh: 截至 2026 年 8 月 1 日並無直接購屋選項——惟草稿有兩處錯誤，且現存選項與不動產之連結遠較單純否定為深。2023 年第 XC 號法律（Btátv.）之彙編條文，效力戳記為「2026.I.1.－2026.IX.26.」（即今日實際施行之版本），其第 16 條第 3 項僅列兩種合格投資：（a）取得由匈牙利國家銀行登記之不動產基金所發行、價值至少 25 萬歐元之投資基金受益權；（b）向公益資產管理基金會所設之高等教育機構捐贈至少 100 萬歐元。錯誤前提一：基金金額並未調升，仍為 25 萬歐元，已就現行條文及 2026 年 9 月 27 日起之未來版本雙重查證。錯誤前提二：「在啟用前即遭刪除」並不正確。2023 年第 XC 號法律於 2024 年 1 月 1 日生效，惟第 286 條第 17 項規定客座投資人簽證與居留許可各節「自 2024 年 7 月 1 日起適用」。故 50 萬歐元之住宅不動產選項自 2024 年 7 月 1 日起至 2024 年 12 月 29 日止確曾適用，實際運作視窗約 6 個月，其後依 2024 年第 LXXXIV 號法律第 135 條第 2 項（關鍵實體韌性指令之轉換法，移民修正條款係搭載其中），自 2024 年 12 月 30 日起刪除。該期間內是否確曾核發不動產類許可，屬未查得出處之經驗性問題，不得逕稱為零。必須併陳之細節：現存之 25 萬歐元選項確與不動產相連。第 22 條第 9 項要求申請人直接認購並持續持有至少 5 年之不動產基金受益權，該基金之淨資產價值須至少 40% 投資於位在匈牙利之住宅用途不動產，且其基金經理人須列於 2016 年第 XXX 號法律之合格市場參與者名單，並經憲法保護局審查。投資人始終不擁有不動產，故非購屋；惟若於否定條目中稱「與不動產全無關聯」則屬言過其實。這是歐盟境內現存最接近購屋取得居留之類似制度。

negatives.short_en: The Federal Office of Justice states that owning property confers no residence permit; the Lex Koller restricts acquisition instead.
negatives.short_zh: 聯邦司法辦公室明載持有不動產不賦予居留許可；《Lex Koller》反而限制取得。

finding.text_en: NO PROPERTY ROUTE, AND THE LAW RUNS THE OTHER WAY. The Swiss Federal Office of Justice states it in one sentence: 'It should also be noted that owning a property in Switzerland does not entitle the foreign national(s) concerned to a residence permit.' The inverse is what the law actually does: acquisition of property in Switzerland by foreign nationals, by companies domiciled abroad, or by Swiss-domiciled companies under foreign control is governed by the Lex Koller, which the Federal Office of Justice renders in English as ANRA, the Federal Act on the Acquisition of Immovable Property in Switzerland by Foreign Non-Residents, CC 211.412.41, with implementing ordinance SR 211.412.411. It generally REQUIRES authorisation from the competent cantonal authority, which may be granted only on grounds set out in the Act and in any cantonal legislation; enforcement is primarily a cantonal matter, and some communes additionally restrict acquisition of holiday homes and aparthotel units. The Federal Office of Justice page expressly redirects residence-permit questions to the State Secretariat for Migration or cantonal immigration authorities — the two matters are institutionally separate. NOTE ON ABBREVIATIONS: BewG and LFAIE are the German and French short titles; the Federal Office of Justice's own English abbreviation is ANRA. NOT VERIFIED and therefore not asserted: the characterisation of the lump-sum taxation (forfait fiscal / Pauschalbesteuerung) route as a cantonal tax arrangement rather than a property-based residence route. That characterisation is consistent with everything seen but was not independently sourced.
finding.text_zh: 無購屋途徑，且法律走向恰恰相反。瑞士聯邦司法辦公室以一句話明示：「並須注意，於瑞士擁有不動產並不賦予相關外國人取得居留許可之權利。」法律實際運作方向適得其反：外國人、境外設籍公司或受外國控制之瑞士設籍公司取得瑞士不動產，受《洛克斯・科勒法》規範，聯邦司法辦公室之英文簡稱為 ANRA，即《外國非居民取得瑞士不動產聯邦法》（CC 211.412.41），並有施行命令 SR 211.412.411。該法原則上要求取得主管州機關之許可，且僅得依該法及各州法律所定事由核准；執行主要屬各州權限，部分市鎮並另行限制度假屋與公寓式旅館單位之取得。聯邦司法辦公室頁面明確將居留許可問題導向聯邦移民事務國務秘書處或各州移民機關——兩者在制度上分屬不同事務。簡稱說明：BewG 與 LFAIE 分別為德文與法文簡稱，聯邦司法辦公室採用之英文簡稱為 ANRA。未經查證故不主張：將定額課稅（forfait fiscal／Pauschalbesteuerung）途徑定性為州級稅務安排而非不動產型居留途徑一節，該定性與所見資料一致，惟未經獨立查證。

negatives.short_en: The residence permit for business rests on four enumerated bases, none of which is real estate.
negatives.short_zh: 營業居留許可設四項列舉事由，均非不動產。

finding.text_en: PROPERTY PURCHASE CONFERS NO RESIDENCE, but with two corrections to the draft. The residence permit for business is available on four enumerated bases, none of which is real estate: shareholder of a company, at least EUR 65,000 invested in the company's activities in Estonia; sole proprietor, at least EUR 16,000 invested in the business activity in Estonia; start-up entrepreneur, a separate track; and LARGE INVESTOR, at least EUR 1,000,000 of permanent direct investment in an Estonian company investing in the Estonian economy, or in an investment fund investing mainly in Estonian companies. All bases additionally require income of at least six times the subsistence level and health insurance under Aliens Act §120, and the shareholder and sole-proprietor routes require settling in Estonia and registering in the Population Register. Permits issue for up to 5 years and are extendable up to 10 years at a time. CORRECTION 1: the draft omitted the EUR 1,000,000 large-investor route, which is real and current — still not a property route, being company or fund only, but a publication-grade negative should mention it or a reader will conclude something was missed. CORRECTION 2 — a precision point that matters: the official pages do NOT contain an express exclusion of real estate. Real estate is simply not among the enumerated bases, i.e. exclusion by OMISSION FROM A CLOSED LIST, not by express prohibition. Publish it that way; the stronger phrasing is not supported by the source text. E-RESIDENCY IS NOT RESIDENCE, in the authority's own words: 'e-Resident's digital ID does not grant the right to reside in Estonia.' It is a digital identity for electronic identification and digital signature only, valid 5 years, granted only to foreign nationals who do NOT hold an Estonian residence permit or right of residence. NOT VERIFIED: the draft's Aliens Act §§18–19 section references — riigiteataja.ee is a JavaScript application and the statute text could not be retrieved; only §120 for the insurance requirement is confirmed. Check the section numbers before citing them.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不賦予居留權，惟草稿有兩處須更正。營業居留許可有四種列舉事由，均不含不動產：公司股東，投入該公司在愛沙尼亞之營業活動至少 6.5 萬歐元；獨資經營者，投入在愛沙尼亞之營業活動至少 1.6 萬歐元；新創企業家，屬獨立途徑；以及大額投資人，對投資於愛沙尼亞經濟之愛沙尼亞公司、或對主要投資於愛沙尼亞公司之投資基金，作出至少 100 萬歐元之永久性直接投資。各事由並均要求收入達最低生活費之 6 倍以上，及依《外國人法》第 120 條投保健康保險；股東與獨資經營者途徑另須在愛沙尼亞定居並辦理人口登記。許可效期最長 5 年，每次可延長至多 10 年。更正一：草稿漏列 100 萬歐元之大額投資人途徑，該途徑真實且現行有效——仍非不動產途徑（僅限公司或基金），惟達刊登水準之否定條目應予提及，否則讀者將以為有所遺漏。更正二（此一精確度攸關重大）：官方頁面並無明文排除不動產之規定，不動產僅係未列於列舉事由之中，亦即係「自封閉清單中省略」而排除，而非明文禁止。應依此表述；較強之措辭並無來源條文支持。電子居民身分並非居留，主管機關原文為：「電子居民數位身分證不賦予在愛沙尼亞居住之權利。」該身分僅為電子識別與數位簽章之用，效期 5 年，且僅核發予未持有愛沙尼亞居留許可或居留權之外國人。未經查證：草稿所引《外國人法》第 18 至 19 條之條號——riigiteataja.ee 為 JavaScript 應用程式，條文無法取得，僅健康保險要件之第 120 條獲確認。引用條號前應先行查核。

negatives.short_en: The wealthy-foreign-national residence ground was abolished with effect from 17 April 2024.
negatives.short_zh: 高資產外國人居留事由自 2024 年 4 月 17 日起廢止。

finding.text_en: NO PROPERTY ROUTE, AND THE DRAFT'S DATE IS WRONG. The wealthy-foreign-national residence ground (vermogende vreemdeling) was abolished with effect from 17 APRIL 2024, not 1 January 2024. Instrument: Besluit (Order in Council) of 9 April 2024 amending the Besluit inburgering 2021, the Besluit uitvoering Wet arbeid vreemdelingen 2022 and the Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000, published as Staatsblad 2024, 83, issued 16 April 2024; article V provides that it enters into force on the day after the date of issue of the Staatsblad in which it is placed, i.e. 17 April 2024. The Staatsblad's own table of contents labels the operative articles '[afschaffing verblijfsgrond vermogende vreemdelingen]'. Mechanically, art. I(D) strikes the term 'vermogende vreemdeling' from art. 3.29a(1) Vb 2000 and repeals art. 3.29a(2) in its entirety — the explanatory memorandum states the second limb was repealed expressly to put beyond doubt that wealthy foreign nationals cannot still qualify via the second paragraph. Art. IV preserves permits already granted. PROPERTY NEVER QUALIFIED: the scheme entered into force 1 October 2013 and allowed a permit to foreign nationals with assets of at least EUR 1,250,000, but in 2013 the policy narrowed this to foreign investors investing at least that amount in an INNOVATIVE ENTERPRISE (Vreemdelingencirculaire B11/2.2), the stated reason being that merely holding that sum 'would on reflection be too little ground for granting a right of residence in the Netherlands'. Property purchase was never a qualifying use of the funds. Two publication-grade facts: FEWER THAN TEN permits were ever granted on this ground between 1 October 2013 and abolition; and the stated rationale for abolition was that such schemes 'have been under discussion within the EU for some years because of the risk of criminal activity, such as money laundering', with adaptation while preserving anti-abuse safeguards judged not feasible. Abolition was announced by the previous government by letter of 11 January 2021. IND's current listing of twenty work-related residence permits contains no wealthy-foreign-national or investor permit whatsoever. NOT VERIFIED: the Dutch-American Friendship Treaty route, which is administered as a variant of the self-employed permit and is not property-based, was not independently sourced.
finding.text_zh: 無不動產途徑，且草稿之日期有誤。高資產外國人居留事由（vermogende vreemdeling）自 2024 年 4 月 17 日起廢止，而非 2024 年 1 月 1 日。法律工具：2024 年 4 月 9 日之王室命令，修正《2021 年融入命令》、《2022 年外國人勞動法施行命令》及《2000 年外國人命令》，刊登為《國家公報》2024 年第 83 號，發行日 2024 年 4 月 16 日；第 V 條規定自刊載該命令之《國家公報》發行日之翌日起生效，即 2024 年 4 月 17 日。《國家公報》目次就相關條文之標示即為「〔廢止高資產外國人居留事由〕」。技術上，第 I 條第 D 款自《2000 年外國人命令》第 3.29a 條第 1 項刪除「高資產外國人」一詞，並全部廢止第 3.29a 條第 2 項——立法理由說明，廢止第二項係為明確排除高資產外國人仍得循第二項取得資格之疑義。第 IV 條保留已核發之許可。不動產從未合格：該制度於 2013 年 10 月 1 日生效，容許資產達 125 萬歐元以上之外國人取得許可，惟 2013 年之政策已將其限縮為將該金額投入創新企業之外國投資人（《外國人通函》B11/2.2），理由為單純持有該筆金額「經審酌後，作為在荷蘭取得居留權之依據仍嫌不足」。購置不動產從未屬合格之資金用途。兩項達刊登水準之事實：自 2013 年 10 月 1 日至廢止為止，依此事由核發之許可不足 10 件；廢止理由為此類制度「因洗錢等犯罪風險，於歐盟內部已討論多年」，且經評估認為在維持防弊機制之前提下加以調整並不可行。廢止係由前任政府以 2021 年 1 月 11 日函宣布。荷蘭移民局現行所列 20 種工作類居留許可中，完全不含高資產外國人或投資人許可。未經查證：荷美友好條約途徑（以自營作業許可之變體辦理，非以不動產為基礎）未經獨立查證。

negatives.short_en: Statuses of residence are enumerated exhaustively in the appended tables and none rests on real-estate ownership.
negatives.short_zh: 在留資格於附表中窮盡列舉，其中並無以不動產所有權為基礎者。

finding.text_en: Property purchase confers no status of residence. Residence requires a Status of Residence under the Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act, whose appended tables enumerate the categories exhaustively; none is based on real-estate ownership. Separately verified and worth flagging because it is often the fallback route people reach for: the Business Manager status was materially tightened with effect from 16 October 2025 — required capital rose from JPY 5 million to JPY 30 million, plus at least one full-time employee, Japanese-language capability, and a degree or three or more years' management experience.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不賦予任何居留資格。居留須依《出入國管理及難民認定法》取得在留資格，該法附表窮盡列舉各類資格，其中並無以不動產所有權為基礎者。另經查證且值得標示者（因常被視為替代途徑）：經營管理在留資格自 2025 年 10 月 16 日起大幅收緊——所需資本額由 500 萬日圓提高至 3,000 萬日圓，並須僱用至少 1 名全職員工、具備日語能力，且具學位或 3 年以上經營管理經驗。

ownership_form.text_en: No nationality restriction on freehold ownership of land or buildings. The only overlay is a notification regime — not a prohibition — under the Important Land Survey Act (Act No. 84 of 2021, in force 20 September 2022) for land near defence sites and critical infrastructure.
ownership_form.text_zh: 土地及建物之完全所有權不設國籍限制。唯一附加者為通報制度而非禁止規定，依《重要土地調查法》（2021 年第 84 號法律，2022 年 9 月 20 日施行），適用於防衛設施及重要基礎設施周邊土地。

negatives.short_en: Investment-immigration routes are limited to investment in a profit-seeking enterprise or in central government bonds.
negatives.short_zh: 投資移民途徑僅限投資營利事業或中央政府公債。

finding.text_en: Property purchase grants no residence. The National Immigration Agency's investment-immigration routes are exhaustively listed and real estate is absent from both the eligibility list and the documentary checklist. The two routes are investment of NT$15 million or more in a profit-seeking enterprise creating employment for five or more nationals for three years, or investment of NT$30 million or more in central government bonds held for three years.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不取得居留權。內政部移民署之投資移民途徑係窮盡列舉，不動產既不在資格清單，亦不在文件檢核表內。兩條途徑分別為：投資營利事業新臺幣 1,500 萬元以上並創造 5 人以上本國人就業機會滿 3 年，或投資中央政府公債面額新臺幣 3,000 萬元以上滿 3 年。

ownership_form.text_en: Foreign nationals require Ministry of the Interior approval, subject to the reciprocity principle in Article 18 of the Land Act — acquisition of land rights by foreign nationals is to be equal to the rights ROC nationals enjoy in the host country. NOT PUBLISHED: the sometimes-cited 'vacant land / investment-use' restriction could not be pinned to a citable provision and is omitted.
ownership_form.text_zh: 外國人須經內政部核准，並適用《土地法》第 18 條之平等互惠原則——外國人取得土地權利，以其本國給予中華民國人民同樣權利者為限。不予刊載：時而被引用之「空地／投資用途」限制無法對應可引註之條文，故從缺。

negatives.short_en: The Global Investor Programme requires business and investment activity; residential property is not a qualifying investment.
negatives.short_zh: 全球投資者計畫要求實質營運與投資活動，住宅不動產不屬合格投資。

finding.text_en: No residence from property. The Global Investor Programme confers permanent residence for business and investment activity — EDB describes it as according PR 'to eligible global investors who intend to drive their businesses and investment growth from Singapore' and requiring 'a substantial business track record and successful entrepreneurial background'. Residential property is not a qualifying investment. NOT PUBLISHED: the specific GIP thresholds sometimes quoted as SGD 10m business / SGD 25m fund / SGD 50m family-office AUM could not be verified — the EDB factsheet would not retrieve — so the qualitative statement stands but the three figures are omitted.
finding.text_zh: 不因購置不動產取得居留。全球投資者計畫係就商業與投資活動授予永久居留——經濟發展局稱其授予永久居留予「有意自新加坡推動其事業與投資成長之合資格全球投資人」，並要求「深厚之商業經歷與成功之創業背景」。住宅不動產非合格投資項目。不予刊載：時而被引用之新幣 1,000 萬元企業／2,500 萬元基金／5,000 萬元家族辦公室管理資產等具體門檻無法查證（經濟發展局說明文件無法取得），故保留定性陳述而略去該三項數字。

ownership_form.text_en: Foreign persons need Land Dealings Approval Unit approval under the Residential Property Act for vacant residential land and for terrace, semi-detached and bungalow houses, and for Sentosa Cove landed property; the stated criteria are at least five years' Singapore permanent residence and exceptional economic contribution to Singapore. Condominiums and strata flats are exempt. Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty for foreigners was raised from 30% to 60% with effect from 27 April 2023 — stated as a dated change because no tier-1 page confirming the rate is still 60% in 2026 could be retrieved.
ownership_form.text_zh: 外國人購買空置住宅用地、排屋、半獨立式及獨立式洋房，以及聖淘沙灣有地房產，須依《住宅財產法》取得土地交易審批組核准；所列標準為已取得新加坡永久居留至少 5 年且對新加坡有卓越經濟貢獻。公寓及分層住宅不在此限。外國人額外買方印花稅自 2023 年 4 月 27 日起由 30% 調高至 60%——以「該日之調整」陳述，因無法取得確認 2026 年仍為 60% 之一級來源頁面。

negatives.short_en: Causation runs the other way: visa status determines whether a purchase is permitted at all, and FIRB approval is required in order to buy.
negatives.short_zh: 因果關係相反：簽證身分決定是否得以購置，且購置前須取得外資審議委員會核准。

finding.text_en: Buying confers no visa; the causation runs the other way. FIRB approval is required in order TO BUY, and visa status determines whether purchase is permitted at all. The ATO defines a foreign person as one who is not an Australian citizen, an Australian permanent resident, or a New Zealand citizen holding a special category visa. CORRECTION TO THE DRAFT: the ban on foreign purchases of established dwellings does NOT end on 31 March 2027. It ran from 1 April 2025 and has been extended by two years and three months to 30 JUNE 2029, announced in the 2026-27 Budget.
finding.text_zh: 購置不賦予簽證；因果關係恰好相反。取得外資審查委員會核准是購買之前提，且簽證身分決定是否得以購買。澳洲稅務局將外國人定義為非澳洲公民、非澳洲永久居民、且非持特別類別簽證之紐西蘭公民者。草稿更正：外國人購買既有住宅之禁令並非於 2027 年 3 月 31 日屆滿。該禁令自 2025 年 4 月 1 日起實施，並依 2026-27 年度預算宣布延長 2 年 3 個月至 2029 年 6 月 30 日。

ownership_form.text_en: Foreign persons require FIRB (now foreigninvestment.gov.au) approval for residential and commercial property. From 1 April 2025 to 30 June 2029 foreign persons are banned from purchasing established dwellings, with limited exceptions.
ownership_form.text_zh: 外國人購買住宅及商用不動產須取得外資審查委員會（現為 foreigninvestment.gov.au）核准。自 2025 年 4 月 1 日至 2029 年 6 月 30 日，外國人禁止購買既有住宅，僅有少數例外。

sources.publisher: Australian Taxation Office
Australian Taxation Office

negatives.short_en: Foreign ownership takes the form of a fixed-term certificate, not an immigration status.
negatives.short_zh: 外國人所有權之形式為定期權狀，並非移民身分。

finding.text_en: No visa or residence flows from a housing purchase. Foreign ownership is a fixed-term certificate, not an immigration status.
finding.text_zh: 購置房產不產生任何簽證或居留權。外國人之所有權為定期權利證書，並非移民身分。

ownership_form.text_en: Law on Housing 2023 (No. 27/2023/QH15) with Decree 95/2024/ND-CP, in force 1 August 2024. Foreign individuals may own for no more than 50 years from the date the certificate is granted, extendable once for a further 50 years, subject to caps of 30% of the apartments in any one building or block and no more than 250 landed houses per ward-equivalent area. A foreign individual married to a Vietnamese citizen obtains stable long-term ownership under Article 20(2)(c).
ownership_form.text_zh: 《2023 年住宅法》（第 27/2023/QH15 號）及第 95/2024/ND-CP 號議定書，2024 年 8 月 1 日施行。外國個人自證書核發日起最長可持有 50 年，得延長一次再 50 年，並受同一棟或同一區塊公寓 30% 上限、以及每一坊級區域有地住宅不超過 250 戶之限制。與越南公民結婚之外國個人依第 20 條第 2 項第 c 款取得穩定之長期所有權。

sources.publisher: LuatVietnam — translation of Law on Housing No. 27/2023/QH15
Viger Law (Vietnam)
DNP Law (Vietnam)

negatives.short_en: Temporary residency by real-estate investment has been suspended since 4 April 2007 and has not reopened.
negatives.short_zh: 不動產投資臨時居留自 2007 年 4 月 4 日起暫停受理，迄今未重開。

finding.text_en: The real-estate investment residency route has been closed since 4 April 2007 and has NOT reopened. IPIM states that 'New applications for temporary residency based on investment in local real estate have not been accepted since 4 April 2007, without prejudice to the renewal application of the granted residency and extension application made by interested parties of approved residency.' The Government has separately rebutted revival rumours, confirming that 'Administrative Regulation No. 7/2007, effective from 4 April 2007, is still in force and ... temporary residency applications for investment in local real estate are still suspended.' The backlog of pre-suspension applications was fully cleared by 17 July 2015. The surviving IPIM route is major-investment or major-investment-plan under Administrative Regulation No. 3/2005 — business, not property.
finding.text_zh: 以不動產投資取得居留之途徑自 2007 年 4 月 4 日起關閉，且未重新開放。貿促局表示：「自 2007 年 4 月 4 日起已不再接受以本地不動產投資為依據之臨時居留新申請，惟不影響已獲批居留者之續期申請及利害關係人之延期申請。」政府另已駁斥重啟傳聞，確認「第 7/2007 號行政法規自 2007 年 4 月 4 日生效後仍然有效……以本地不動產投資申請臨時居留仍屬暫停」。暫停前之積案已於 2015 年 7 月 17 日全數處理完畢。貿促局現存途徑為第 3/2005 號行政法規下之重大投資或重大投資計畫，屬商業性質而非不動產。

ownership_form.text_en: Legal instrument: Administrative Regulation No. 7/2007. Only renewals of already-granted residency and family-dependant extensions continue to be processed.
ownership_form.text_zh: 法律依據：第 7/2007 號行政法規。現僅繼續處理已獲批居留之續期及家團成員之延期。

sources.publisher: Macao Trade and Investment Promotion Institute (IPIM)
Macao SAR Government services portal
Macao SAR Government

negatives.short_en: The Investor Permit requires a business project approved by Investment Fiji under a Foreign Investment Registration Certificate.
negatives.short_zh: 投資人許可須具經斐濟投資局核准並取得外人投資登記證之營業專案。

finding.text_en: Property purchase confers no permit. The Investor Permit under section 9(2)(c) of the Immigration Act 2003 requires a business project approved by Investment Fiji via a Foreign Investment Registration Certificate. CORRECTION TO THE DRAFT: the minimum investment threshold is FJD 300,000, not FJD 250,000 — Investment (Reserved and Restricted Activities) Regulations 2022, regulation 3: 'The minimum investment threshold in Fiji is FJD $300,000 except for the restricted activities outlined in the Schedule', and the investor must bring at least FJD 300,000 into Fiji within three months from the date of incorporation. Restricted activities carry higher thresholds.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不賦予任何許可。《2003 年入出境法》第 9(2)(c) 條之投資人許可，須有經斐濟投資局核發外國投資登記證之營業計畫。草稿更正：最低投資門檻為 30 萬斐濟元而非 25 萬——《2022 年投資（保留及限制業別）規則》第 3 條規定：「斐濟最低投資門檻為 30 萬斐濟元，附表所列限制業別除外」，且投資人須自公司設立日起 3 個月內匯入至少 30 萬斐濟元。限制業別門檻更高。

ownership_form.text_en: Land Sales (Amendment) Act 2014, new section 7A: 'any State land or freehold land for residential purposes in any area within the boundary of any town or city declared or extended under the Local Government Act (Cap. 125) shall not be sold, transferred or leased to a non-resident.' Strata and unit title and integrated tourism developments are carved out, and land outside municipal boundaries is unaffected.
ownership_form.text_zh: 《2014 年土地買賣（修正）法》新增第 7A 條：「依《地方政府法》（第 125 章）宣告或擴張之任何鎮或市界內，供住宅用途之任何國有地或永久業權土地，不得出售、移轉或出租予非居民。」分層及單元業權與整合型觀光開發案除外，市鎮界外之土地亦不受影響。

sources.publisher: Laws of Fiji — Investment (Reserved and Restricted Activities) Regulations 2022
Parliament of Fiji — Land Sales (Amendment) Act 2014
Ministry of Immigration, Fiji

negatives.short_en: Acquisition is governed by FEMA purely as an exchange-control matter and produces no immigration status.
negatives.short_zh: 取得不動產依《外匯管理法》處理，純屬外匯管制事項，不產生移民身分。

finding.text_en: No visa or residence arises from property purchase; FEMA governs acquisition purely as an exchange-control matter.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不產生任何簽證或居留權；《外匯管理法》純以外匯管制角度規範取得行為。

ownership_form.text_en: Foreign Exchange Management (Acquisition and Transfer of Immovable Property in India) Regulations 2018 — Notification No. FEMA 21(R)/2018-RB of 26 March 2018. Purchase rights are granted only to NRIs and OCIs (regulation 3, non-agricultural property only, funded by inward remittance or NRO/NRE accounts), to branch, liaison and project offices for property necessary for or incidental to their activity (regulation 4), and to foreign embassies and diplomats with Ministry of External Affairs clearance (regulation 5). A foreign national of non-Indian origin resident outside India falls outside all of these and needs RBI permission. Regulation 9 additionally bars nationals of Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Afghanistan, China, Iran, Nepal, Bhutan, Hong Kong, Macau and North Korea from acquiring or transferring immovable property, other than a lease not exceeding five years, without prior RBI approval. Agricultural land, farmhouses and plantation property are barred to NRIs and OCIs as well.
ownership_form.text_zh: 《2018 年外匯管理（印度境內不動產之取得與移轉）規則》——2018 年 3 月 26 日第 FEMA 21(R)/2018-RB 號公告。購買權僅授予非居民印度人及海外印度公民（第 3 條，限非農業不動產，資金須為境外匯入或 NRO／NRE 帳戶）、分公司/聯絡處/專案辦事處就其業務所必需或附隨之不動產（第 4 條），以及經外交部核可之外國使領館及外交人員（第 5 條）。非印度裔且居住境外之外國人不屬上述任一情形，須經印度儲備銀行許可。第 9 條另規定，巴基斯坦、孟加拉、斯里蘭卡、阿富汗、中國、伊朗、尼泊爾、不丹、香港、澳門及北韓國民，未經印度儲備銀行事前核准，不得取得或移轉不動產（不逾 5 年之租賃除外）。農地、農舍及種植園不動產對非居民印度人及海外印度公民亦同屬禁止。

sources.publisher: Reserve Bank of India

negatives.short_en: Holding a qualifying visa is what permits the purchase; the purchase never produces a visa.
negatives.short_zh: 須先持有合格簽證方得購置；購置本身不產生任何簽證。

finding.text_en: DIRECTION CONFIRMED, and the 2026 reform does not reverse it: holding a qualifying visa is what PERMITS the purchase; the purchase never produces a visa. LINZ states that New Zealand citizens and permanent residents who meet the 'ordinarily resident' requirements can buy without restrictions, while 'Overseas people usually cannot buy a house or land in New Zealand', and that you cannot buy or build a home if you are an overseas person on a temporary, limited, interim or transit visa such as a student, work or visitor visa, or an overseas person without any visa. The 2025-26 change is now IN FORCE and its direction is the same: the Overseas Investment (National Interest Test and Other Matters) Amendment Act passed under urgency on 12 December 2025 and came into force on 6 MARCH 2026, letting holders of Active Investor Plus, Investor 1 and Investor 2 visas apply for OIO consent to buy or build ONE residential or lifestyle dwelling valued over NZD 5 million even if not ordinarily resident. That is still visa first, permission-to-buy second.
finding.text_zh: 方向已確認，2026 年之改革亦未逆轉：持有合格簽證是「得以購買」之前提；購買絕不產生簽證。土地資訊局載明，符合「通常居住」要件之紐西蘭公民及永久居民可無限制購買，而「海外人士通常不得在紐西蘭購買房屋或土地」；持學生、工作或訪客等臨時、限制、過渡或過境簽證之海外人士，以及無簽證之海外人士，不得購買或興建自用住宅。2025-26 年之修法現已生效，方向不變：《海外投資（國家利益檢驗及其他事項）修正法》於 2025 年 12 月 12 日以緊急程序通過，並於 2026 年 3 月 6 日施行，允許 Active Investor Plus、Investor 1 及 Investor 2 簽證持有人即使不符「通常居住」，亦得向海外投資辦公室申請核准購買或興建一戶價值逾 500 萬紐幣之住宅或生活型態用地住宅。此仍為先有簽證、後得購買。

ownership_form.text_en: Residential land is 'sensitive land' under the Overseas Investment Act 2005 as amended by the Overseas Investment Amendment Act 2018; the general foreign-buyer ban remains. For the new investor-visa pathway, LINZ guidance states that consent under the Overseas Investment Act is required and 'Consent will be inexpensive and generally be granted within five working days.'
ownership_form.text_zh: 住宅用地依《2005 年海外投資法》（經《2018 年海外投資修正法》修正）屬「敏感土地」；一般外國買方禁令仍然存續。就新設之投資簽證途徑，土地資訊局指引載明須依《海外投資法》取得核准，且「核准費用低廉，通常於 5 個工作日內核發」。

sources.publisher: Land Information New Zealand (LINZ)
Land Information New Zealand (LINZ) — guidance for investor visa holders
New Zealand Government

negatives.short_en: A resident visa is granted only on marriage to a Maldivian citizen.
negatives.short_zh: 居留簽證僅以與馬爾地夫公民結婚為事由核發。

finding.text_en: No residency by property purchase. Maldives Immigration states that 'A Resident Visa is granted to a foreign national married to a Maldivian citizen, allowing them to reside in the Maldives' — marriage is the sole basis. A Corporate Resident Visa exists but is tied to registered FOREIGN INVESTMENT (shareholders, directors, senior officers), not to property; its eligibility criteria and thresholds could not be retrieved from an official source and are NOT published.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不取得任何居留權。馬爾地夫移民局載明：「居留簽證授予與馬爾地夫公民結婚之外國人，使其得於馬爾地夫居住」——婚姻為唯一依據。另有法人居留簽證，惟其係與登記之外國投資（股東、董事、高階主管）掛鉤而非不動產；其資格條件與門檻無法自官方來源取得，故不予刊載。

ownership_form.text_en: There is essentially no private freehold available to foreigners. Most land is leased from the government, though Maldivians may hold title. A 2015 constitutional amendment permitting foreign ownership of land and islands in connection with major projects — requiring investment of at least USD 1 billion with at least 70% of the land reclaimed — was REPEALED by parliament in 2019, and there are now no property or real estate laws or mechanisms allowing foreign persons to hold title to land. Foreign parties may lease for no longer than 99 years for business activity; inhabited islands are capped at 50 years, and uninhabited non-tourism islands at 21 years below USD 1m investment, rising to 50 years above USD 10m. The exact repeal month is not settled between sources (April versus August 2019) and only the year is published.
ownership_form.text_zh: 外國人實質上無私有永久業權可言。多數土地係向政府承租，惟馬爾地夫人得持有所有權。2015 年一項憲法修正案曾允許外國人就重大計畫持有土地及島嶼所有權（須投資至少 10 億美元且至少 70% 土地為填海造地），該修正案已於 2019 年經議會廢止，現行已無任何法律或機制允許外國人持有土地所有權。外國人得為營業目的承租不逾 99 年；有人島上限 50 年，無人島（非觀光用途）在投資額低於 100 萬美元時為 21 年，逾 1,000 萬美元時可達 50 年。廢止之確切月份於各來源間未有定論（2019 年 4 月或 8 月），故僅刊載年份。

sources.publisher: Maldives Immigration
United States Department of State — 2024 Investment Climate Statement, Maldives

negatives.short_en: Purchase requires government sanction. Residency is the prerequisite for a discount on that sanction fee, not a consequence of buying.
negatives.short_zh: 購置須取得政府核可。居留身分為核可規費折減之前提，而非購置之結果。

finding.text_en: No automatic residency from property purchase. The Seychelles Planning Authority states that 'A Non-Seychellois individual or corporate body may purchase immovable property (or rights therein) which is privately owned in Seychelles subject to sanction being obtained from the Government' — the document addresses sanction only and says nothing about residency. The causality in fact runs the opposite way: Immigration and Civil Status describes Permanent Residence holders as able to buy land and residential property with Government sanction at only 50% of the sanction fee. Residency is the prerequisite for the discount, not a consequence of the purchase.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不自動取得居留權。塞席爾規劃局載明：「非塞席爾籍個人或法人得購買塞席爾境內私有之不動產（或其權利），惟須取得政府之許可」——該文件僅處理許可事項，未涉及居留。實際因果關係恰好相反：移民及民事身分局說明永久居留持有人得在取得政府許可下購買土地及住宅，且僅需支付 50% 之許可費。居留是取得該折扣之前提，而非購買之結果。

ownership_form.text_en: Purchase requires Government sanction. Fees: application SCR 3,000 for a purchase; sanction processing at 1.5% of market value; residential sanction duty increased from 11% to 12% of market value. Minimum values: dwelling house SCR 10 million; bare land SCR 4,000 per square metre; condominium units SCR 30,000 per square metre.
ownership_form.text_zh: 購買須取得政府許可。費用：購買申請費 3,000 塞席爾盧比；許可處理費為市價之 1.5%；住宅許可稅由市價之 11% 調高至 12%。最低金額：住宅 1,000 萬盧比；素地每平方公尺 4,000 盧比；區分所有權單元每平方公尺 30,000 盧比。

sources.publisher: Seychelles Planning Authority

negatives.short_en: EB-5 requires a commercial enterprise and ten permanent jobs; the Gold Card launched in the interim and is not property-linked.
negatives.short_zh: EB-5 要求投資商業實體並創造 10 個長期就業機會；其後推出之 Gold Card 亦與不動產無涉。

finding.text_en: CONFIRMED: no property-linked residency route — but the wording must now account for the Gold Card, which launched in the interim and is NOT property-linked. Two routes exist, and neither is real estate. (1) EB-5: USCIS states eligibility requires the investor to 'Make the necessary investment in a commercial enterprise in the United States' and to 'Plan to create or preserve 10 permanent full-time jobs for qualified U.S. workers'. Both conditions are conjunctive and neither can be met by a passive purchase of residential real estate: buying a home is not a commercial enterprise and creates no permanent full-time jobs. Real estate features only indirectly, as the underlying asset of a job-creating commercial enterprise (typically a regional-centre development project) — an investment in an operating business, not property ownership by the applicant. (2) THE GOLD CARD: established by Executive Order 14351 of 19 September 2025. Its operative text requires 'an unrestricted gift to the Department of Commerce under 15 U.S.C. 1522', of '$1 million for an individual donating on his or her own behalf and $2 million for a corporation or similar entity donating on behalf of an individual'; the gift is then treated as evidence of eligibility under 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(1)(A) and of exceptional business ability, i.e. it routes the applicant through the existing extraordinary-ability and exceptional-ability immigrant categories. The words 'real estate' and 'property' do not appear anywhere in the Executive Order. It is a non-refundable gift to the federal government, not an asset purchase. CONCLUSION: the United States now has a price-tagged residency route, but it buys nothing and confers no asset — there is still no US visa category granting residence in exchange for owning a home.
finding.text_zh: 已確認：不存在與房產掛鉤的居留途徑——但措辭現在必須把期間內上路的「金卡」計入，而金卡並不與房產掛鉤。目前存在兩條路徑，兩條都不是房地產。（1）EB-5：USCIS 載明資格要求投資人「在美國的商業企業中完成必要投資」，並「計畫創造或維持 10 個合格美國勞工的全職永久職位」。兩項條件並存，被動購置住宅都無法滿足：買房不是商業企業，也不創造全職永久職位。房地產僅間接出現——作為創造就業之商業企業（通常是區域中心開發案）的底層資產——那是對營運中事業的投資，而非申請人自己持有物業。（2）金卡：由 2025 年 9 月 19 日第 14351 號行政命令設立。其實體條文要求「依 15 U.S.C. 1522 向商務部作出無限制贈與」，金額為「個人以自身名義捐贈 100 萬美元，法人或類似實體代個人捐贈 200 萬美元」；該筆贈與其後被視為符合 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(1)(A) 及卓越商業能力之資格證據，亦即將申請人導入既有的傑出人才與特殊能力移民類別。行政命令全文未出現「real estate」或「property」字樣。它是對聯邦政府的不可退還贈與，不是資產購置。結論：美國現在確有一條明碼標價的居留途徑，但它買不到任何東西、也不帶來任何資產——美國仍然沒有任何簽證類別以持有住宅換取居留權。

negatives.notes_en: The coordinator's hint was right: the Gold Card has progressed well beyond a proposal — it is a signed Executive Order, read here in full at tier 1. Two things about it are NOT published because they were only available at tier 3: the US$15,000 processing/vetting fee, and take-up figures (reported as 338 applications, 165 fee payments and one approval as at April 2026). Those are plausible but agency-sourced; if the take-up point matters editorially, it needs a Commerce Department or FOIA-response citation. The EB-5 minimum investment amounts (commonly cited as US$1,050,000 standard and US$800,000 in a targeted employment area) were also NOT verified in this pass and are deliberately not published. The negative finding depends on none of these.

sources.publisher: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS)
The White House — Executive Order 14351, 'The Gold Card', 19 September 2025

negatives.short_en: IRCC’s own complete enumeration of permanent-residence pathways contains no property-linked route.
negatives.short_zh: 加拿大移民、難民及公民部所列永久居留途徑之完整清單中，並無不動產連結途徑。

finding.text_en: CONFIRMED: no property-linked residency route. IRCC's own complete enumeration of permanent-residence pathways ('Live in Canada permanently') lists Express Entry, Caregivers, Medical doctors, Provincial Nominee Program, Rural and Francophone Community Immigration Pilots, Atlantic Immigration Program, Quebec-selected skilled workers, Quebec investors and entrepreneurs, family sponsorship, refugees, and special programs for Hong Kong residents and former youth in state care. None is property-linked; the phrase 'real estate' does not appear on the page. The same page lists Start-up Visa and Self-employed persons as Paused, and Economic Mobility Pathways Pilot, TR-to-PR pathway and Agri-Food Pilot as Closed.
finding.text_zh: 已確認：不存在與房產掛鉤的居留途徑。加拿大移民、難民及公民部（IRCC）自身完整列舉的永久居留途徑（「永久居留於加拿大」頁）包含快速通道、看護者、醫師、省提名計畫、鄉村與法語社群移民試辦、大西洋移民計畫、魁北克甄選技術移民、魁北克投資人與創業家、家庭團聚、難民，以及香港居民與曾受政府照護青年的特別計畫。無一與房產掛鉤；該頁完全沒有出現「real estate」一詞。同頁並列出創業簽證與自雇人士為「暫停」，經濟流動途徑試辦、臨時轉永久居留途徑與農業食品試辦為「關閉」。

negatives.notes_en: Two things in the brief could NOT be verified and must not be published as stated. (1) The federal Immigrant Investor Program's termination (widely dated to 2014) was not verified against a statute or government page in this pass. (2) Quebec's programme has NOT ended — IRCC's current page lists 'Quebec investors and entrepreneurs' as a live regional pathway. The Quebec investor stream's parameters were not verified (the quebec.ca page consulted returned 404), so no claim is made about whether it is property-linked; the negative above rests only on the absence of any property route from IRCC's own enumeration. Confidence is therefore medium, not high.
negatives.notes_zh: 簡報中有兩點未能查證，不得照原文刊登。（1）聯邦投資移民計畫的終止（一般繫於 2014 年）本次未對照法條或政府頁面查證。（2）魁北克的計畫並未結束——IRCC 現行頁面仍將「魁北克投資人與創業家」列為運作中的區域途徑。魁北克投資人管道的參數未查證（所查 quebec.ca 頁面回傳 404），故不就其是否與房產掛鉤作任何主張；上述否定結論僅立基於 IRCC 自身列舉中不存在任何房產途徑。因此信心度為 medium 而非 high。

negatives.short_en: The Desert Visa Programme has never been launched, and five mutually inconsistent thresholds circulate for it.
negatives.short_zh: 沙漠簽證計畫從未上路，坊間就其門檻流傳五個互不一致的數字。

finding.text_en: NO PROPERTY-LINKED RESIDENCY ROUTE IS IN FORCE, and the reported debunk of the 'NAD 3.95m golden visa' is supported — though by a different and stronger argument than the one reported. The programme that agency material describes is the Desert Visa Programme, under which foreign investors would obtain a renewable five-year residence permit by purchasing real estate in approved projects. It was announced by the CEO of the Namibia Investment Promotion and Development Board and has been reported on since 2021, but as at April 2026 the specialist investment-migration outlet IMI Daily records it as 'under review in Cabinet', 'contingent on passage of a pending migration control bill', and explicitly 'not formally launched'; a second specialist source states the launch date 'has not yet been confirmed' and depends on passage of a draft law; a third describes it as 'stalled in development since 2021'. A programme that has not been launched cannot have a threshold, which is the cleanest possible answer to the NAD 3.95m question. THE SECOND, INDEPENDENT ARGUMENT IS THE STATE OF THE CIRCULATING NUMBERS THEMSELVES. Across agency and marketing material this pass encountered, for the same claimed Namibian programme: NAD 2,000,000 (~US$110,000), NAD 3,950,000, US$316,000, US$375,000, and 'no fixed or official investment threshold'. Five mutually inconsistent figures for one supposed programme is not a sourcing gap — it is what invention looks like. Publish Namibia as having no in-force property-linked residency route, and do not publish any figure.
finding.text_zh: 不存在生效中的不動產連結居留途徑，且報導中對「NAD 395 萬黃金簽證」的破除獲得支持——惟支持的論據與報導所述不同，且更為有力。仲介文宣所描述的計畫是「沙漠簽證計畫」，據稱外籍投資人可透過購買核准建案內的不動產，取得可續期的五年居留許可。該計畫由納米比亞投資促進與發展局執行長對外宣布，自 2021 年起即有報導，但截至 2026 年 4 月，投資移民專業媒體 IMI Daily 記載其仍「處於內閣審議中」、「取決於一部尚未通過的移民管制法案」，並明白指出「尚未正式上路」；另一專業來源稱其上路日期「迄今未定」，取決於一部法律草案的通過；第三方來源則描述其「自 2021 年起停滯於研議階段」。一個尚未上路的計畫不可能有門檻，這是對 NAD 395 萬問題最乾淨俐落的回答。第二項獨立論據，是流通中的數字本身的狀態。在本次所見的仲介與行銷資料中，同一個號稱的納米比亞計畫出現了以下數字：NAD 2,000,000（約 11 萬美元）、NAD 3,950,000、316,000 美元、375,000 美元，以及「不存在固定或官方投資門檻」。同一個所謂計畫出現五個彼此矛盾的數字，這不是來源不足，這就是杜撰的樣貌。納米比亞應以「不存在生效中的不動產連結居留途徑」刊登，且不刊登任何數字。

negatives.notes_en: Confidence is medium, not high, for one reason: no Namibian government source was opened in this pass. The reported claim that the national investment board affirmatively states 'no minimum capital exists' was NOT independently verified and is not published as a quotation — what is published is the weaker but well-supported proposition that the programme is not in force. If a stronger negative is wanted, the NIPDB site and the Ministry of Home Affairs are the two places to check, and the status of the migration control bill is the single fact that would settle it.
negatives.notes_zh: 信心度列為 medium 而非 high，理由只有一個：本次未能開啟任何納米比亞政府來源。報導所稱該國投資局明確表示「不存在最低資本額」一節，未經獨立查證，故不以引述形式刊登；此處刊登的是較弱但佐證充分的命題——該計畫尚未生效。若需要更強的否定結論，NIPDB 網站與內政部是兩個該查的地方，而移民管制法案的立法進度，是唯一能一舉定案的事實。

excluded.jurisdiction_zh: 北馬其頓——投資入籍（《公民法》第 11 條）
excluded.reason_en: The route exists but its FIGURES cannot be published. Art. 11 of the Law on Citizenship permits naturalisation for special scientific, ECONOMIC, cultural, sporting or other national interest, and contains NO MONETARY FIGURE at all; art. 11(2) delegates the criteria to a Government decree (uredba) whose text could not be obtained. The widely circulated EUR 200,000 investment, 10-jobs and 1,000-person-cap figures appear only in tier-2 and tier-3 material and are not published. Confirmed at tier 1: this is an investment/national-interest route, NOT a property-purchase route. The property route is published separately as a programme.
excluded.reason_zh: 該途徑確實存在，惟其金額不具刊登條件。《公民法》第 11 條容許因特殊科學、經濟、文化、體育或其他國家利益而歸化，條文完全未載任何金額；第 11 條第 2 項將條件授權政府命令訂定，而該命令原文無法取得。廣為流傳之 20 萬歐元投資、創造 10 個就業機會及 1,000 人上限等數字僅見於第二級與第三級資料，不予刊登。第一級來源確認：此為投資／國家利益途徑，並非購屋途徑。不動產途徑另以獨立條目刊登。

excluded.reason_en: EXCLUDED — no legal instrument could be located, and the threshold itself is unestablished. Searches across the Cambodian General Department of Immigration, the Ministry of Interior and the e-visa portal returned no CM2H page of any kind; the programme has no government-domain footprint at all. Every locatable source is the programme's own marketing or a promotional outlet, i.e. tier 3. The programme's own materials describe it as launched by the Khmer Home Charity Association — a NON-GOVERNMENT body — with 'exclusive approval from the Ministry of Interior', which is a claim of authorisation rather than a legal basis, and no sub-decree, prakas or other instrument is cited anywhere. The draft's internal conflicts are unresolved and unresolvable on the available sourcing: launch date given as 2022 in one source and 2023 in another, and the threshold given as USD 50,000 in one and USD 100,000 in another. Per the publication rule, where the threshold itself is unestablished the programme moves to excluded rather than being published at reduced confidence. Do not publish any CM2H figure.
excluded.reason_zh: 排除——查無任何法律文件，門檻本身亦未確立。遍查柬埔寨移民總局、內政部及電子簽證入口網，均無任何 CM2H 頁面；該計畫在政府網域完全沒有足跡。所有可查得之來源均為該計畫自身之行銷素材或宣傳性媒體，即第三級來源。該計畫自身資料稱其由高棉家園慈善協會（非政府機構）推出，並「獲內政部獨家批准」，此係授權之主張而非法律依據，且各處均未引註任何次級法令、部令或其他文件。草稿之內部矛盾在現有來源下無法解決：發起年份一說 2022、一說 2023；門檻一說 5 萬美元、一說 10 萬美元。依刊載規則，門檻本身未確立者應移入排除項，而非降級刊載。任何 CM2H 數字均不得刊載。

excluded.reason_en: Threshold itself unestablished, and the official site is itself suspect. On a second pass, cbi.gov.gd attributes 'Minimum contribution of USD 150,000' specifically to the National Transformation Fund route and publishes NO figure at all for the real-estate / approved-projects route; that route's own page returned 404 on every path tried, in both WebFetch and a rendering browser. The US$150,000 NTF figure is itself below the US$200,000 floor the five-country memorandum reportedly imposed in 2024, which means either the memorandum does not bind Grenada as reported or the official site is stale — and we cannot tell which. Secondary sources disagree materially on the real-estate figure (US$220,000 and US$270,000 both appear) and all are tier-3. Per the publication rule, a programme whose threshold cannot be established is excluded rather than published with a hedge. NOTE for the coordinator: this is the one Caribbean gap; the other four are verified at tier 1.

MIXED RESULT — one of the two open questions is now ANSWERED, but the threshold itself still cannot be published. (1) THE GEOGRAPHIC SCOPE DOCUMENT HAS BEEN PUBLISHED — this is the headline and it is confirmed at tier 1. The Real Estate General Authority's own programme page for 'تملّك غير السعوديين للعقار' (Non-Saudi Real Estate Ownership) at rega.gov.sa carries four sections — About the Programme, Implementing Regulation, GEOGRAPHIC SCOPES (النطاقات الجغرافية), and FAQs — and its body text states that the 'Saudi Properties' portal (saudiproperties.rega.gov.sa) is the official portal for the regime and 'تستعرض النطاقات الجغرافية المعتمدة', i.e. displays the APPROVED geographic scopes. So the previous pass's warning that the SAR 4m threshold might be academic for want of anywhere to spend it does not hold: the scopes exist and are approved. Secondary sources put the Council of Ministers' approval of the Implementing Regulations and the Geographic Scopes Document at 23 June 2026 and the number of scopes at approximately 170, with regulated zones in Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah and Madinah and additional restrictions in Makkah and Madinah; those specifics are tier-2/3 and are NOT published. REGA separately records the Law of Real Estate Ownership by Non-Saudis as having entered into force on 21 January 2026. (2) THE SAR 4,000,000 PREMIUM RESIDENCY THRESHOLD CANNOT BE PUBLISHED. premiumresidency.sa does not resolve from this environment (DNS failure, not a block), my.gov.sa returned HTTP 403, and the only sources stating SAR 4,000,000 that were reachable are tier-3: a tax-residency marketing site, a luxury-property blog, a bank's social post, and the Premium Residency Center's own Instagram account. A government body's Instagram is not a citable tier-1 source for a number that will be printed. The figure is almost certainly right — it is uniform across every source seen and has been stable for two years — but 'almost certainly right' is exactly the standard this exercise exists to refuse. (3) THE 10% TOTAL FOREIGN-BUYER COST (5% RETT plus up to 5% surcharge) was not verified at any tier and is not published. (4) Royal Decree M/14 of 14 July 2025 was not read; REGA's 'in force since 21 January 2026' is the datable fact. RECOMMENDATION: one successful read of my.gov.sa service 'Request Premium Residency' or of the Premium Residency Permit Law implementing rules on misa.gov.sa or ncar.gov.sa would move Saudi Arabia straight into the published set — the NCAR site was seen to host a translated implementing-rules PDF whose table of contents includes an item 'g) Real Estate residency', which is very likely the exact provision needed.

Threshold not established. The reported US$300,000 real-estate route to Egyptian citizenship could not be confirmed: gafi.gov.eg returned 404 on the citizenship service path tried, egyptcitizenship.gov.eg refused the connection outright (ECONNREFUSED), and no Egyptian gazette or Ministry of Interior text was opened. What was seen was tier-3 only and included a materially different figure — one source describes the Egyptian investment-citizenship programme as having 'a minimum financial threshold of USD 250,000', which is the bank-deposit or donation route rather than the property route, and the coexistence of US$250,000 and US$300,000 in circulation is precisely the kind of confusion that must not be resolved by guessing. The unusual conditions reported — USD denomination, funds wired from abroad, five-year hold — remain plausible and unverified. NOT PUBLISHED. Note for a follow-up: the governing framework is Law 173 of 2018 amending the Egyptian Nationality Law 26/1975, with the amounts fixed by Prime Ministerial decree, so the decree is the document to find, not the statute.

Not researched in this pass — budget was consumed by the Priority-1 Gulf and Cape Verde items. The reported US$100,000 Zanzibar-only route remains unverified from either direction. Recording the two things a follow-up should hold onto: first, the Zanzibar-only scope is load-bearing, because Zanzibar is a semi-autonomous jurisdiction within Tanzania and a Zanzibar residence permit is not mainland Tanzanian residence; second, one tier-2 sweep of African programmes encountered in this pass ('Africa Residency by Investment: 8 Active Programs', IMI Daily, April 2026) describes an African programme qualifying 'through real estate ($50,000 for a one-year permit ...)', which if it refers to Zanzibar would contradict the US$100,000 figure outright. That single ambiguity is reason enough not to publish either number.

DISAGREEMENT AMONG TIER-2 SOURCES ON THE FIGURE THAT MATTERS. The headline figure of BRL 1,000,000 for a residence permit by real-estate investment is agreed across the sources seen. The REGIONAL DISCOUNT is not: one Brazilian law firm states BRL 700,000 for properties in the North and Northeast regions, and the SAME firm, in a 2026 article, states BRL 750,000 for North/Northeast; a third source repeats BRL 700,000. Two mutually exclusive values for the concessionary tier, from overlapping sources, with no Resolução Normativa or Portaria read to break the tie. Under the publication rule this goes to excluded rather than being published with a hedge, because the concessionary tier is the whole point of the regional split. Note also that the reported 'VITEM XIV' label was not corroborated by anything read here; the Brazilian instrument for individual-investor residence permits appears in the compiled migration legislation as a Resolução Normativa of the Conselho Nacional de Imigração, and identifying the correct RN number is the first step for a follow-up.

One lead worth recording for whoever picks this up: the IMI Daily survey 'Africa Residency by Investment: 8 Active Programs' (26 April 2026) enumerates which African programmes its authors consider actually active, and it would be the fastest way to work out which of these twelve deserve individual attention rather than a blanket negative.
